import { useState } from 'react';
import StudentCard from './components/StudentCard';
import Header from './components/Header';
import NavBr from './components/NavBr';
import Footer from './components/Footer';
import LoginModal from './components/LoginModal';
import './index.css';

function App() {
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-gray-100">
      <Header />
      <NavBr />

      <main className="flex-1 flex justify-center items-start py-8">
        <StudentCard />
      </main>

      <Footer />
    <LoginModal
    isOpen={!isLoggedIn}
    onLoginSuccess={() => setIsLoggedIn(true)}
    dismissible={false}/>
      
      
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;
```

## AdvancedHTML/my-project/src/components/LoginModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";

const VALID_EMAIL = 'zyrus@gmail.com';
const VALID_PASSWORD = '071234';

function LoginModal({ isOpen, onLoginSuccess, dismissible = false, onClose }) {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();

    if (!email || !password) {
      setError('Please fill both fields');
      return;
    }
    if (email === VALID_EMAIL && password === VALID_PASSWORD) {
      setError('');
      onLoginSuccess();
    } else {
      setError('Invalid email or password.');
    }
  };

  const handleBackdropClick = () => {
    if (dismissible && onClose) onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black bg-opacity-50 flex items-center justify-center z-50" onClick={handleBackdropClick}>
      <div className="bg-white rounded-lg shadow-md p-6 w-80" onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-extrabold">Login</h2>
          {dismissible && (
            <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600">X</button>
          )}
        </div>
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          <div className="mb-3">
            <label className="block text-sm mb-1">Email</label>
            <input
              type="email"
              value={email}
              onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full border rounded px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="name@example.com"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="mb-3">
            <label className="block text-sm mb-1">Password</label>
            <input
              type="password"
              value={password}
              onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full border rounded px-3 py-2 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500"
              placeholder="********"
            />
          </div>
          {error && <p className="text-red-500 text-sm mb-3">{error}</p>}
          <button
            type="submit"
            className="w-full bg-blue-500 text-white px-3 py-3 rounded hover:bg-blue-600"
          >
            Login
          </button>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default LoginModal;
```

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/server/README.md

```
# Backend server

Install the backend dependencies from this directory:

```bash
bun install
```

The backend reads configuration from the workspace-root `.env` regardless of
whether it is started from the repository root or this directory. Merge the
settings in this directory's `.env.example` into that root file, and set
`JWT_SECRET` to a long, random value. Do not commit the secret. MongoDB must be
running at the `MONGODB_URI` address; all backend operations target
`basketball_reservation`.

Start the API in development mode:

```bash
bun run dev
```

The API listens on `http://localhost:5000` by default. Check its health at
`http://localhost:5000/api/health`. The frontend origin defaults to
`http://localhost:3000`; set `CLIENT_ORIGIN` in the root `.env` if it differs.

Authentication is provided by `/api/auth/register`, `/api/auth/login`,
`/api/auth/me`, and `/api/auth/logout`. Sessions use an HTTP-only cookie.

For a non-watch start:

```bash
bun run start
```

Type-check the backend:

```bash
bun run typecheck
```

The explicit database configuration and seed scripts are available as
`bun run db:setup` and `bun run db:seed`. The seed script inserts sample records
only when they do not already exist; it does not overwrite existing records.

To set a password for an administrator that is already explicitly marked as an
administrator in `basketball_reservation`, provide that account's email and
staff ID together with a private password, then run `bun run admin:provision`
from this directory. For PowerShell, enter the password without echoing it:

```powershell
$env:ADMIN_PROVISION_EMAIL = Read-Host "Authorized administrator email"
$env:ADMIN_PROVISION_STAFF_ID = Read-Host "Authorized staff ID"
$securePassword = Read-Host "New administrator password" -AsSecureString
$env:ADMIN_PROVISION_PASSWORD = [System.Net.NetworkCredential]::new("", $securePassword).Password
bun run admin:provision
Remove-Item Env:ADMIN_PROVISION_EMAIL, Env:ADMIN_PROVISION_STAFF_ID, Env:ADMIN_PROVISION_PASSWORD
Remove-Variable securePassword
```

The script does not create accounts, promote users, overwrite existing
password credentials, or run automatically. It requires the target account to
already have `isAdmin: true` and an administrator/director role, hashes the
password with bcrypt, and updates only that account. Sign in through the normal
login page; the verified backend role opens the administrator dashboard.

[Bun](https://bun.com) is a fast all-in-one JavaScript runtime.

```

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/server/src/db.ts

```
import { MongoClient } from 'mongodb';
import type { Db } from 'mongodb';

const uri = process.env.MONGODB_URI || 'mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/basketball_reservation';
const databaseName = 'basketball_reservation';
const client = new MongoClient(uri);

let db: Db;
let connection: Promise<Db> | undefined;

export async function connectDB(): Promise<Db> {
    if (db) return db;
    if (connection) return connection;

    connection = client.connect()
        .then(() => {
            db = client.db(databaseName);
            console.log(`[Database] Successfully connected to MongoDB: ${db.databaseName}`);
            return db;
        })
        .catch((error: unknown) => {
            connection = undefined;
            console.error(
                '[Database] Connection failed:',
                error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown error'
            );
            throw error;
        });

    return connection;
}
```

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/server/src/index.ts

```
import './env';
import express from 'express';
import type { ErrorRequestHandler, Request, Response } from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import { connectDB } from './db';
import authRoutes from './routes/auth';

const app = express();
const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT || 5000);
const allowedOrigins = new Set([
    'http://localhost:3000',
    'http://127.0.0.1:3000',
    ...(process.env.CLIENT_ORIGIN || '')
        .split(',')
        .map(origin => origin.trim())
        .filter(Boolean)
]);

app.use(cors({
    credentials: true,
    origin(origin, callback) {
        if (!origin || allowedOrigins.has(origin)) {
            callback(null, true);
            return;
        }
        callback(new Error('Not allowed by CORS'));
    }
}));
app.use(express.json({ limit: '16kb' }));

app.use('/api/auth', authRoutes);

app.get('/api/health', async (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    try {
        const db = await connectDB();
        await db.command({ ping: 1 });
        res.status(200).json({
            status: 'success',
            message: 'Server is running',
            database: 'connected',
            databaseName: db.databaseName
        });
    } catch {
        console.error('[Health] MongoDB ping failed.');
        res.status(503).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Server is running, but database connection failed'
        });
    }
});

const errorHandler: ErrorRequestHandler = (error: unknown, _req, res, _next) => {
    const errorType = typeof error === 'object' && error !== null && 'type' in error
        ? error.type
        : undefined;
    const status = errorType === 'entity.parse.failed'
        ? 400
        : errorType === 'entity.too.large'
            ? 413
            : error instanceof Error && error.message === 'Not allowed by CORS'
                ? 403
                : 500;
    const message = status === 400
        ? 'Request body must contain valid JSON.'
        : status === 413
            ? 'Request body is too large.'
            : status === 403
                ? 'Request origin is not allowed.'
                : 'Internal server error.';

    console.error(`[Server] Request failed with status ${status}.`);
    res.status(status).json({ status: 'error', message });
};

app.use(errorHandler);

app.listen(PORT, async () => {
    console.log(`[Server] Running at http://localhost:${PORT}`);
    try {
        await connectDB();
    } catch {
        console.warn('[Server] Warning: Failed to connect to the configured database.');
    }
});

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/server/src/routes/auth.ts

```
import { Router } from 'express';
import type { Request, Response } from 'express';
import { ObjectId, MongoServerError } from 'mongodb';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import * as jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';
import { connectDB } from '../db';

const router = Router();
const SESSION_COOKIE = 'basketball_session';
const SESSION_MAX_AGE = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function getJwtSecret(): string {
    const secret = process.env.JWT_SECRET;
    if (!secret) {
        throw new Error('JWT_SECRET must be set in the workspace root .env file.');
    }
    return secret;
}

const JWT_SECRET = getJwtSecret();

interface UserProfile {
    uid: string;
    name: string;
    studentId: string;
    email: string;
    role: string;
    eligibility: string;
    avatarUrl: string;
    isAdmin: boolean;
}

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function isValidEmail(value: string): boolean {
    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(value);
}

function isValidUniversityEmail(value: string): boolean {
    return isValidEmail(value) && value.endsWith('.edu');
}

function isValidName(value: string): boolean {
    return value.length >= 2
        && value.length <= 100
        && /^[\p{L}\p{M}]+(?:[ .'\u2019-][\p{L}\p{M}]+)*\.?$/u.test(value);
}

function getSessionToken(request: Request): string | undefined {
    const cookieHeader = request.headers.cookie;
    if (!cookieHeader) return undefined;

    for (const cookie of cookieHeader.split(';')) {
        const separator = cookie.indexOf('=');
        if (separator < 0) continue;
        if (cookie.slice(0, separator).trim() === SESSION_COOKIE) {
            return cookie.slice(separator + 1).trim();
        }
    }
    return undefined;
}

function getProfile(uid: string, user: Record<string, unknown>): UserProfile {
    return {
        uid,
        name: typeof user.name === 'string' ? user.name : '',
        studentId: typeof user.studentId === 'string' ? user.studentId : '',
        email: typeof user.email === 'string' ? user.email : '',
        role: typeof user.role === 'string' ? user.role : 'Student Member',
        eligibility: typeof user.eligibility === 'string' ? user.eligibility : '',
        avatarUrl: typeof user.avatarUrl === 'string' ? user.avatarUrl : '',
        isAdmin: user.isAdmin === true
    };
}

function setSessionCookie(response: Response, userId: string): void {
    const token = jwt.sign({ sub: userId }, JWT_SECRET, { expiresIn: '24h' });
    response.cookie(SESSION_COOKIE, token, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        sameSite: 'lax',
        maxAge: SESSION_MAX_AGE,
        path: '/api/auth'
    });
}

function clearSessionCookie(response: Response): void {
    response.clearCookie(SESSION_COOKIE, {
        httpOnly: true,
        secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
        sameSite: 'lax',
        path: '/api/auth'
    });
}

function logAuthFailure(operation: string, error: unknown): void {
    console.error(
        `[Auth API] ${operation} failed:`,
        error instanceof Error ? error.name : 'Unknown error'
    );
}

router.post('/register', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const body: unknown = req.body;
    const errors: Record<string, string> = {};
    const name = isRecord(body) && typeof body.name === 'string' ? body.name.trim() : '';
    const studentId = isRecord(body) && typeof body.studentId === 'string'
        ? body.studentId.trim().toUpperCase()
        : '';
    const email = isRecord(body) && typeof body.email === 'string'
        ? body.email.trim().toLowerCase()
        : '';
    const password = isRecord(body) && typeof body.password === 'string' ? body.password : '';

    if (!isValidName(name)) {
        errors.name = 'Enter a valid name using letters, spaces, apostrophes, or hyphens.';
    }
    if (!/^\d{8}-[A-Z]$/.test(studentId)) {
        errors.studentId = 'Use the format 12345678-A.';
    }
    if (!isValidUniversityEmail(email)) {
        errors.email = 'Enter a valid university .edu email address.';
    }
    if (password.length < 8 || new TextEncoder().encode(password).length > 72) {
        errors.password = 'Password must be 8 to 72 UTF-8 bytes long.';
    }

    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Please correct the highlighted fields.',
            errors
        });
    }

    try {
        const db = await connectDB();
        const users = db.collection('users');
        const existingUser = await users.findOne({
            $or: [{ email }, { studentId }]
        });

        if (existingUser) {
            const duplicateErrors: Record<string, string> = {};
            if (existingUser.email === email) {
                duplicateErrors.email = 'An account with this email already exists.';
            }
            if (existingUser.studentId === studentId) {
                duplicateErrors.studentId = 'An account with this student ID already exists.';
            }
            return res.status(409).json({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'An account with those details already exists.',
                errors: duplicateErrors
            });
        }

        const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);
        const newUser = {
            name,
            studentId,
            email,
            passwordHash,
            role: 'Student Member',
            eligibility: 'Active Full Member',
            avatarUrl: '',
            isAdmin: false
        };
        const result = await users.insertOne(newUser);
        const uid = result.insertedId.toHexString();

        setSessionCookie(res, uid);
        return res.status(201).json({
            status: 'success',
            user: getProfile(uid, newUser)
        });
    } catch (error) {
        if (error instanceof MongoServerError && error.code === 11000) {
            const keys = Object.keys(error.keyPattern ?? {});
            const field = keys.includes('email') ? 'email' : 'studentId';
            return res.status(409).json({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'An account with those details already exists.',
                errors: {
                    [field]: field === 'email'
                        ? 'An account with this email already exists.'
                        : 'An account with this student ID already exists.'
                }
            });
        }
        logAuthFailure('Registration', error);
        return res.status(500).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Unable to create an account right now.'
        });
    }
});

router.post('/login', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const body: unknown = req.body;
    const email = isRecord(body) && typeof body.email === 'string'
        ? body.email.trim().toLowerCase()
        : '';
    const password = isRecord(body) && typeof body.password === 'string' ? body.password : '';

    if (!isValidEmail(email) || password.length === 0) {
        return res.status(400).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Enter a valid email address and password.'
        });
    }

    try {
        const db = await connectDB();
        const user = await db.collection('users').findOne({ email });
        const passwordHash = typeof user?.passwordHash === 'string'
            ? user.passwordHash
            : typeof user?.password === 'string'
                ? user.password
                : undefined;

        if (!user || !passwordHash || !(await bcrypt.compare(password, passwordHash))) {
            return res.status(401).json({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'Invalid email or password.'
            });
        }

        if (
            user.eligibility === 'Suspended'
            || user.eligibility === 'Inactive'
            || user.eligibility === 'Disabled'
        ) {
            return res.status(403).json({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'This account is not currently eligible to sign in.'
            });
        }

        const uid = user._id.toString();
        setSessionCookie(res, uid);
        return res.status(200).json({
            status: 'success',
            user: getProfile(uid, user)
        });
    } catch (error) {
        logAuthFailure('Login', error);
        return res.status(500).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Unable to log in right now.'
        });
    }
});

router.get('/me', async (req: Request, res: Response) => {
    const token = getSessionToken(req);
    if (!token) {
        return res.status(401).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Authentication required.' });
    }

    let userId: string;
    try {
        const payload = jwt.verify(token, JWT_SECRET);
        userId = typeof payload === 'object' && typeof payload.sub === 'string'
            ? payload.sub
            : '';
    } catch {
        clearSessionCookie(res);
        return res.status(401).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Authentication required.' });
    }

    if (!ObjectId.isValid(userId)) {
        clearSessionCookie(res);
        return res.status(401).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Authentication required.' });
    }

    try {
        const db = await connectDB();
        const user = await db.collection('users').findOne({ _id: new ObjectId(userId) });
        if (!user) {
            clearSessionCookie(res);
            return res.status(401).json({ status: 'error', message: 'Authentication required.' });
        }
        if (
            user.eligibility === 'Suspended'
            || user.eligibility === 'Inactive'
            || user.eligibility === 'Disabled'
        ) {
            clearSessionCookie(res);
            return res.status(403).json({
                status: 'error',
                message: 'This account is not currently eligible to sign in.'
            });
        }
        return res.status(200).json({
            status: 'success',
            user: getProfile(userId, user)
        });
    } catch (error) {
        logAuthFailure('Session verification', error);
        return res.status(500).json({
            status: 'error',
            message: 'Unable to verify the session right now.'
        });
    }
});

router.post('/logout', (_req: Request, res: Response) => {
    clearSessionCookie(res);
    return res.status(204).end();
});

export default router;

import '../env';
import bcrypt from 'bcryptjs';
import { connectDB } from '../db';

async function provisionAdmin() {
  const email = process.env.ADMIN_PROVISION_EMAIL?.trim().toLowerCase();
  const staffId = process.env.ADMIN_PROVISION_STAFF_ID?.trim();
  const password = process.env.ADMIN_PROVISION_PASSWORD;

  if (!email || !staffId || !password) {
    throw new Error('Set ADMIN_PROVISION_EMAIL, ADMIN_PROVISION_STAFF_ID, and ADMIN_PROVISION_PASSWORD privately.');
  }
  if (Buffer.byteLength(password, 'utf8') < 12 || Buffer.byteLength(password, 'utf8') > 72) {
    throw new Error('The administrator password must be 12â€“72 UTF-8 bytes.');
  }

  const db = await connectDB();
  const users = db.collection('users');
  const account = await users.findOne({
    email,
    studentId: staffId,
    isAdmin: true,
    role: /admin|director/i,
  });

  if (!account) {
    throw new Error('No matching pre-authorized administrator account was found; no account was changed.');
  }

  const hasPassword = [account.passwordHash, account.password].some(
    value => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0
  );
  if (hasPassword) {
    throw new Error('The authorized account already has a password credential; no account was changed.');
  }

  const passwordHash = await bcrypt.hash(password, 12);
  const result = await users.updateOne(
    {
      _id: account._id,
      email,
      studentId: staffId,
      isAdmin: true,
      role: /admin|director/i,
      $and: [
        { $or: [{ passwordHash: { $exists: false } }, { passwordHash: null }, { passwordHash: '' }] },
        { $or: [{ password: { $exists: false } }, { password: null }, { password: '' }] },
      ],
    },
    { $set: { passwordHash } }
  );

  if (result.modifiedCount !== 1) {
    throw new Error('The administrator account changed during provisioning; no password was set.');
  }

  console.log('[Admin Provisioning] Password set for the pre-authorized administrator account.');
}

provisionAdmin()
  .then(() => process.exit(0))
  .catch((error: unknown) => {
    console.error(
      '[Admin Provisioning] Failed:',
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unexpected error.'
    );
    process.exit(1);
  });

import '../env';
import { connectDB } from '../db';

async function setupDatabase() {
    try {
        const db = await connectDB();
        console.log('[Setup] Starting database configuration...');

        const existingCollections = await db.listCollections().toArray();
        const collectionNames = existingCollections.map(c => c.name);

        // 1. Users Collection
        if (!collectionNames.includes('users')) await db.createCollection('users');
        await db.command({
            collMod: 'users',
            validator: {
                $jsonSchema: {
                    bsonType: 'object',
                    required: ['name', 'studentId', 'email', 'role', 'eligibility'],
                    properties: {
                        name: { bsonType: 'string', minLength: 1 },
                        studentId: { bsonType: 'string', minLength: 1 },
                        email: { bsonType: 'string', pattern: '^.+@.+\\..+$' },
                        role: { bsonType: 'string' },
                        eligibility: { bsonType: 'string' },
                        isAdmin: { bsonType: 'bool' }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        await db.collection('users').createIndex({ email: 1 }, { unique: true });
        await db.collection('users').createIndex({ studentId: 1 }, { unique: true });
        console.log('[Setup] Users collection and indexes configured.');

        // 2. Courts Collection
        if (!collectionNames.includes('courts')) await db.createCollection('courts');
        await db.command({
            collMod: 'courts',
            validator: {
                $jsonSchema: {
                    bsonType: 'object',
                    required: ['name', 'type', 'status'],
                    properties: {
                        name: { bsonType: 'string' },
                        type: { enum: ['basketball', 'volleyball'] },
                        status: { enum: ['Available', 'Reserved', 'Maintenance', 'Closed'] }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        await db.collection('courts').createIndex({ name: 1 }, { unique: true });
        console.log('[Setup] Courts collection configured.');

        // 3. Equipment Collection (Enforces Phase 5: No negative inventory)
        if (!collectionNames.includes('equipment')) await db.createCollection('equipment');
        await db.command({
            collMod: 'equipment',
            validator: {
                $jsonSchema: {
                    bsonType: 'object',
                    required: ['name', 'availableStock', 'totalStock'],
                    properties: {
                        name: { bsonType: 'string' },
                        availableStock: { bsonType: 'int', minimum: 0 },
                        totalStock: { bsonType: 'int', minimum: 0 },
                        loanedStock: { bsonType: 'int', minimum: 0 }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        await db.collection('equipment').createIndex({ name: 1 }, { unique: true });
        console.log('[Setup] Equipment collection configured.');

        // 4. Reservations Collection
        if (!collectionNames.includes('reservations')) await db.createCollection('reservations');
        await db.command({
            collMod: 'reservations',
            validator: {
                $jsonSchema: {
                    bsonType: 'object',
                    required: ['courtName', 'isoDate', 'timeSlot', 'studentId', 'status'],
                    properties: {
                        isoDate: { bsonType: 'string', pattern: '^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$' }, // Enforces YYYY-MM-DD
                        status: { enum: ['Confirmed', 'Pending Confirmation', 'In Progress', 'Completed', 'Cancelled by User', 'Blocked / Varsity'] },
                        equipmentDetails: {
                            bsonType: 'array',
                            items: {
                                bsonType: 'object',
                                required: ['name', 'qty'],
                                properties: { qty: { bsonType: 'int', minimum: 0 } }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
        // Index to help prevent double booking (Phase 4 concurrency protection)
        await db.collection('reservations').createIndex({ courtName: 1, isoDate: 1, timeSlot: 1 });
        await db.collection('reservations').createIndex({ studentId: 1 });
        console.log('[Setup] Reservations collection and indexes configured.');

        console.log('[Setup] Database configuration complete!');
        process.exit(0);
    } catch (error) {
        console.error('[Setup] Error configuring database:', error);
        process.exit(1);
    }
}

setupDatabase();

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/App.tsx

```
/**
 * @license
 * SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 */

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { ViewTab, UserProfile, Reservation, BookingHistoryRecord, CourtOption, EquipmentLoanItem, StudentMember } from './types';
import {
  INITIAL_ACTIVE_RESERVATION,
  INITIAL_HISTORY_RECORDS,
  INITIAL_ALL_RESERVATIONS,
  COURTS_DATA,
  INITIAL_EQUIPMENT,
  INITIAL_STUDENTS,
} from './data/initialData';
import {
  fetchFirestoreReservations,
  saveFirestoreReservation,
  updateFirestoreReservation,
  fetchFirestoreCourts,
  updateFirestoreCourt,
  saveFirestoreUserProfile,
  fetchFirestoreEquipment,
  updateFirestoreEquipment,
  fetchFirestoreStudents,
  updateFirestoreStudent,
  deriveBookingHistory,
  checkLocalBookingConflict,
} from './lib/firestoreService';
import { getCurrentUser, logoutUser } from './lib/authService';
import { ApiError } from './lib/apiClient';
import { testFirestoreConnection } from './lib/firebase';
import { Header } from './components/Header';
import { Footer } from './components/Footer';
import { AuthScreen } from './components/AuthScreen';
import { DashboardScreen } from './components/DashboardScreen';
import { ReservationFlowScreen } from './components/ReservationFlowScreen';
import { SchedulesBookingsScreen } from './components/SchedulesBookingsScreen';
import { AdminDashboardScreen } from './components/AdminDashboardScreen';
import { DigitalPassModal } from './components/modals/DigitalPassModal';
import { EditReservationModal } from './components/modals/EditReservationModal';
import { CancelReservationModal } from './components/modals/CancelReservationModal';
import { AvailabilityCalendarModal } from './components/modals/AvailabilityCalendarModal';
import { EditProfileModal } from './components/modals/EditProfileModal';
import { AdminReserveCourtModal } from './components/modals/AdminReserveCourtModal';
import { GatepassCheckerModal } from './components/modals/GatepassCheckerModal';
import { AdminTab } from './types';

export default function App() {
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState<ViewTab>('auth');
  const [adminSubTab, setAdminSubTab] = useState<AdminTab>('overview');
  const [user, setUser] = useState<UserProfile | null>(null);
  const [isCheckingSession, setIsCheckingSession] = useState(true);
  const [sessionError, setSessionError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [activeReservation, setActiveReservation] = useState<Reservation | null>(
    INITIAL_ACTIVE_RESERVATION
  );
  const [historyRecords, setHistoryRecords] = useState<BookingHistoryRecord[]>(
    INITIAL_HISTORY_RECORDS
  );

  // Admin and Facility State
  const [allReservations, setAllReservations] = useState<Reservation[]>(INITIAL_ALL_RESERVATIONS);
  const [courts, setCourts] = useState<CourtOption[]>(COURTS_DATA);
  const [equipment, setEquipment] = useState<EquipmentLoanItem[]>(INITIAL_EQUIPMENT);
  const [students, setStudents] = useState<StudentMember[]>(INITIAL_STUDENTS);

  // Reservation Flow configuration
  const [reserveSportType, setReserveSportType] = useState<'basketball' | 'volleyball'>('basketball');
  const [reserveFocusEquipment, setReserveFocusEquipment] = useState<boolean>(false);

  // Schedules / Bookings sub-tab
  const [schedulesSubTab, setSchedulesSubTab] = useState<'active' | 'history'>('active');

  // Modals state
  const [isPassModalOpen, setIsPassModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCancelModalOpen, setIsCancelModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isCalendarModalOpen, setIsCalendarModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isEditProfileOpen, setIsEditProfileOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isAdminReserveOpen, setIsAdminReserveOpen] = useState(false);
  const [isGatepassCheckerOpen, setIsGatepassCheckerOpen] = useState(false);

  // Toast notification state
  const [toastMessage, setToastMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    async function restoreSession() {
      try {
        const sessionUser = await getCurrentUser();
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setUser(sessionUser);
        setCurrentTab(sessionUser ? (sessionUser.isAdmin ? 'admin' : 'dashboard') : 'auth');
        setSessionError(null);
      } catch (error) {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        setUser(null);
        setCurrentTab('auth');
        setSessionError(
          error instanceof ApiError && error.status === 404
            ? 'The running backend needs to be restarted to enable secure sessions.'
            : error instanceof Error
              ? error.message
              : 'Unable to check the sign-in session.'
        );
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setIsCheckingSession(false);
      }
    }

    void restoreSession();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Initialize Firestore connection and sync data for authenticated users.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    const activeUser = user;
    let isMounted = true;
    async function initFirestore() {
      try {
        await testFirestoreConnection();
        const loadedReservations = await fetchFirestoreReservations();
        const loadedCourts = await fetchFirestoreCourts();
        const loadedEquipment = await fetchFirestoreEquipment();
        const loadedStudents = await fetchFirestoreStudents();

        if (isMounted) {
          if (loadedReservations && loadedReservations.length > 0) {
            setAllReservations(loadedReservations);
            // If active reservation exists in loaded list for current user
            const foundActive = loadedReservations.find(
              r => (r.status === 'Confirmed' || r.status === 'In Progress') &&
                   (activeUser.isAdmin || r.studentId === activeUser.studentId)
            );
            if (foundActive) {
              setActiveReservation(foundActive);
            }

            // Derive dynamic history for current user
            const dynamicHistory = deriveBookingHistory(loadedReservations, activeUser.studentId);
            if (dynamicHistory && dynamicHistory.length > 0) {
              setHistoryRecords(dynamicHistory);
            }
          }
          if (loadedCourts && loadedCourts.length > 0) {
            setCourts(loadedCourts);
          }
          if (loadedEquipment && loadedEquipment.length > 0) {
            setEquipment(loadedEquipment);
          }
          if (loadedStudents && loadedStudents.length > 0) {
            setStudents(loadedStudents);
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn('Firestore initialization notice:', err);
      }
    }
    initFirestore();
    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [user?.studentId]);

  const showToast = (msg: string) => {
    setToastMessage(msg);
    setTimeout(() => {
      setToastMessage(null);
    }, 3500);
  };

  const handleLoginSuccess = (newUser: UserProfile) => {
    setUser(newUser);
    setSessionError(null);
    if (newUser.isAdmin) {
      setCurrentTab('admin');
      showToast(`Welcome Director ${newUser.name}! Facilities Management Desk open.`);
    } else {
      setCurrentTab('dashboard');
      showToast(`Welcome back, ${newUser.name}! Directory access authenticated.`);
    }
  };

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    try {
      await logoutUser();
      setUser(null);
      setCurrentTab('auth');
      showToast('Signed out of your account.');
    } catch (error) {
      showToast(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unable to sign out right now.');
    }
  };

  const handleConfirmNewBooking = async (newRes: Reservation) => {
    // 1. Conflict check
    const conflict = checkLocalBookingConflict(
      allReservations,
      newRes.courtName,
      newRes.isoDate,
      newRes.timeSlot
    );
    if (conflict) {
      showToast(`Conflict detected: ${newRes.courtName} already booked for ${newRes.timeSlot}!`);
      return;
    }

    // 2. Decrement equipment stock if requested
    if (newRes.equipmentDetails && newRes.equipmentDetails.length > 0) {
      for (const eq of newRes.equipmentDetails) {
        const item = equipment.find(
          e => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(eq.name.toLowerCase()) || eq.name.toLowerCase().includes(e.name.toLowerCase())
        );
        if (item) {
          handleUpdateEquipmentStock(item.id, -eq.qty, 0);
        }
      }
    }

    setActiveReservation(newRes);
    setAllReservations(prev => [newRes, ...prev]);
    try {
      await saveFirestoreReservation(newRes);
      showToast(`Reservation confirmed for ${newRes.courtName}! Keycard pass ready.`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore save notice:', err);
      showToast(`Reservation confirmed for ${newRes.courtName}!`);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveEditReservation = async (updated: Partial<Reservation>) => {
    if (!activeReservation) return;
    const merged = { ...activeReservation, ...updated };

    if (
      updated.courtName !== undefined ||
      updated.isoDate !== undefined ||
      updated.timeSlot !== undefined
    ) {
      const conflict = checkLocalBookingConflict(
        allReservations,
        merged.courtName,
        merged.isoDate,
        merged.timeSlot,
        merged.id
      );
      if (conflict) {
        showToast('Reschedule Conflict: That slot is already booked.');
        return;
      }
    }

    setActiveReservation(merged);
    setAllReservations(prev => prev.map(r => (r.id === merged.id ? merged : r)));
    try {
      await updateFirestoreReservation(merged.id, updated);
      showToast(`Reservation updated for ${merged.courtName}`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore update notice:', err);
      showToast(`Reservation updated for ${merged.courtName}`);
    }
    setIsEditModalOpen(false);
  };

  const handleConfirmCancelReservation = async () => {
    if (!activeReservation) return;

    // Restore equipment stock if applicable
    if (activeReservation.equipmentDetails && activeReservation.equipmentDetails.length > 0) {
      for (const eq of activeReservation.equipmentDetails) {
        const item = equipment.find(
          e => e.name.toLowerCase().includes(eq.name.toLowerCase()) || eq.name.toLowerCase().includes(e.name.toLowerCase())
        );
        if (item) {
          handleUpdateEquipmentStock(item.id, eq.qty, 0);
        }
      }
    }

    const cancelledRecord: BookingHistoryRecord = {
      id: `hist-${Date.now()}`,
      courtName: activeReservation.courtName,
      courtType: activeReservation.courtName.includes('Volleyball') ? 'Volleyball' : 'Basketball',
      date: activeReservation.dateStr || 'Today, Oct 24, 2025',
      timeSlot: activeReservation.timeSlot,
      equipmentRequested: activeReservation.equipmentSummary || 'None',
      status: 'Cancelled by User',
    };

    setHistoryRecords(prev => [cancelledRecord, ...prev]);
    setAllReservations(prev =>
      prev.map(r => (r.id === activeReservation.id ? { ...r, status: 'Cancelled by User' } : r))
    );
    try {
      await updateFirestoreReservation(activeReservation.id, { status: 'Cancelled by User' });
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn('Firestore cancel notice:', err);
    }
    setActiveReservation(null);
    setIsCancelModalOpen(false);
    showToast('Reservation cancelled. Slot has been released to varsity timetable.');
  };

  // Admin Handlers
  const handleUpdateReservationStatus = (
    id: string,
    newStatus: Reservation['status'],
    isCheckedIn?: boolean
  ) => {
    setAllReservations(prev =>
      prev.map(r => {
        if (r.id === id) {
          return {
            ...r,
            status: newStatus,
            isCheckedIn: isCheckedIn !== undefined ? isCheckedIn : r.isCheckedIn,
          };
        }
        return r;
      })
    );

    updateFirestoreReservation(id, {
      status: newStatus,
      ...(isCheckedIn !== undefined ? { isCheckedIn } : {}),
    });

    if (activeReservation?.id === id) {
      setActiveReservation(prev => (prev ? { ...prev, status: newStatus, isCheckedIn: !!isCheckedIn } : null));
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateCourtStatus = (
    courtId: string,
    newStatus: CourtOption['status'],
    maintenanceNote?: string
  ) => {
    setCourts(prev =>
      prev.map(c => {
        if (c.id === courtId) {
          return {
            ...c,
            status: newStatus,
            maintenanceNote: maintenanceNote !== undefined ? maintenanceNote : c.maintenanceNote,
          };
        }
        return c;
      })
    );
    updateFirestoreCourt(courtId, newStatus, maintenanceNote);
  };

  const handleUpdateEquipmentStock = (eqId: string, deltaAvailable: number, deltaTotal = 0) => {
    setEquipment(prev =>
      prev.map(item => {
        if (item.id === eqId) {
          const newAvail = Math.max(0, item.availableStock + deltaAvailable);
          const newTotal = (item.totalStock || item.availableStock) + deltaTotal;
          updateFirestoreEquipment(eqId, {
            availableStock: newAvail,
            totalStock: newTotal,
          }).catch(err => console.warn('Equipment update note:', err));
          return {
            ...item,
            availableStock: newAvail,
            totalStock: newTotal,
          };
        }
        return item;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleToggleStudentEligibility = (studentId: string) => {
    setStudents(prev =>
      prev.map(stu => {
        if (stu.id === studentId) {
          const isSuspended = stu.eligibility === 'Suspended';
          const newEligibility = isSuspended ? 'Active Full Member' : 'Suspended';
          updateFirestoreStudent(stu.id, {
            eligibility: newEligibility as StudentMember['eligibility'],
          }).catch(err => console.warn('Student eligibility note:', err));
          return {
            ...stu,
            eligibility: newEligibility as StudentMember['eligibility'],
          };
        }
        return stu;
      })
    );
  };

  const handleAddNewReservation = (newRes: Reservation) => {
    setAllReservations(prev => [newRes, ...prev]);
    saveFirestoreReservation(newRes);
  };

  const handleNavigateToReserve = (
    sport: 'basketball' | 'volleyball' = 'basketball',
    focusEquipment = false
  ) => {
    setReserveSportType(sport);
    setReserveFocusEquipment(focusEquipment);
    setCurrentTab('reservations');
    if (focusEquipment) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        document.getElementById('equipment-section')?.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' });
      }, 100);
    }
  };

  const handleBookFromCalendar = (courtName: string, timeSlot: string) => {
    setIsCalendarModalOpen(false);
    setReserveSportType(courtName.toLowerCase().includes('volleyball') ? 'volleyball' : 'basketball');
    setCurrentTab('reservations');
    showToast(`Selected ${courtName} (${timeSlot}). Choose equipment and confirm.`);
  };

  const visibleTab = currentTab === 'admin' && !user?.isAdmin ? 'dashboard' : currentTab;

  if (isCheckingSession) {
    return (
      <main className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center bg-[#f5faff] text-[#2d4055]">
        <p role="status" className="text-sm font-semibold">Checking your sign-in sessionâ€¦</p>
      </main>
    );
  }

  if (!user || currentTab === 'auth') {
    return (
      <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#f5faff]">
        <AuthScreen onLoginSuccess={handleLoginSuccess} systemError={sessionError} />
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-[#f5faff] text-[#111d24]">
      {/* Fixed Header */}
      <Header
        currentTab={visibleTab}
        onSelectTab={(tab) => {
          if (tab === 'booking-history') {
            setSchedulesSubTab('history');
            setCurrentTab('booking-history');
          } else if (tab === 'reservations') {
            setCurrentTab('reservations');
          } else if (tab === 'admin') {
            if (user.isAdmin) setCurrentTab('admin');
          } else {
            setCurrentTab('dashboard');
          }
        }}
        user={user}
        onLogout={handleLogout}
        onOpenPass={() => setIsPassModalOpen(true)}
        onOpenEditProfile={() => setIsEditProfileOpen(true)}
        adminSubTab={adminSubTab}
        onSelectAdminSubTab={(tab) => {
          if (!user.isAdmin) return;
          setAdminSubTab(tab);
          setCurrentTab('admin');
        }}
        onOpenGatepassChecker={() => {
          if (user.isAdmin) setIsGatepassCheckerOpen(true);
        }}
        onOpenAdminReserveModal={() => {
          if (user.isAdmin) setIsAdminReserveOpen(true);
        }}
      />

      {/* Main Content View with top offset for fixed navbar */}
      <main className="w-full pt-16 flex-1 bg-[#f5faff] pb-12">
        {visibleTab === 'dashboard' && (
          <DashboardScreen
            user={user}
            activeReservation={activeReservation}
            onNavigateToReserve={handleNavigateToReserve}
            onNavigateToReservationsTab={() => {
              setSchedulesSubTab('active');
              setCurrentTab('booking-history');
            }}
            onNavigateToHistoryTab={() => {
              setSchedulesSubTab('history');
              setCurrentTab('booking-history');
            }}
            onOpenCalendarModal={() => setIsCalendarModalOpen(true)}
            onOpenPassModal={() => setIsPassModalOpen(true)}
            onOpenEditProfile={() => setIsEditProfileOpen(true)}
          />
        )}

        {visibleTab === 'reservations' && (
          <ReservationFlowScreen
            user={user}
            initialSport={reserveSportType}
            focusEquipment={reserveFocusEquipment}
            onConfirmBooking={handleConfirmNewBooking}
            onOpenPassModal={() => setIsPassModalOpen(true)}
            courts={courts}
            reservations={allReservations}
          />
        )}

        {visibleTab === 'booking-history' && (
          <SchedulesBookingsScreen
            user={user}
            activeReservation={activeReservation}
            historyRecords={historyRecords}
            initialSubTab={schedulesSubTab}
            onEditReservation={() => setIsEditModalOpen(true)}
            onCancelReservation={() => setIsCancelModalOpen(true)}
            onNavigateToReserve={() => handleNavigateToReserve('basketball')}
          />
        )}

        {currentTab === 'admin' && user.isAdmin && (
          <AdminDashboardScreen
            reservations={allReservations}
            courts={courts}
            equipment={equipment}
            students={students}
            user={user}
            activeTab={adminSubTab}
            onTabChange={setAdminSubTab}
            isAdminReserveOpen={isAdminReserveOpen}
            onCloseAdminReserve={() => setIsAdminReserveOpen(false)}
            isGatepassCheckerOpen={isGatepassCheckerOpen}
            onCloseGatepassChecker={() => setIsGatepassCheckerOpen(false)}
            onOpenEditProfile={() => setIsEditProfileOpen(true)}
            onUpdateReservationStatus={handleUpdateReservationStatus}
            onUpdateCourtStatus={handleUpdateCourtStatus}
            onUpdateEquipmentStock={handleUpdateEquipmentStock}
            onToggleStudentEligibility={handleToggleStudentEligibility}
            onAddNewReservation={handleAddNewReservation}
          />
        )}
      </main>

      {/* Footer */}
      <Footer />

      {/* Modals */}
      {isPassModalOpen && activeReservation && (
        <DigitalPassModal
          reservation={activeReservation}
          user={user}
          onClose={() => setIsPassModalOpen(false)}
        />
      )}

      {isEditProfileOpen && (
        <EditProfileModal
          user={user}
          isOpen={isEditProfileOpen}
          onClose={() => setIsEditProfileOpen(false)}
          onSave={(updated) => {
            const merged = { ...user, ...updated };
            setUser(merged);
            saveFirestoreUserProfile(merged);
            showToast('Profile updated successfully.');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {isEditModalOpen && activeReservation && (
        <EditReservationModal
          reservation={activeReservation}
          courts={courts}
          reservations={allReservations}
          onClose={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}
          onSave={handleSaveEditReservation}
        />
      )}

      {isCancelModalOpen && activeReservation && (
        <CancelReservationModal
          reservation={activeReservation}
          onClose={() => setIsCancelModalOpen(false)}
          onConfirm={handleConfirmCancelReservation}
        />
      )}

      {isCalendarModalOpen && (
        <AvailabilityCalendarModal
          courts={courts}
          reservations={allReservations}
          onClose={() => setIsCalendarModalOpen(false)}
          onBookCourt={handleBookFromCalendar}
        />
      )}

      {user.isAdmin && isAdminReserveOpen && (
        <AdminReserveCourtModal
          isOpen={isAdminReserveOpen}
          courts={courts}
          user={user}
          onClose={() => setIsAdminReserveOpen(false)}
          onSaveReservation={(newRes) => {
            handleAddNewReservation(newRes);
            setIsAdminReserveOpen(false);
            showToast(`Admin reservation confirmed for ${newRes.courtName} (${newRes.studentName})`);
          }}
        />
      )}

      {user.isAdmin && isGatepassCheckerOpen && (
        <GatepassCheckerModal
          isOpen={isGatepassCheckerOpen}
          reservations={allReservations}
          onClose={() => setIsGatepassCheckerOpen(false)}
          onValidateCheckIn={(resId) => {
            handleUpdateReservationStatus(resId, 'In Progress', true);
            showToast('Pass checked in successfully!');
          }}
        />
      )}

      {/* Floating System Toast */}
      {toastMessage && (
        <div
          id="toast"
          className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 z-50 transform transition-all duration-300 pointer-events-none"
        >
          <div className="bg-[#2d4055] text-white px-4 py-3 rounded-xl shadow-xl flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xs font-semibold border border-[#44576d]">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#c9e7f8] text-[20px]">
              check_circle
            </span>
            <span id="toast-message">{toastMessage}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
