## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/AuthScreen.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Eye, EyeOff } from 'lucide-react';
import { BasketballLogo } from './BasketballLogo';
import type { UserProfile } from '../types';
import { loginWithEmail, registerWithEmail } from '../lib/authService';
import { ApiError } from '../lib/apiClient';
import {
  getRegistrationErrors,
  isValidEmail,
  isValidName,
  isValidPassword,
  isValidStudentId,
  isValidUniversityEmail
} from '../lib/validation';
import type { AuthField, AuthFieldErrors } from '../lib/validation';

interface AuthScreenProps {
  onLoginSuccess: (user: UserProfile) => void;
  systemError?: string | null;
}

export const AuthScreen: React.FC<AuthScreenProps> = ({ onLoginSuccess, systemError }) => {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'login' | 'register'>('login');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Login form state
  const [loginIdentifier, setLoginIdentifier] = useState('');
  const [loginPassword, setLoginPassword] = useState('');

  // Register form state
  const [regName, setRegName] = useState('');
  const [regId, setRegId] = useState('');
  const [regEmail, setRegEmail] = useState('');
  const [regPassword, setRegPassword] = useState('');
  const [regConfirmPassword, setRegConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showRegPassword, setShowRegPassword] = useState(false);
  const [showRegConfirmPassword, setShowRegConfirmPassword] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<AuthFieldErrors>({});

  // Feedback toast state
  const [feedback, setFeedback] = useState<{
    type: 'success' | 'error';
    message: string;
  } | null>(null);

  const clearFieldError = (field: AuthField, value: string) => {
    const valid = field === 'name'
      ? isValidName(value)
      : field === 'studentId'
        ? isValidStudentId(value)
        : field === 'email'
            ? activeTab === 'register' ? isValidUniversityEmail(value) : isValidEmail(value)
          : field === 'password'
            ? isValidPassword(value)
            : value === regPassword;
    if (!valid) return;

    setFieldErrors(previous => {
      if (!previous[field]) return previous;
      const next = { ...previous };
      delete next[field];
      return next;
    });
  };

  // Password strength calculation
  const getPasswordStrength = (val: string) => {
    if (!val) return { score: 0, label: 'Awaiting input' };
    let score = 0;
    if (val.length >= 8) score++;
    if (/[A-Z]/.test(val)) score++;
    if (/[0-9]/.test(val)) score++;
    if (/[^A-Za-z0-9]/.test(val)) score++;

    if (score <= 1) return { score: 1, label: 'Low Resilience' };
    if (score === 2) return { score: 2, label: 'Moderate' };
    return { score: Math.min(4, score), label: 'Institutional Standard' };
  };

  const strength = getPasswordStrength(regPassword);

  const handleLoginSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const errors: AuthFieldErrors = {};
    if (!isValidEmail(loginIdentifier)) {
      errors.email = 'Enter a valid email address.';
    }
    if (!loginPassword) {
      errors.password = 'Enter your password.';
    }
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    setFeedback(null);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const userProfile = await loginWithEmail(loginIdentifier.trim(), loginPassword);
      onLoginSuccess(userProfile);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError) {
        setFieldErrors({
          email: error.fieldErrors.email,
          password: error.fieldErrors.password,
          name: error.fieldErrors.name,
          studentId: error.fieldErrors.studentId,
          confirmPassword: error.fieldErrors.confirmPassword
        });
      }
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Login failed. Please try again.'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleRegisterSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const errors = getRegistrationErrors(regName, regId, regEmail, regPassword, regConfirmPassword);
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    setFeedback(null);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    setIsLoading(true);
    try {
      const userProfile = await registerWithEmail(regName, regId, regEmail, regPassword);
      onLoginSuccess(userProfile);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof ApiError) {
        setFieldErrors({
          email: error.fieldErrors.email,
          password: error.fieldErrors.password,
          name: error.fieldErrors.name,
          studentId: error.fieldErrors.studentId,
          confirmPassword: error.fieldErrors.confirmPassword
        });
      }
      setFeedback({
        type: 'error',
        message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Registration failed. Please try again.'
      });
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <main className="w-full min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-10 bg-[#f5faff]">
      <div className="flex flex-col w-full max-w-6xl mx-auto my-auto">
        <div className="relative w-full rounded-2xl overflow-hidden bg-[#e9f5ff] shadow-xl p-4 sm:p-6 lg:p-10 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
          {/* Ambient Decorative Blurs */}
          <div className="absolute -top-24 -right-24 w-96 h-96 rounded-full bg-[#c9e7f8]/40 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />
          <div className="absolute -bottom-24 -left-24 w-96 h-96 rounded-full bg-[#d0e4ff]/30 blur-3xl pointer-events-none" />

          <div className="relative grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 lg:gap-8 items-stretch">
            {/* Left Column: Institutional Brand & Facility Stats */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-5 flex flex-col justify-between bg-white/85 backdrop-blur-md p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-[#ddeaf3]/70">
              <div className="flex flex-col space-y-4">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                  <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#2d4055] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-sm overflow-hidden p-1.5 shrink-0">
                    <BasketballLogo className="w-full h-full" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#466271] uppercase tracking-widest">
                      Athletic Facilities Board
                    </span>
                    <span className="font-headline text-lg font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
                      Varsity Court Portal
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-2">
                  <h1 className="font-headline text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] leading-tight">
                    Basketball Court Reservation Web System
                  </h1>
                  <p className="text-sm text-[#466271] mt-2 leading-relaxed">
                    Official university athletic facility booking portal for indoor basketball courts, volleyball courts, and equipment lending.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Sports and booking services */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
                  <div className="bg-[#e3f0f9] p-3 rounded-lg flex flex-col justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[#2d4055] text-xs font-semibold">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">sports_basketball</span>
                      <span>Basketball</span>
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] mt-0.5">Court reservations</span>

                  <div className="bg-[#e3f0f9] p-3 rounded-lg flex flex-col justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                    <div className="flex items-center space-x-1.5 text-[#2d4055] text-xs font-semibold">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">sports_volleyball</span>

                    </div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] mt-0.5">Court reservations</span>
                  </div>

                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider text-[#2d4055] font-bold">

                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right Column: Frosted Auth Card Container with Tabs */}

              <div>
                {/* Segmented Tab Navigation */}
                <div className="flex p-1 bg-[#e3f0f9] rounded-lg mb-6 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                  <button

                        ? 'bg-[#44576d] text-white shadow-sm'

                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">login</span>

                  </button>

                  <button
                    id="tab-register"
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      setActiveTab('register');
                      setFeedback(null);
                    }}
                    className={`flex-1 py-2 text-center text-sm font-semibold rounded-md transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 ${
                      activeTab === 'register'
                        ? 'bg-[#44576d] text-white shadow-sm'
                        : 'text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">person_add</span>
                    Create Account
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Log In Form View */}
                {activeTab === 'login' && (
                  <div className="flex flex-col space-y-4" id="view-login">
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <h2 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055]">
                        Sign in to your account
                      </h2>
                      <p className="text-sm text-[#466271] mt-1">
                        Provide your verified institutional credentials to manage reservations.
                      </p>
                    </div>

                    <form className="space-y-4 pt-1" onSubmit={handleLoginSubmit}>
                      <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">

                        <div className="relative flex items-center">

                          />

                        {fieldErrors.email && (

                            {fieldErrors.email}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#344048]" htmlFor="login-password">

                        </div>
                        <div className="relative flex items-center">
                          <span className="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 text-[#466271] text-lg pointer-events-none">
                            lock
                          </span>
                          <input
                            id="login-password"
                            value={loginPassword}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              setLoginPassword(e.target.value);
                              clearFieldError('password', e.target.value);
                              setFeedback(null);
                            }}
                            placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
                            required
                            type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                            aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.password)}
                            aria-describedby={fieldErrors.password ? 'login-password-error' : undefined}
                            className={`w-full h-10 pl-10 pr-10 bg-white text-[#111d24] text-sm rounded-lg border ${
                              fieldErrors.password ? 'border-[#ba1a1a]' : 'border-[#c4c6cd]'
                            } focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#44576d] focus:border-transparent outline-none shadow-xs transition-all`}
                          />
                          <button
                            type="button"

                            </span>

                        </div>
                        {fieldErrors.password && (
                          <p id="login-password-error" className="text-xs text-[#ba1a1a]" role="alert">
                            {fieldErrors.password}
                          </p>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <button
                        id="btn-login-submit"
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        className="w-full h-11 bg-[#44576d] hover:bg-[#2d4055] disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-wait text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c9e7f8] focus:ring-offset-2 mt-4 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span>{isLoading ? 'Signing inâ€¦' : 'Log In'}</span>

                      <div className="text-center pt-2">

                              required

                              aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.studentId)}
                              aria-describedby={fieldErrors.studentId ? 'reg-id-error' : 'reg-id-hint'}
                              className={`w-full h-10 pl-10 pr-3 bg-white text-[#111d24] text-sm rounded-lg border ${

                              } focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#44576d] outline-none shadow-xs font-mono`}

                          </div>
                          {fieldErrors.studentId ? (
                            <p id="reg-id-error" className="text-xs text-[#ba1a1a]" role="alert">

                      </div>

                      <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">

                          className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#344048] flex justify-between"

                          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#74777d]">Use your university .edu address</span>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">

                          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#344048]" htmlFor="reg-password">
                            Account Password

                          <div className="relative flex items-center">
                            <span className="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 text-[#466271] text-lg pointer-events-none">
                              lock_open

                              id="reg-password"
                              value={regPassword}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                setRegPassword(e.target.value);
                                clearFieldError('password', e.target.value);
                                if (e.target.value === regConfirmPassword) {
                                  setFieldErrors(previous => {
                                    if (!previous.confirmPassword) return previous;
                                    const next = { ...previous };
                                    delete next.confirmPassword;
                                    return next;
                                  });
                                }
                                setFeedback(null);
                              }}
                              placeholder="8 to 72 bytes"
                              required
                              type={showRegPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}

                            >
                              {showRegPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Eye size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          {fieldErrors.password && (
                            <p id="reg-password-error" className="text-xs text-[#ba1a1a]" role="alert">
                              {fieldErrors.password}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        <div className="flex flex-col space-y-1">
                          <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#344048]" htmlFor="reg-confirm-password">
                            Confirm Password
                          </label>
                          <div className="relative flex items-center">
                            <span className="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 text-[#466271] text-lg pointer-events-none">
                              check_circle
                            </span>
                            <input
                              id="reg-confirm-password"
                              value={regConfirmPassword}
                              onChange={(e) => {
                                setRegConfirmPassword(e.target.value);
                                clearFieldError('confirmPassword', e.target.value);
                                setFeedback(null);
                              }}
                              placeholder="Repeat password"
                              required

                              aria-invalid={Boolean(fieldErrors.confirmPassword)}
                              aria-describedby={fieldErrors.confirmPassword ? 'reg-confirm-password-error' : undefined}
                              className={`w-full h-10 pl-10 pr-10 bg-white text-[#111d24] text-sm rounded-lg border ${
                                fieldErrors.confirmPassword ? 'border-[#ba1a1a]' : 'border-[#c4c6cd]'
                              } focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#44576d] outline-none shadow-xs`}
                            />
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              onClick={() => setShowRegConfirmPassword(visible => !visible)}
                              aria-label={`${showRegConfirmPassword ? 'Hide' : 'Show'} confirm password`}
                              aria-pressed={showRegConfirmPassword}
                              className="absolute right-2 p-1 text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-[#44576d] rounded"
                            >
                              {showRegConfirmPassword ? <EyeOff size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Eye size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}
                            </button>
                          </div>
                          {fieldErrors.confirmPassword && (
                            <p id="reg-confirm-password-error" className="text-xs text-[#ba1a1a]" role="alert">
                              {fieldErrors.confirmPassword}
                            </p>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* Password Security Meter */}
                      <div className="p-3 bg-[#e3f0f9] rounded-lg flex flex-col space-y-1.5 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                          <span className="text-[#466271]">Password Security Meter</span>
                          <span
                            className={`font-semibold ${
                              strength.score === 0
                                ? 'text-[#74777d]'
                                : strength.score === 1
                                ? 'text-[#ba1a1a]'
                                : strength.score === 2
                                ? 'text-[#466271]'
                                : 'text-[#2d4055]'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {strength.label}
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="w-full h-1.5 bg-[#ddeaf3] rounded-full overflow-hidden flex gap-0.5">
                          <div
                            className={`h-full w-1/4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                              strength.score >= 1
                                ? strength.score === 1
                                  ? 'bg-[#ba1a1a]'
                                  : 'bg-[#44576d]'
                                : 'bg-[#c4c6cd]'
                            }`}
                          />
                          <div
                            className={`h-full w-1/4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                              strength.score >= 2 ? 'bg-[#44576d]' : 'bg-[#c4c6cd]'
                            }`}
                          />
                          <div
                            className={`h-full w-1/4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                              strength.score >= 3 ? 'bg-[#44576d]' : 'bg-[#c4c6cd]'
                            }`}
                          />
                          <div
                            className={`h-full w-1/4 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 ${
                              strength.score >= 4 ? 'bg-[#2d4055]' : 'bg-[#c4c6cd]'
                            }`}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-[#74777d]">
                          Use at least 8 characters. Passwords are case-sensitive.
                        </span>
                      </div>

                      <button
                        id="btn-register-submit"
                        type="submit"
                        disabled={isLoading}
                        className="w-full h-11 bg-[#44576d] hover:bg-[#2d4055] disabled:opacity-60 disabled:cursor-wait text-white text-sm font-semibold rounded-lg transition-all flex items-center justify-center space-x-2 shadow-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#c9e7f8] focus:ring-offset-2 mt-2 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">how_to_reg</span>
                        <span>{isLoading ? 'Creating accountâ€¦' : 'Create Account'}</span>
                      </button>

                      <div className="text-center pt-1">
                        <span className="text-xs text-[#466271]">Already have an account? </span>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setActiveTab('login');
                            setFeedback(null);
                          }}
                          className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] hover:underline"
                        >
                          Log In
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </form>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>

              {/* Feedback Message Toast */}
              {feedback && (
                <div
                  id="feedback-alert"
                  className={`mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg flex items-center space-x-2.5 transition-all text-xs font-medium ${
                    feedback.type === 'error'
                      ? 'bg-[#ffdad6] text-[#93000a] border border-[#ffdad6]'
                      : 'bg-[#c9e7f8] text-[#4c6877] border border-[#aecbdc]'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">
                    {feedback.type === 'error' ? 'error' : 'task_alt'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex-1">{feedback.message}</span>
                </div>
              )}
              {systemError && (
                <div
                  className="mt-4 p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#ffdad6] text-[#93000a] border border-[#ffdad6] text-xs font-medium"
                  role="alert"
                >
                  {systemError}
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </main>
  );
};

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/common/DatePicker.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';

interface DatePickerProps {
  value: string; // ISO date 'YYYY-MM-DD'
  onChange: (isoDate: string, formattedLabel: string) => void;
  id?: string;
  minDate?: string;
  className?: string;
}

export const DatePicker: React.FC<DatePickerProps> = ({
  value,
  onChange,
  id = 'unified-date-picker',
  minDate,
  className = '',
}) => {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

  // Parse incoming value
  const initialDate = value ? new Date(value + 'T00:00:00') : new Date();
  const [viewYear, setViewYear] = useState(
    isNaN(initialDate.getTime()) ? new Date().getFullYear() : initialDate.getFullYear()
  );
  const [viewMonth, setViewMonth] = useState(
    isNaN(initialDate.getTime()) ? new Date().getMonth() : initialDate.getMonth()
  );

  // Month names
  const monthNames = [
    'January', 'February', 'March', 'April', 'May', 'June',
    'July', 'August', 'September', 'October', 'November', 'December'
  ];

  // Helper to format ISO to nice label
  const formatLabel = (iso: string) => {
    try {
      const parts = iso.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const d = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          weekday: 'short',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric',
          year: 'numeric',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }
    return iso;
  };

  // Days calculations
  const firstDayOfMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth, 1).getDay(); // 0 is Sunday
  // Convert so Monday is 0, Sunday is 6
  const startOffset = (firstDayOfMonth + 6) % 7;
  const daysInMonth = new Date(viewYear, viewMonth + 1, 0).getDate();

  const handlePrevMonth = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (viewMonth === 0) {
      setViewMonth(11);
      setViewYear((y) => y - 1);
    } else {
      setViewMonth((m) => m - 1);
    }
  };

  const handleNextMonth = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (viewMonth === 11) {
      setViewMonth(0);
      setViewYear((y) => y + 1);
    } else {
      setViewMonth((m) => m + 1);
    }
  };

  const handleSelectDay = (day: number) => {
    const monthStr = String(viewMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0');
    const dayStr = String(day).padStart(2, '0');
    const newIso = `${viewYear}-${monthStr}-${dayStr}`;
    const label = formatLabel(newIso);
    onChange(newIso, label);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  // Active day check
  const isSelected = (day: number) => {
    if (!value) return false;
    const parts = value.split('-');
    if (parts.length !== 3) return false;
    return (
      Number(parts[0]) === viewYear &&
      Number(parts[1]) - 1 === viewMonth &&
      Number(parts[2]) === day
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className={`relative inline-block w-full ${className}`} id={`${id}-wrapper`}>
      {/* Trigger / Display Input */}
      <div
        id={id}
        onClick={() => setIsOpen(!isOpen)}
        className="w-full flex items-center justify-between px-3.5 py-2.5 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] bg-white hover:bg-[#f5faff] cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-2xs group"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 min-w-0">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#2d4055] text-[18px] group-hover:scale-110 transition-transform">
            calendar_month
          </span>
          <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] truncate">
            {value ? formatLabel(value) : 'Select target date...'}
          </span>
        </div>
        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#74777d] text-[18px]">
          {isOpen ? 'expand_less' : 'expand_more'}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Popover Calendar Dropdown */}
      {isOpen && (
        <>
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 z-40"
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
          <div
            id={`${id}-dropdown`}
            className="absolute left-0 mt-2 z-50 w-72 sm:w-80 bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] p-4 text-xs animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95 duration-150"
          >
            {/* Header: Month / Year + Navigation */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 mb-2 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] uppercase font-bold text-[#466271] block">
                  Calendar Schedule
                </span>
                <span className="font-headline font-bold text-sm text-[#2d4055]">
                  {monthNames[viewMonth]} {viewYear}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handlePrevMonth}
                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] flex items-center justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3] transition-colors"
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">chevron_left</span>
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleNextMonth}
                  className="w-7 h-7 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] flex items-center justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3] transition-colors"
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">chevron_right</span>
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Weekday Labels */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center font-bold text-[#466271] text-[11px] mb-1.5">
              <span>Mo</span>
              <span>Tu</span>
              <span>We</span>
              <span>Th</span>
              <span>Fr</span>
              <span>Sa</span>
              <span>Su</span>
            </div>

            {/* Days Matrix */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center text-xs">
              {/* Empty leading offsets */}
              {[...Array(startOffset)].map((_, i) => (
                <div key={`empty-${i}`} className="py-2 text-[#c4c6cd]" />
              ))}

              {/* Month Days */}
              {[...Array(daysInMonth)].map((_, i) => {
                const day = i + 1;
                const active = isSelected(day);
                return (
                  <button
                    key={day}
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleSelectDay(day)}
                    className={`py-1.5 rounded-lg font-medium transition-all ${
                      active
                        ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white font-bold shadow-xs ring-2 ring-[#2d4055]/30'
                        : 'bg-[#f5faff] text-[#2d4055] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9]'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {day}
                  </button>
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* Quick Today Shortcut */}
            <div className="mt-3 pt-2.5 border-t border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  const today = new Date();
                  const monthStr = String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0');
                  const dayStr = String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
                  const todayIso = `${today.getFullYear()}-${monthStr}-${dayStr}`;
                  onChange(todayIso, formatLabel(todayIso));
                  setIsOpen(false);
                }}
                className="text-[#2d4055] font-semibold hover:underline"
              >
                Today
              </button>
              <span className="text-[#74777d]">Academic Term 2025-2026</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

```

                    </span>

              <button

              </div>
              <button

                type="button"
                onClick={onNavigateToReservationsTab}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg bg-[#44576d] hover:bg-[#2d4055] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"

              </button>
            </article>

            {/* Card 6: Booking History */}
            <article className="flex flex-col bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all justify-between gap-4 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <div className="space-y-4">

                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-2xl">history</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#466271] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">

                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <h3 className="font-headline text-lg font-bold text-[#2d4055]">

                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-sm text-[#43474c] leading-relaxed">

                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#466271] p-3 bg-[#e9f5ff] rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                  <span>Completed Sessions</span>
                  <span className="font-headline text-lg font-bold text-[#2d4055]">12 Hours</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                id="card-btn-view-history"
                type="button"
                onClick={onNavigateToHistoryTab}
                className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 rounded-lg bg-[#44576d] hover:bg-[#2d4055] text-white text-sm font-semibold transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 shadow-xs cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>View History</span>
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-lg">arrow_forward</span>
              </button>
            </article>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Facility Guidelines Information Row */}
        <section className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-6 lg:p-8 shadow-xs border border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">

              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#466271] text-2xl shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                timer
              </span>

                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#2d4055]">Slot Limits</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#43474c] mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">

                </p>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#466271] text-2xl shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                app_badging
              </span>
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#2d4055]">Check-in Policy</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#43474c] mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                  Present student ID card or digital confirmation at Court Control Desk.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#466271] text-2xl shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                clean_hands
              </span>
              <div>
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-[#2d4055]">Court Footwear</h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-[#43474c] mt-0.5 leading-relaxed">
                  Non-marking athletic footwear required on all competition hardwoods.
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ViewTab, UserProfile, AdminTab } from '../types';
import { BasketballLogo } from './BasketballLogo';
import { UserAvatar } from './UserAvatar';

interface HeaderProps {
  currentTab: ViewTab;
  onSelectTab: (tab: ViewTab) => void;
  user: UserProfile;
  onLogout: () => void;
  onOpenPass: () => void;
  onOpenEditProfile: () => void;
  adminSubTab?: AdminTab;
  onSelectAdminSubTab?: (tab: AdminTab) => void;
  onOpenGatepassChecker?: () => void;
  onOpenAdminReserveModal?: () => void;
}

export const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({
  currentTab,
  onSelectTab,
  user,
  onLogout,
  onOpenPass,
  onOpenEditProfile,
  adminSubTab = 'overview',
  onSelectAdminSubTab,
  onOpenGatepassChecker,
  onOpenAdminReserveModal,
}) => {
  const [isMenuOpen, setIsMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuButtonRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isMenuOpen) return;

    const handleKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        setIsMenuOpen(false);
        menuButtonRef.current?.focus();
      }
    };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [isMenuOpen]);

  const closeMenu = () => {
    setIsMenuOpen(false);
    if (isMenuOpen) menuButtonRef.current?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <header className="fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 w-full z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#ddeaf3] shadow-[0_1px_4px_rgba(0,0,0,0.02),0_4px_16px_rgba(45,64,85,0.05)]">
      <div className="relative h-16 w-full max-w-[1920px] mx-auto px-3 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 sm:gap-4 md:gap-6">
        {/* Brand / Logo */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => {
            onSelectTab(user.isAdmin ? 'admin' : 'dashboard');
            closeMenu();
          }}
          className="flex min-w-0 items-center gap-2.5 sm:gap-3 shrink-0 cursor-pointer group select-none text-left focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[#44576d] rounded-lg"
          id="header-brand-logo"
          aria-label={user.isAdmin ? 'Go to admin overview' : 'Go to dashboard'}
        >
          <div className="w-9 h-9 sm:w-10 sm:h-10 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-br from-[#2d4055] to-[#111d24] p-1.5 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs ring-1 ring-black/5 group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-200 shrink-0">
            <BasketballLogo className="h-full w-full text-white" />

            <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-bold text-[#466271] tracking-wider uppercase leading-none whitespace-nowrap">
              Varsity Athletics
            </span>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-0.5">
              <span className="hidden min-[360px]:inline font-headline font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm lg:text-base text-[#111d24] tracking-tight leading-snug whitespace-nowrap">

              {user.isAdmin ? (

              ) : (
                <span className="hidden xl:inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md text-[10px] font-semibold bg-[#e9f5ff] text-[#2d4055] border border-[#ddeaf3] whitespace-nowrap">
                  <span className="w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#2d4055] animate-pulse" />
                  Courts Active

        </button>

        <button

          {/* Logout Button */}

};

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/AdminReserveCourtModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { CourtOption, Reservation, UserProfile } from '../../types';
import { DatePicker } from '../common/DatePicker';

interface AdminReserveCourtModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  courts: CourtOption[];
  user: UserProfile;
  onSaveReservation: (newReservation: Reservation) => void;
}

export const AdminReserveCourtModal: React.FC<AdminReserveCourtModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  courts,
  user,
  onSaveReservation,
}) => {
  const [selectedCourtId, setSelectedCourtId] = useState(courts[0]?.id || 'bb-1');
  const [reserveForType, setReserveForType] = useState<'student' | 'faculty' | 'varsity'>('student');
  const [beneficiaryName, setBeneficiaryName] = useState('Mateo Santos');
  const [beneficiaryId, setBeneficiaryId] = useState('20240412-M');
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState('2025-10-24');
  const [timeSlot, setTimeSlot] = useState('02:00 PM â€“ 03:00 PM');
  const [equipmentBalls, setEquipmentBalls] = useState(2);
  const [notes, setNotes] = useState('Admin scheduled via Facility Desk');

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const court = courts.find((c) => c.id === selectedCourtId) || courts[0];

    // Format human-readable date
    let dateStr = selectedDate;
    try {
      const parts = selectedDate.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const d = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        dateStr = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          weekday: 'long',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric',
          year: 'numeric',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }

    const sportLabel = court.type === 'volleyball' ? 'Volleyballs' : 'Basketballs';

    const newRes: Reservation = {
      id: `ADM-${Date.now().toString().slice(-4)}`,
      docket: `#CRS-ADM-${Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000 + 1000)}`,
      courtName: court.name,
      courtSub: court.subLocation,
      facilityDetail: `${court.name} â€¢ ${court.badge}`,
      dateStr,
      isoDate: selectedDate,
      timeSlot,
      equipmentSummary: equipmentBalls > 0 ? `${equipmentBalls} ${sportLabel}` : 'None Requested',
      equipmentDetails: equipmentBalls > 0 ? [{ name: sportLabel, qty: equipmentBalls }] : [],
      checkInLocation: 'Main Desk â€¢ Turnstile 1',
      status: reserveForType === 'varsity' ? 'Blocked / Varsity' : 'Confirmed',
      studentName: beneficiaryName.trim() || user.name,
      studentId: beneficiaryId.trim() || user.studentId,
      isCheckedIn: false,
      notes: notes.trim(),
    };

    onSaveReservation(newRes);
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#111d24]/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        id="admin-reserve-modal-container"
        className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-2xl z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3] space-y-5"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#466271]">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-[#2d4055]">
                edit_calendar
              </span>
              <span>Facility Administration Desk</span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
              Schedule / Reserve Court Slot
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] flex items-center justify-center text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4 text-xs">
          {/* Reservation Beneficiary Type */}
          <div>
            <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">
              Reservation Authority / Category
            </label>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setReserveForType('student');
                  setBeneficiaryName('Mateo Santos');
                  setBeneficiaryId('20240412-M');
                }}
                className={`py-2 rounded-xl font-semibold border transition-all text-center ${
                  reserveForType === 'student'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white border-[#2d4055] shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-[#f5faff] text-[#466271] border-[#ddeaf3] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9]'
                }`}
              >
                Student Athlete
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setReserveForType('varsity');
                  setBeneficiaryName('Varsity Team Practice');
                  setBeneficiaryId('VARSITY-T1');
                }}
                className={`py-2 rounded-xl font-semibold border transition-all text-center ${
                  reserveForType === 'varsity'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white border-[#2d4055] shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-[#f5faff] text-[#466271] border-[#ddeaf3] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9]'
                }`}
              >
                Varsity Practice
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setReserveForType('faculty');
                  setBeneficiaryName('Faculty Recreation League');
                  setBeneficiaryId('FACULTY-REC');
                }}
                className={`py-2 rounded-xl font-semibold border transition-all text-center ${
                  reserveForType === 'faculty'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white border-[#2d4055] shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-[#f5faff] text-[#466271] border-[#ddeaf3] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9]'
                }`}
              >
                Faculty / Staff
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Beneficiary Details */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Booked On Behalf Of</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={beneficiaryName}
                onChange={(e) => setBeneficiaryName(e.target.value)}
                required
                placeholder="Student or Team Name"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Student / Team ID</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={beneficiaryId}
                onChange={(e) => setBeneficiaryId(e.target.value)}
                required
                placeholder="e.g. 20240412-M"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-mono text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Court Selection */}
          <div>
            <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Target Court Arena</label>
            <select
              value={selectedCourtId}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedCourtId(e.target.value)}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
            >
              {courts.map((c) => (
                <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                  {c.name} ({c.badge}) â€¢ {c.subLocation}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {/* Date Picker & Time Slot */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">
                Reservation Date
              </label>
              <DatePicker
                id="admin-reserve-datepicker"
                value={selectedDate}
                onChange={(iso) => setSelectedDate(iso)}
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Session Time Slot</label>
              <select
                value={timeSlot}
                onChange={(e) => setTimeSlot(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              >
                <option value="08:00 AM â€“ 09:00 AM">08:00 AM â€“ 09:00 AM (Early Session)</option>
                <option value="09:00 AM â€“ 10:00 AM">09:00 AM â€“ 10:00 AM (Morning Session)</option>
                <option value="10:00 AM â€“ 11:00 AM">10:00 AM â€“ 11:00 AM (Midday Session)</option>
                <option value="01:00 PM â€“ 02:00 PM">01:00 PM â€“ 02:00 PM (Afternoon Early)</option>
                <option value="02:00 PM â€“ 03:00 PM">02:00 PM â€“ 03:00 PM (Afternoon Standard)</option>
                <option value="03:00 PM â€“ 04:00 PM">03:00 PM â€“ 04:00 PM (Peak Session)</option>
                <option value="04:00 PM â€“ 05:00 PM">04:00 PM â€“ 05:00 PM (Varsity Peak)</option>
                <option value="07:00 PM â€“ 08:00 PM">07:00 PM â€“ 08:00 PM (Evening Session)</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Equipment Loan Quantity */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Equipment Balls Loan</label>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setEquipmentBalls((b) => Math.max(0, b - 1))}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] font-bold flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#d0e6f5] border border-[#ddeaf3]"
                >
                  -
                </button>
                <span className="w-12 text-center font-bold text-sm text-[#2d4055]">
                  {equipmentBalls}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setEquipmentBalls((b) => Math.min(10, b + 1))}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#2d4055] text-white font-bold flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-[#111d24]"
                >
                  +
                </button>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] ml-1">Official Equipment</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Administrative Note</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                value={notes}
                onChange={(e) => setNotes(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Reason or instructions"
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Footer buttons */}
          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-[#466271] hover:bg-[#f5faff] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              id="admin-confirm-reserve-btn"
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-[#2d4055] text-white hover:bg-[#111d24] transition-colors shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">check_circle</span>
              <span>Confirm &amp; Issue Docket</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/AvailabilityCalendarModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { DatePicker } from '../common/DatePicker';
import { CourtOption, Reservation } from '../../types';

interface AvailabilityCalendarModalProps {
  onClose: () => void;
  onBookCourt: (courtName: string, timeSlot: string) => void;
  courts?: CourtOption[];
  reservations?: Reservation[];
}

export const AvailabilityCalendarModal: React.FC<AvailabilityCalendarModalProps> = ({
  onClose,
  onBookCourt,
  courts = [],
  reservations = [],
}) => {
  const [selectedSport, setSelectedSport] = useState<'all' | 'basketball' | 'volleyball'>('all');
  const [selectedIsoDate, setSelectedIsoDate] = useState<string>('2025-10-24');
  const [formattedDateLabel, setFormattedDateLabel] = useState<string>('Fri, Oct 24, 2025');

  const defaultCourts = [
    { id: 'bb1', name: 'Basketball Court 1 (Main Hardwood)', type: 'basketball' },
    { id: 'bb2', name: 'Basketball Court 2 (West Wing Quad)', type: 'basketball' },
    { id: 'bb3', name: 'Basketball Court 3 (Training Annex)', type: 'basketball' },
    { id: 'vb1', name: 'Volleyball Court 1 (South Pavilion)', type: 'volleyball' },
    { id: 'vb2', name: 'Volleyball Court 2 (North Pavilion)', type: 'volleyball' },
  ];

  const courtsList = courts && courts.length > 0
    ? courts.map(c => ({ id: c.id, name: c.name, type: c.type, status: c.status }))
    : defaultCourts;

  const timeSlots = [
    '08:00 AM',
    '10:00 AM',
    '12:00 PM',
    '02:00 PM',
    '04:00 PM',
    '06:00 PM',
    '08:00 PM',
  ];

  type SlotStatus = 'current' | 'reserved' | 'peak' | 'open';

  // Dynamic slot status derived from actual Firestore reservations
  const getSlotStatus = (courtName: string, slotStr: string): SlotStatus => {
    const courtClean = courtName.split(' (')[0];
    const isBooked = reservations.some(r =>
      r.isoDate === selectedIsoDate &&
      r.status !== 'Cancelled by User' &&
      r.status !== 'Completed' &&
      (r.courtName.toLowerCase().includes(courtClean.toLowerCase()) || courtClean.toLowerCase().includes(r.courtName.toLowerCase())) &&
      r.timeSlot.includes(slotStr)
    );
    if (isBooked) {
      const activeRes = reservations.find(r =>
        r.isoDate === selectedIsoDate &&
        r.status === 'In Progress' &&
        (r.courtName.toLowerCase().includes(courtClean.toLowerCase()) || courtClean.toLowerCase().includes(r.courtName.toLowerCase())) &&
        r.timeSlot.includes(slotStr)
      );
      if (activeRes) {
        return 'current';
      }
      return 'reserved';
    }

    if (slotStr === '06:00 PM' || slotStr === '08:00 PM') {
      return 'peak';
    }

    return 'open';
  };

  const filteredCourts =
    selectedSport === 'all'
      ? courtsList
      : courtsList.filter((c) => c.type === selectedSport);

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#111d24]/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        id="availability-modal-container"
        className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-4xl w-full p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-2xl z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3] max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col space-y-4"
      >
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-3 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-[#466271] uppercase tracking-wider">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-[#2d4055]">
                calendar_month
              </span>
              <span>Live Arena Timetable</span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-headline text-2xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
              Court Availability Matrix
            </h3>
            <p className="text-xs text-[#466271]">
              Real-time operational status for {formattedDateLabel}
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            {/* Global DatePicker Dropdown */}
            <div className="w-48">
              <DatePicker
                id="availability-date-picker"
                value={selectedIsoDate}
                onChange={(iso, label) => {
                  setSelectedIsoDate(iso);
                  setFormattedDateLabel(label);
                }}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="inline-flex p-1 bg-[#e3f0f9] rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold border border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedSport('all')}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  selectedSport === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055]'
                }`}
              >
                All
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedSport('basketball')}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  selectedSport === 'basketball'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055]'
                }`}
              >
                Basketball
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setSelectedSport('volleyball')}
                className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-lg transition-all ${
                  selectedSport === 'volleyball'
                    ? 'bg-[#2d4055] text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055]'
                }`}
              >
                Volleyball
              </button>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] flex items-center justify-center text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] border border-[#ddeaf3] transition-colors"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">close</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Legend */}
        <div className="py-2 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs text-[#466271]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-[#e9f5ff] border border-[#ddeaf3]" />
              Open / Available
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-[#2d4055]" />
              In Progress / Booked
            </span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-3 h-3 rounded bg-[#ddeaf3] border border-[#c4c6cd]" />
              Reserved
            </span>
          </div>
          <span className="text-[11px] text-[#74777d]">Click any open slot to reserve immediately</span>
        </div>

        {/* Schedule Grid Table */}
        <div className="overflow-x-auto flex-1 my-2 border border-[#ddeaf3] rounded-xl">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-[#f5faff] text-[#2d4055] font-semibold border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
                <th className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[200px]">Facility / Arena</th>
                {timeSlots.map((slot) => (
                  <th key={slot} className="py-3 px-3 text-center min-w-[90px]">
                    {slot}
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-[#ddeaf3]">
              {filteredCourts.map((court) => (
                <tr key={court.id} className="hover:bg-[#f5faff] transition-colors">
                  <td className="py-3.5 px-4 font-semibold text-[#2d4055]">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base text-[#2d4055]">
                        {court.type === 'basketball' ? 'sports_basketball' : 'sports_volleyball'}
                      </span>
                      <span>{court.name}</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  {timeSlots.map((slot) => {
                    const status = getSlotStatus(court.name, slot);
                    if (status === 'current') {
                      return (
                        <td key={slot} className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                          <span className="inline-block px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#2d4055] text-white font-semibold text-[11px] shadow-xs">
                            Active Slot
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      );
                    }
                    if (status === 'reserved') {
                      return (
                        <td key={slot} className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                          <span className="inline-block px-2 py-1 rounded bg-[#ddeaf3] text-[#466271] text-[11px]">
                            Reserved
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      );
                    }
                    if (status === 'peak') {
                      return (
                        <td key={slot} className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => {
                              onBookCourt(court.name.split(' (')[0], `${slot} â€“ 09:00 PM`);
                            }}
                            className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] hover:bg-[#d0e6f5] font-semibold text-[11px] transition-colors w-full border border-[#ddeaf3]"
                          >
                            Peak Slot
                          </button>
                        </td>
                      );
                    }
                    return (
                      <td key={slot} className="py-2 px-2 text-center">
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            onBookCourt(court.name.split(' (')[0], `${slot} â€“ 05:00 PM`);
                          }}
                          className="px-2 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] text-[#2d4055] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] font-semibold text-[11px] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3] w-full"
                        >
                          Open
                        </button>
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        <div className="pt-3 border-t border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-[#466271]">
          <span>Tip: Collegiate varsity teams practice from 1:00 PM â€“ 2:00 PM daily.</span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl bg-[#2d4055] text-white text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-[#111d24] transition-colors shadow-xs"
          >
            Close Timetable
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

```

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/CancelReservationModal.tsx

```
import React from 'react';
import { Reservation } from '../../types';

interface CancelReservationModalProps {
  reservation: Reservation;
  onClose: () => void;
  onConfirm: () => void;
}

export const CancelReservationModal: React.FC<CancelReservationModalProps> = ({
  reservation,
  onClose,
  onConfirm,
}) => {
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#263239]/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="relative bg-white rounded-xl max-w-md w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl space-y-4 z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
        <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-xl bg-[#ddeaf3] text-[#2d4055] flex items-center justify-center">
          <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[28px]">event_busy</span>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-1">
          <h3 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
            Cancel Reservation?
          </h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-[#466271] leading-relaxed">
            Are you sure you want to cancel your reservation for{' '}
            <strong className="text-[#2d4055] font-semibold">{reservation.courtName}</strong> on{' '}
            <strong className="text-[#2d4055] font-semibold">
              {reservation.dateStr} at {reservation.timeSlot.split(' â€“ ')[0]}
            </strong>
            ?
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="p-3.5 rounded-lg bg-[#e9f5ff] text-[#466271] text-xs space-y-1 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[#2d4055] font-semibold">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">release_alert</span>
            Collegiate Reallocation Notice
          </div>
          <p>
            This slot will immediately open for other students and recreation groups on the university athletic timetable.
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-col-reverse sm:flex-row items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-[#466271] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] transition-colors text-center"
          >
            Keep Reservation
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onConfirm}
            className="w-full sm:w-auto px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold bg-[#2d4055] text-white hover:bg-[#263239] transition-colors text-center shadow-sm"
          >
            Confirm Cancellation
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

```

import React from 'react';
import { Reservation, UserProfile } from '../../types';

interface DigitalPassModalProps {
  reservation: Reservation | null;
  user: UserProfile;
  onClose: () => void;
}

export const DigitalPassModal: React.FC<DigitalPassModalProps> = ({
  reservation,
  user,
  onClose,
}) => {
  if (!reservation) return null;

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#263239]/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div
        className="fixed inset-0"
        onClick={onClose}
        aria-hidden="true"
      />
      <div className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-md w-full shadow-2xl overflow-hidden border border-[#ddeaf3] z-10">
        {/* Pass Top Banner */}
        <div className="bg-[#2d4055] text-white p-5 relative overflow-hidden">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-xl text-[#c9e7f8]">
                verified_user
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#c9e7f8]">
                University Athletics Pass
              </span>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 text-white flex items-center justify-center transition-colors"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">close</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <h3 className="font-headline font-bold text-xl text-white">
                {reservation.courtName}
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#b9cce6]">{reservation.courtSub}</p>
            </div>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded bg-[#c9e7f8] text-[#001e2b] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider">
              {reservation.status}
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Pass Body Content */}
        <div className="p-6 space-y-4 bg-[#f5faff]">
          {/* Holder & Keycard Meta */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] shadow-xs">
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#466271] uppercase block">
                Authorized Passholder
              </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#111d24]">
                {reservation.studentName || user.name}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-[#74777d] block font-mono">
                {reservation.studentId || user.studentId}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-[#466271] uppercase block">
                Access Gate
              </span>
              <span className="font-bold text-sm text-[#2d4055]">Gate 2B â€¢ East Wing</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-[#466271] block">
                {reservation.checkInLocation}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Schedule & Equipment */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] space-y-2 shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-[#466271]">Scheduled Slot:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-[#2d4055]">{reservation.dateStr}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
              <span className="text-[#466271]">Session Window:</span>
              <span className="font-bold text-[#2d4055]">{reservation.timeSlot}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 border-t border-[#e3f0f9]">
              <span className="text-[#466271]">Loaned Equipment:</span>
              <span className="font-semibold text-[#2d4055]">
                {reservation.equipmentSummary}
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Simulated High-Res Barcode / Keycard sync */}
          <div className="p-4 bg-white rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-2 text-center shadow-xs">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-[#466271]">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#2d4055] animate-pulse" />
              <span>NFC / RFID Digital Keycard Active</span>
            </div>

            {/* Visual Barcode Bars */}
            <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-center gap-[2.5px] h-12 py-1 px-4 bg-[#f5faff] rounded">
              {[4, 2, 6, 3, 1, 5, 2, 4, 7, 2, 3, 5, 2, 6, 3, 1, 4, 6, 2, 5, 3, 6, 2, 4, 3, 7, 2, 4, 6, 3].map(
                (h, idx) => (
                  <div
                    key={idx}
                    className="bg-[#2d4055] rounded-full"
                    style={{
                      height: `${h * 4 + 14}px`,
                      width: idx % 3 === 0 ? '3px' : '2px',
                    }}
                  />
                )
              )}
            </div>
            <span className="font-mono text-xs font-semibold text-[#466271] tracking-widest">
              CRS-{reservation.id}-NFC{reservation.studentId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '')}
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* Operational Rule */}
          <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-2.5 rounded-lg bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#466271] text-xs">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base text-[#2d4055] shrink-0 mt-0.5">
              app_badging
            </span>
            <span>
              Tap your digital pass at Turnstile 2B or present this screen to the Control Desk 15 minutes before tip-off.
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Modal Actions */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-white border-t border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              window.print();
            }}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-[#2d4055] bg-[#e3f0f9] hover:bg-[#ddeaf3] transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">print</span>
            Print Pass
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-xs font-semibold text-white bg-[#44576d] hover:bg-[#2d4055] transition-colors"
          >
            Done
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

```
