## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/EditProfileModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { UserProfile } from '../../types';
import { UserAvatar } from '../UserAvatar';

interface EditProfileModalProps {
  user: UserProfile;
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (updated: Partial<UserProfile>) => void;
}

export const EditProfileModal: React.FC<EditProfileModalProps> = ({
  user,
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  onSave,
}) => {
  const [name, setName] = useState(user.name);
  const [studentId, setStudentId] = useState(user.studentId);
  const [email, setEmail] = useState(user.email);
  const [role, setRole] = useState(user.role);
  const [eligibility, setEligibility] = useState(user.eligibility);
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState(user.avatarUrl);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    onSave({
      name: name.trim(),
      studentId: studentId.trim(),
      email: email.trim(),
      role: role.trim(),
      eligibility: eligibility.trim(),
      avatarUrl: avatarUrl.trim() || user.avatarUrl,
    });
    onClose();
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#111d24]/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        id="edit-profile-modal-container"
        className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-2xl z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3] space-y-5"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#466271]">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-[#2d4055]">
                manage_accounts
              </span>
              <span>{user.isAdmin ? 'Admin Credentials' : 'Athletic ID Card'}</span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
              Edit {user.isAdmin ? 'Administrator' : 'Student'} Profile
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] flex items-center justify-center text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Current Avatar Preview */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 p-3 bg-[#f5faff] rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div className="relative shrink-0">
            <UserAvatar
              src={avatarUrl || user.avatarUrl}
              alt={name}
              className="w-14 h-14 rounded-full ring-2 ring-[#44576d]/30"
            />
            <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-3.5 h-3.5 rounded-full bg-[#44576d] ring-2 ring-white" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#2d4055] block truncate">{name}</span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] font-mono block">{studentId}</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] text-[#74777d] block truncate">{email}</span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Form fields */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-3.5 text-xs">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Full Legal Name</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="profile-name-input"
                value={name}
                onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-medium text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">
                {user.isAdmin ? 'Staff / Faculty ID' : 'Institutional Student ID'}
              </label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="profile-id-input"
                value={studentId}
                onChange={(e) => setStudentId(e.target.value.toUpperCase())}
                placeholder={user.isAdmin ? 'e.g. FAC-70192' : 'e.g. 20240396-C'}
                pattern={user.isAdmin ? undefined : '^\\d{8}-[A-Za-z]$'}
                title={user.isAdmin ? 'Staff ID' : 'Student ID format: 8 digits, hyphen, single letter (e.g. 20240396-C)'}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-mono uppercase text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
              {!user.isAdmin && (
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#466271] block mt-0.5">
                  Format: 8 digits, hyphen, letter (e.g. <span className="font-mono font-semibold">20240396-C</span>)
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Institutional Email</label>
              <input
                type="email"
                id="profile-email-input"
                value={email}
                onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-medium text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Athletic / Campus Role</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                id="profile-role-input"
                value={role}
                onChange={(e) => setRole(e.target.value)}
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-medium text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Facility Eligibility</label>
              <select
                id="profile-eligibility-select"
                value={eligibility}
                onChange={(e) => setEligibility(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-medium text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              >
                <option value="Active Full Member">Active Full Member</option>
                <option value="Varsity Athlete">Varsity Athlete</option>
                <option value="Faculty / Facility Staff">Faculty / Facility Staff</option>
                <option value="Intramural Captain">Intramural Captain</option>
                <option value="Suspended">Suspended</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] block mb-1">Avatar Image URL</label>
              <input
                type="url"
                id="profile-avatar-input"
                value={avatarUrl}
                onChange={(e) => setAvatarUrl(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="https://images.unsplash.com/..."
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs text-[#2d4055] bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action buttons */}
          <div className="pt-4 border-t border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-end gap-2.5">
            <button
              type="button"
              id="cancel-profile-btn"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-[#466271] hover:bg-[#f5faff] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
            >
              Cancel
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"
              id="save-profile-btn"
              className="px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold bg-[#2d4055] text-white hover:bg-[#111d24] transition-colors shadow-xs flex items-center gap-1.5"
            >
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">save</span>
              <span>Save Profile</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

```

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/EditReservationModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Reservation, CourtOption } from '../../types';
import { DatePicker } from '../common/DatePicker';
import { checkLocalBookingConflict } from '../../lib/firestoreService';

interface EditReservationModalProps {
  reservation: Reservation;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSave: (updated: Partial<Reservation>) => void;
  courts?: CourtOption[];
  reservations?: Reservation[];
}

export const EditReservationModal: React.FC<EditReservationModalProps> = ({
  reservation,
  onClose,
  onSave,
  courts = [],
  reservations = [],
}) => {
  const [selectedCourt, setSelectedCourt] = useState(
    reservation.courtName.includes('Volleyball')
      ? 'Volleyball Court 1 (North Pavilion)'
      : 'Basketball Court 1 (East Gymnasium)'
  );
  const [selectedDate, setSelectedDate] = useState(reservation.isoDate || '2025-10-24');
  const [selectedSlot, setSelectedSlot] = useState(reservation.timeSlot);
  const [ballCount, setBallCount] = useState(2);
  const [conflictError, setConflictError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setConflictError(null);
    const courtClean = selectedCourt.split(' (')[0];
    const subClean = selectedCourt.includes('East')
      ? 'East Wing, Hardwood Arena'
      : selectedCourt.includes('West')
      ? 'West Wing, Main Fieldhouse'
      : 'South Pavilion, Olympic Net';

    // Conflict check
    const conflict = checkLocalBookingConflict(
      reservations,
      courtClean,
      selectedDate,
      selectedSlot,
      reservation.id
    );
    if (conflict) {
      setConflictError(`Conflict: ${courtClean} is already booked for ${selectedSlot}. Please choose a different slot.`);
      return;
    }

    // Format readable date
    let dateFormatted = selectedDate;
    try {
      const parts = selectedDate.split('-');
      if (parts.length === 3) {
        const d = new Date(Number(parts[0]), Number(parts[1]) - 1, Number(parts[2]));
        dateFormatted = d.toLocaleDateString('en-US', {
          weekday: 'long',
          month: 'short',
          day: 'numeric',
          year: 'numeric',
        });
      }
    } catch {
      // fallback
    }

    onSave({
      courtName: courtClean,
      courtSub: subClean,
      dateStr: dateFormatted,
      isoDate: selectedDate,
      timeSlot: selectedSlot,
      equipmentSummary:
        ballCount > 0 ? `${ballCount} Official Basketballs` : 'None Requested',
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#263239]/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div className="relative bg-white rounded-xl max-w-lg w-full p-6 sm:p-8 shadow-xl space-y-4 z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3]">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#466271]">
              Reservation Modification
            </span>
            <h3 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
              Edit Court Reservation
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#e3f0f9] flex items-center justify-center text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] transition-colors"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        <form className="space-y-4" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
          {conflictError && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-red-700 font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-base">error</span>
              <span>{conflictError}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-[#466271]">
              Court Selection
            </label>
            <div className="relative">
              <select
                id="edit-court"
                value={selectedCourt}
                onChange={(e) => setSelectedCourt(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full h-11 px-3 bg-[#e9f5ff] rounded-lg text-sm text-[#2d4055] font-medium appearance-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#44576d] pr-10 border border-[#ddeaf3]"
              >
                <option value="Basketball Court 1 (East Gymnasium)">
                  Basketball Court 1 (East Gymnasium)
                </option>
                <option value="Basketball Court 2 (East Gymnasium)">
                  Basketball Court 2 (East Gymnasium)
                </option>
                <option value="Volleyball Court 1 (North Pavilion)">
                  Volleyball Court 1 (North Pavilion)
                </option>
                <option value="Volleyball Court 2 (North Pavilion)">
                  Volleyball Court 2 (North Pavilion)
                </option>
              </select>
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-3 text-[#466271] text-[20px]">
                expand_more
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-[#466271]">
                Date
              </label>
              <DatePicker
                id="edit-reservation-datepicker"
                value={selectedDate}
                onChange={(iso) => setSelectedDate(iso)}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-[#466271]">
                Time Slot
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <select
                  id="edit-slot"
                  value={selectedSlot}
                  onChange={(e) => setSelectedSlot(e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full h-11 px-3 bg-[#e9f5ff] rounded-lg text-sm text-[#2d4055] font-medium appearance-none focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#44576d] pr-10 border border-[#ddeaf3]"
                >
                  <option value="02:00 PM â€“ 03:00 PM">02:00 PM â€“ 03:00 PM</option>
                  <option value="03:00 PM â€“ 04:00 PM">03:00 PM â€“ 04:00 PM</option>
                  <option value="04:00 PM â€“ 05:00 PM">04:00 PM â€“ 05:00 PM</option>
                  <option value="05:00 PM â€“ 06:00 PM">05:00 PM â€“ 06:00 PM</option>
                  <option value="06:00 PM â€“ 07:00 PM">06:00 PM â€“ 07:00 PM</option>
                </select>
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined pointer-events-none absolute right-3 top-3 text-[#466271] text-[20px]">
                  schedule
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-1">
            <label className="block text-xs font-semibold uppercase text-[#466271]">
              Equipment Check-Out Counter
            </label>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-[#e9f5ff] rounded-lg border border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[#44576d] text-[22px]">
                  sports_basketball
                </span>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#2d4055] block">
                    Official Game Basketballs
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-[#466271]">Max 4 balls per reservation</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBallCount((c) => Math.max(0, c - 1))}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-white text-[#2d4055] font-bold hover:bg-[#c9e7f8] flex items-center justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3] shadow-xs"
                >
                  -
                </button>
                <span className="w-8 text-center font-headline font-bold text-base text-[#2d4055]">
                  {ballCount}
                </span>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setBallCount((c) => Math.min(4, c + 1))}
                  className="w-8 h-8 rounded bg-white text-[#2d4055] font-bold hover:bg-[#c9e7f8] flex items-center justify-center border border-[#ddeaf3] shadow-xs"
                >
                  +
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-[#ddeaf3]/60 flex items-start gap-2 text-[#466271] text-xs">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] text-[#2d4055] shrink-0">
              info
            </span>
            <span>
              Changes are subject to court slot availability. Existing locker hall codes will remain valid.
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={onClose}
              className="px-4 py-2 rounded-lg text-sm font-semibold text-[#466271] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] transition-colors"
            >
              Discard
            </button>
            <button
              type="submit"

            >
              Save Changes
            </button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </div>

  );
};

## AdvanceWEBProject/Basketball-Court-Reservation-Web-System/src/components/modals/GatepassCheckerModal.tsx

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { Reservation } from '../../types';

interface GatepassCheckerModalProps {
  isOpen: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  reservations: Reservation[];
  onValidateCheckIn: (id: string) => void;
}

export const GatepassCheckerModal: React.FC<GatepassCheckerModalProps> = ({
  isOpen,
  onClose,
  reservations,
  onValidateCheckIn,
}) => {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [scanSimActive, setScanSimActive] = useState(false);
  const [verifiedPass, setVerifiedPass] = useState<Reservation | null>(null);
  const [verificationError, setVerificationError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  if (!isOpen) return null;

  const handleSearchSubmit = (e?: React.FormEvent) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    const query = searchTerm.trim().toUpperCase();
    if (!query) return;

    setScanSimActive(true);
    setVerificationError(null);
    setVerifiedPass(null);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanSimActive(false);
      const match = reservations.find(
        (r) =>
          r.studentId.toUpperCase() === query ||
          r.docket.toUpperCase().includes(query) ||
          r.id.toUpperCase().includes(query) ||
          r.studentName.toUpperCase().includes(query)
      );

      if (match) {
        setVerifiedPass(match);
      } else {
        setVerificationError(`No matching active pass found for keycard query "${query}".`);
      }
    }, 400);
  };

  const handleInstantQuickCheck = (idOrDocket: string) => {
    setSearchTerm(idOrDocket);
    setScanSimActive(true);
    setVerificationError(null);
    setVerifiedPass(null);

    setTimeout(() => {
      setScanSimActive(false);
      const match = reservations.find(
        (r) =>
          r.studentId.toUpperCase() === idOrDocket.toUpperCase() ||
          r.docket.toUpperCase().includes(idOrDocket.toUpperCase())
      );
      if (match) {
        setVerifiedPass(match);
      } else {
        setVerificationError(`No pass found for "${idOrDocket}".`);
      }
    }, 300);
  };

  const handleConfirmAccess = () => {
    if (!verifiedPass) return;
    onValidateCheckIn(verifiedPass.id);
    setVerifiedPass((prev) => (prev ? { ...prev, isCheckedIn: true, status: 'In Progress' } : null));
  };

  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-[#111d24]/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-in fade-in duration-200">
      <div className="fixed inset-0" onClick={onClose} aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        id="gatepass-checker-modal-container"
        className="relative bg-white rounded-2xl max-w-xl w-full p-6 sm:p-7 shadow-2xl z-10 border border-[#ddeaf3] space-y-5"
      >
        {/* Header */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#466271]">
              <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-[#2d4055]">
                qr_code_scanner
              </span>
              <span>Facility Security &amp; Turnstile</span>
            </div>
            <h3 className="font-headline text-xl font-bold text-[#2d4055] tracking-tight">
              Gatepass Scanner &amp; Access Checker
            </h3>
          </div>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="w-8 h-8 rounded-lg bg-[#f5faff] hover:bg-[#e3f0f9] flex items-center justify-center text-[#466271] hover:text-[#2d4055] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
          >
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">close</span>
          </button>
        </div>

        {/* Turnstile scanner input */}
        <form onSubmit={handleSearchSubmit} className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#2d4055] mb-1">
              Scan RFID Barcode, Docket Number, or Student ID
            </label>
            <div className="flex gap-2">
              <div className="relative flex-1">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-3 top-2.5 text-[#466271] text-[18px]">
                  contactless
                </span>
                <input
                  type="text"
                  id="gatepass-search-input"
                  value={searchTerm}
                  onChange={(e) => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="e.g. 20240396-C or #CRS-8849-25"
                  className="w-full pl-9 pr-3 py-2 rounded-xl border border-[#ddeaf3] text-xs font-mono uppercase bg-[#f5faff] focus:bg-white focus:outline-hidden focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#2d4055] text-[#2d4055]"
                  autoFocus
                />
              </div>
              <button
                type="submit"
                id="gatepass-scan-btn"
                disabled={scanSimActive || !searchTerm.trim()}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-[#2d4055] hover:bg-[#111d24] disabled:opacity-50 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 transition-all shadow-xs"
              >
                {scanSimActive ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] animate-spin">
                      sync
                    </span>
                    <span>Checking...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px]">search</span>
                    <span>Verify Pass</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Quick preset chips */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-[#466271] pt-1">
            <span className="font-semibold text-[#74777d]">Quick Scan Demo Passes:</span>
            {reservations.slice(0, 3).map((r) => (
              <button
                key={r.id}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleInstantQuickCheck(r.studentId)}
                className="px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg bg-[#e9f5ff] hover:bg-[#ddeaf3] text-[#2d4055] font-mono border border-[#ddeaf3] transition-colors"
              >
                {r.studentId} ({r.studentName.split(' ')[0]})
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </form>

        {/* Verification result screen */}
        {verificationError && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#ffdad6]/60 border border-[#ba1a1a]/30 text-xs text-[#93000a] flex items-start gap-2.5">
            <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px] shrink-0 text-[#ba1a1a]">
              error
            </span>
            <div className="min-w-0">
              <span className="font-bold block">Access Turnstile Denied</span>
              <span>{verificationError}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {verifiedPass && (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-[#f5faff] border border-[#ddeaf3] space-y-3.5">
            {/* Pass status banner */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#2d4055] animate-pulse" />
                <span className="font-bold text-xs text-[#2d4055] uppercase tracking-wide">
                  Gate Access Validated
                </span>
              </div>
              <span className="text-[11px] font-mono font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-md bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] border border-[#ddeaf3]">
                {verifiedPass.docket}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Holder information */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#466271] uppercase tracking-wider block font-semibold">
                  Student Athlete
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] text-sm block">
                  {verifiedPass.studentName}
                </span>
                <span className="font-mono text-[11px] text-[#466271]">
                  ID: {verifiedPass.studentId}
                </span>
              </div>

              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#466271] uppercase tracking-wider block font-semibold">
                  Authorized Arena
                </span>
                <span className="font-bold text-[#2d4055] text-sm block">
                  {verifiedPass.courtName}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] block">
                  {verifiedPass.courtSub}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Timetable & equipment */}
            <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border border-[#ddeaf3] grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#74777d] uppercase font-semibold block">
                  Allocated Session
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-[#2d4055]">{verifiedPass.timeSlot}</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#466271] block">{verifiedPass.dateStr}</span>
              </div>
              <div>
                <span className="text-[10px] text-[#74777d] uppercase font-semibold block">
                  Equipment Pass
                </span>
                <span className="font-semibold text-[#2d4055] block">
                  {verifiedPass.equipmentSummary}
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-[#74777d]">Turnstile: Turnstile Gate A</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Barcode graphic */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-3 bg-white rounded-lg border border-[#ddeaf3]">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-[2px] h-10 px-2">
                {[3, 1, 4, 2, 1, 3, 2, 4, 1, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2, 3, 1, 2, 4, 2, 3, 1, 4, 2, 3].map(
                  (w, i) => (
                    <div
                      key={i}
                      className="bg-[#2d4055] h-full rounded-xs"
                      style={{ width: `${w * 1.6}px` }}
                    />
                  )
                )}
              </div>
              <span className="text-[10px] font-mono text-[#466271] mt-1">
                * GATEPASS-AUTH-{verifiedPass.id} *
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Turnstile Actions */}
            <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
              {verifiedPass.isCheckedIn ? (
                <div className="w-full py-2 px-3 rounded-xl bg-[#e3f0f9] text-[#2d4055] text-xs font-semibold text-center border border-[#ddeaf3] flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[16px] text-[#2d4055]">
                    task_alt
                  </span>
                  <span>Pass Already Checked-In &amp; Granted Turnstile Access</span>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  id="grant-turnstile-access-btn"
                  onClick={handleConfirmAccess}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-4 bg-[#2d4055] hover:bg-[#111d24] text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-xs flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                  <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[18px]">lock_open</span>
                  <span>Grant Turnstile Entry &amp; Mark Checked In</span>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="pt-2 flex items-center justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-4 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-[#466271] hover:bg-[#f5faff] transition-colors border border-[#ddeaf3]"
          >
            Close Scanner
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

};
