                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/15 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <IconDesktop className="w-4 h-4 text-white" />
                  <span>Switch to Desktop View</span>
                </button>
              )}

              {onSwitchToCustomerMenu && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setIsDrawerOpen(false);
                    onSwitchToCustomerMenu();
                  }}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 bg-[#E58422]/20 hover:bg-[#E58422]/30 text-[#E58422] border border-[#E58422]/40 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <IconCoffee className="w-4 h-4 text-[#E58422]" />
                  <span>View Customer Menu</span>
                </button>
              )}

              {onLogout && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setIsDrawerOpen(false);
                    onLogout();
                  }}
                  className="w-full py-2.5 px-3 bg-rose-500/10 hover:bg-rose-500/20 text-rose-300 border border-rose-500/30 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <IconLogout className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-400" />
                  <span>Lock Terminal / Logout</span>
                </button>
              )}

              <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 text-center pt-1 font-mono">
                Terminal ID: TER-MNL-BAY-01
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 5. FULLY FUNCTIONAL 'ADD NEW PRODUCT' MODAL (Requirement 3)          */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {isAddProductModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
            onClick={() => setIsAddProductModalOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full z-10 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scaleUp max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center">
                  <IconPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#19244E]">Add New Product</h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Live digital menu catalog item</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAddProductModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1"
              >
                <IconClose className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const form = e.target;
                const name = form.productName.value.trim();
                const price = Number(form.productPrice.value);
                const category = form.productCategory.value;
                const desc = form.productDesc.value.trim() || 'Signature handcrafted specialty creation.';
                const flavor = form.productFlavor.value.trim() || 'Rich notes of chocolate and roasted hazelnut.';
                const allergens = form.productAllergens.value.trim() || 'None';
                const image = form.productImage.value.trim() || '/src/assets/hiromi.png';

                const newProduct = {
                  id: `menu-${Date.now()}`,
                  name,
                  category,
                  price: `â‚±${price.toFixed(2)}`,
                  description: desc,
                  flavorNotes: flavor,
                  allergens,
                  available: true,
                  image
                };

                setMenuItems((prev) => [newProduct, ...prev]);
                logAudit('Create Product', 'create', name, newProduct.id, 'None', `Price: â‚±${price.toFixed(2)}, Category: ${category}`);
                setIsAddProductModalOpen(false);
                showToast(`Product "${name}" added to menu catalog!`);
              }}
              className="space-y-3.5"
            >
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Product Name *
                </label>
                <input
                  name="productName"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Caramel Beard Cortado"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    Price (PHP â‚±) *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    name="productPrice"
                    type="number"
                    step="5"
                    required
                    defaultValue="160"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    Category *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    name="productCategory"
                    defaultValue="Signatures"
                    className="w-full px-2.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    {categories.filter((c) => c.name !== 'All Items').map((c) => (
                      <option key={c.id} value={c.name}>
                        {c.name}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Description
                </label>
                <textarea
                  name="productDesc"
                  rows={2}
                  placeholder="Rich double espresso poured over textured milk..."
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 outline-none resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Flavor Profile / Tasting Notes
                </label>
                <input
                  name="productFlavor"
                  placeholder="Dark cocoa, roasted almond, velvety finish"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    Allergens
                  </label>
                  <input
                    name="productAllergens"
                    defaultValue="Dairy"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 outline-none"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    Preset Image
                  </label>
                  <select
                    name="productImage"
                    className="w-full px-2 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="/src/assets/hiromi.png">Iced Americano</option>
                    <option value="/src/assets/beardista blanc.jpg">Latte / Flat White</option>
                    <option value="/src/assets/alon_at_apoy.png">Cold Brew Tonic</option>
                    <option value="/src/assets/goatee.png">Mocha Signature</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddProductModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  Save Product
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 6. FULLY FUNCTIONAL 'ADD NEW CATEGORY' MODAL (Requirement 3)         */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {isAddCategoryModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
            onClick={() => setIsAddCategoryModalOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full z-10 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scaleUp max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 flex items-center justify-center">
                  <IconPlus className="w-4 h-4" />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#19244E]">Add New Category</h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">Department classification</p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsAddCategoryModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1"
              >
                <IconClose className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            <form
              onSubmit={(e) => {
                e.preventDefault();
                const form = e.target;
                const name = form.categoryName.value.trim();
                const dept = form.categoryDept.value;
                const slug = name.toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, '-');

                const newCategory = {
                  id: `cat-${Date.now()}`,
                  name,
                  count: 0,
                  slug,
                  department: dept
                };

                setCategories((prev) => [...prev, newCategory]);
                logAudit('Create Category', 'create', name, newCategory.id, 'None', `Department: ${dept}`);
                setIsAddCategoryModalOpen(false);
                showToast(`Category "${name}" added to menu catalog!`);
              }}
              className="space-y-3.5"
            >
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Category Name *
                </label>
                <input
                  name="categoryName"
                  required
                  placeholder="e.g. Single-Origin Pour Overs"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Department / Group *
                </label>
                <select
                  name="categoryDept"
                  defaultValue="Beverages & Espresso"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Beverages & Espresso">Beverages & Espresso</option>
                  <option value="Signature Creations">Signature Creations</option>
                  <option value="Savory Kitchen & Pasta">Savory Kitchen & Pasta</option>
                  <option value="Bakery & Bar Bites">Bakery & Bar Bites</option>
                  <option value="Matcha & Tea Bar">Matcha & Tea Bar</option>
                  <option value="Merchandise & Retail">Merchandise & Retail</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Sort Priority (Order)
                </label>
                <input
                  name="sortPriority"
                  type="number"
                  defaultValue="1"
                  min="1"
                  className="w-full px-3.5 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Tag Color Scheme
                </label>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                  {['#E58422', '#19244E', '#10B981', '#F43F5E', '#8B5CF6'].map((color) => (
                    <button
                      key={color}
                      type="button"
                      style={{ backgroundColor: color }}
                      className="w-7 h-7 rounded-full shadow-2xs border-2 border-white hover:scale-110 transition-transform cursor-pointer"
                    />
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsAddCategoryModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  Save Category
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 7. ADD / EDIT ADMIN USER MODAL (Requirement 4)                       */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {isUserModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
            onClick={() => setIsUserModalOpen(false)}
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl p-6 max-w-sm w-full z-10 shadow-2xl space-y-4 animate-scaleUp max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-100">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <div className="w-8 h-8 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-xs">
                  {editingUser ? <IconEdit className="w-4 h-4" /> : <IconPlus className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </div>
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#19244E]">
                    {editingUser ? 'Edit Admin Personnel' : 'Add New Admin'}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                    {editingUser ? editingUser.name : 'Provision portal credentials'}
                  </p>
                </div>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setIsUserModalOpen(false)}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1"
              >
                <IconClose className="w-5 h-5" />
              </button>
            </div>

            {userFormError && (
              <div className="p-2.5 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <IconWarning className="w-4 h-4 flex-shrink-0" />
                <span>{userFormError}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <form onSubmit={handleSaveUser} className="space-y-3.5">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5">
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    First Name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={userFormData.firstName}
                    onChange={(e) => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, firstName: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. Maria"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                    Last Name *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    required
                    value={userFormData.lastName}
                    onChange={(e) => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, lastName: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="e.g. Santos"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Email Address *
                </label>
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={userFormData.email}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, email: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="admin@beardistabrew.com"
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                />
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Role Assignment *
                </label>
                <select
                  value={userFormData.role}
                  onChange={(e) => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, role: e.target.value })}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <option value="Owner Admin">Owner Admin (Full System Privileges)</option>
                  <option value="Store Admin">Store Admin (Menu, Availability, & Survey Ops)</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black uppercase text-[#19244E] mb-1">
                  Account Status
                </label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, status: 'Active' })}
                    className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                      userFormData.status === 'Active'
                        ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800'
                        : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-500'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                    <span>Active</span>
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, status: 'Suspended' })}
                    className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                      userFormData.status === 'Suspended'
                        ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-800'
                        : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-500'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500" />
                    <span>Suspended</span>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Password Generator */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-orange-50/60 rounded-2xl border border-orange-200/60 space-y-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-[10px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E]">
                    Temporary Password
                  </span>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => {
                      const newPass = generateRandomPassword();
                      setUserFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: newPass }));
                      setShowPassword(true);
                      setPasswordCopied(false);
                    }}
                    className="text-[10px] font-extrabold text-[#E58422] hover:text-[#c46914] flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <IconRefresh className="w-3 h-3 text-[#E58422]" />
                    <span>Generate</span>
                  </button>
                </div>

                <div className="relative flex items-center">
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    value={userFormData.password}
                    onChange={(e) => setUserFormData({ ...userFormData, password: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder={editingUser ? 'Leave blank to preserve' : 'Click Generate'}
                    className="w-full pl-3 pr-16 py-2 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none"
                  />
                  <div className="absolute right-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                      className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      {showPassword ? <IconEyeOff className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> : <IconEye className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />}
                    </button>
                    {userFormData.password && (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => {
                          navigator.clipboard.writeText(userFormData.password);
                          setPasswordCopied(true);
                          setTimeout(() => setPasswordCopied(false), 2000);
                        }}
                        className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-[9px] font-bold rounded cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        {passwordCopied ? 'Copied' : 'Copy'}
                      </button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2 pt-3 border-t border-gray-100">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setIsUserModalOpen(false)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-black shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  Save User
                </button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 8. CENTERED REVOKE ACCESS CONFIRMATION MODAL (Requirement 4)         */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {userToDelete && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs"
            onClick={() => setUserToDelete(null)}
          />
          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-sm w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 z-10 animate-scaleUp space-y-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto shadow-sm">
              <IconWarning className="w-6 h-6 text-rose-600" />
            </div>

            <div className="text-center space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#19244E]">
                Revoke Admin Access
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800">
                Are you sure you want to revoke this user's access?
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center gap-3">
              <img
                src={userToDelete.avatar}
                alt={userToDelete.name}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-gray-300"
                onError={(e) => {
                  e.target.src = '/src/assets/beardista sign.jpg';
                }}
              />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
                <div className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#19244E] truncate">
                  {userToDelete.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 truncate">
                  {userToDelete.email}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422]">
                  Role: {userToDelete.role}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 text-center leading-relaxed">
              This action will immediately terminate this administrative account and invalidate all session tokens.
            </p>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2.5 pt-1">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUserToDelete(null)}
                className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmRevoke}
                className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              >
                Revoke Access
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* 9. SURVEY BUILDER MODAL                                              */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <SurveyBuilderModal
        isOpen={isSurveyModalOpen}
        onClose={() => setIsSurveyModalOpen(false)}
        onSave={(surveyData) => {
          setIsSurveyModalOpen(false);
          logAudit('Publish Survey', 'create', surveyData.title, 'SURV-NEW', 'Draft', 'Published to customer app');
          showToast(`Customer survey "${surveyData.title}" created & QR code deployed!`);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
};

export default MobileAdminLayout;
```

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';

export const MobileLogin = ({
  onLoginSuccess,
  onBackToCustomer,
  onSwitchToDesktop
}) => {
  // Current view: 'console' (View A: Password login) | 'pin' (View B: 4-digit PIN)
  const [view, setView] = useState('console');

  // View A (Console) form states
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('admin@beardistabrew.com');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [keepActive, setKeepActive] = useState(true);

  // View B (PIN) states
  const [pin, setPin] = useState('');
  const [pinError, setPinError] = useState(false);

  // General auth states
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState('');
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  // Active staff profile (matches reference images)
  const [staffProfile, setStaffProfile] = useState({
    name: 'Jim Carlo Gorospe',
    role: 'ADMIN',
    email: 'admin@beardistabrew.com',
    avatarLetter: 'A'
  });

  // Handle PIN entry changes
  useEffect(() => {
    if (view === 'pin' && pin.length === 4) {
      // Auto-validate 4-digit PIN (default demo PIN 2026 or any 4 digits in demo mode)
      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMsg('');

      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        if (pin === '2026' || pin === '1234' || pin.length === 4) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          if (onLoginSuccess) {
            onLoginSuccess({
              username: staffProfile.name,
              email: staffProfile.email,
              role: 'Owner Admin',
              authMethod: '4-Digit PIN',
              terminalId: 'TER-MNL-BAY-01'
            });
          }
        } else {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setPinError(true);
          setErrorMsg('Invalid terminal PIN. Try 2026');
          setTimeout(() => {
            setPin('');
            setPinError(false);
          }, 900);
        }
      }, 350);

      return () => clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }, [pin, view, onLoginSuccess, staffProfile]);

  // Keypad click handler for View B
  const handleKeypadPress = (val) => {
    setErrorMsg('');
    if (val === 'CLEAR') {
      setPin('');
      return;
    }
    if (val === 'BACKSPACE') {
      setPin((prev) => prev.slice(0, -1));
      return;
    }
    if (pin.length < 4) {
      setPin((prev) => prev + val);
    }
  };

  // Submit handler for View A (Console / Password)
  const handleConsoleSubmit = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setErrorMsg('');

    if (password === 'admin2026' || password === 'admin' || password.length >= 4) {
      setIsLoading(true);
      setTimeout(() => {
        setIsLoading(false);
        if (onLoginSuccess) {
          onLoginSuccess({
            username: staffProfile.name,
            email: email.trim() || staffProfile.email,
            role: 'Owner Admin',
            authMethod: 'Password',
            terminalId: 'TER-MNL-BAY-01'
          });
        }
      }, 400);
    } else {
      setErrorMsg('Invalid credentials. Demo password: admin2026');
    }
  };

  // Quick autofill demo credentials
  const handleAutofillDemo = () => {
    setEmail('admin@beardistabrew.com');
    setPassword('admin2026');
    setErrorMsg('');
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F3F4F6] flex flex-col justify-between items-center p-4 sm:p-6 font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif] text-gray-900 selection:bg-[#E58422] selection:text-white relative">
      {/* Top Utility Bar */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 pb-2">
        {onBackToCustomer ? (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onBackToCustomer}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E] font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors"
          >
            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18" />
            </svg>
            <span>Customer Menu</span>
          </button>
        ) : (
          <div />
        )}

        {onSwitchToDesktop && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onSwitchToDesktop}
            className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:text-[#c46914] bg-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 shadow-2xs cursor-pointer"
          >
            ðŸ’» Desktop Portal
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Main Authentication Container */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col items-center flex-1 justify-center my-auto">
        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW A: SIGN IN TO CONSOLE (Reference Image 2)                       */}
        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {view === 'console' && (
          <div className="w-full space-y-5 animate-fadeIn">
            {/* Brand Logo Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-[#E58422] text-white flex items-center justify-center shadow-md shadow-orange-500/20">
                <svg className="w-7 h-7" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M18 8h1a4 4 0 010 8h-1M2 8h16v9a4 4 0 01-4 4H6a4 4 0 01-4-4V8zM6 1v3M10 1v3M14 1v3"
                  />
                </svg>
              </div>
              <span className="text-base font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase">
                Beardista Brew
              </span>

            {/* View Title & Subtitle */}
            <div>

                  <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate">

                </div>
              </div>

              <button

                  setStaffProfile(prev => ({

                    name: prev.name === 'Jim Carlo Gorospe' ? 'Kimberly Ramos' : 'Jim Carlo Gorospe',

                  }));
                }}
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-[#FFF3E7] hover:bg-orange-100 text-[#E58422] text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors cursor-pointer flex-shrink-0"
              >
                Switch
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Demo Hint Banner */}
            <div className="p-2.5 bg-amber-50 rounded-xl border border-amber-200/60 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-amber-900 font-medium">
                <span className="font-bold">Pass:</span> <code className="font-mono bg-white px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[#19244E] font-bold">admin2026</code>
              </span>
              <button

                className="font-black text-[#E58422] hover:underline cursor-pointer"

                Auto-fill
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Error Message */}
            {errorMsg && (
              <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>âš ï¸</span>
                <span>{errorMsg}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Form */}
            <form onSubmit={handleConsoleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              {/* Field 1: Staff Email or ID */}
              <div>
                <label className="block text-[10px] font-black text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                  Staff Email or ID
                </label>
                <div className="relative flex items-center">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                      <path
                        strokeLinecap="round"
                        strokeLinejoin="round"
                        strokeWidth={2}
                        d="M16 7a4 4 0 11-8 0 4 4 0 018 0zM12 14a7 7 0 00-7 7h14a7 7 0 00-7-7z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </span>
                  <input
                    type="text"

                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-3 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] outline-none shadow-2xs"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Field 2: Password */}
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                  <label className="text-[10px] font-black text-gray-600 uppercase tracking-wider">
                    Password
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setErrorMsg('Demo recovery: Use password "admin2026" or click "Use 4-Digit PIN" (2026).')}
                    className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    Forgot password?
                  </button>
                </div>
                <div className="relative flex items-center">
                  <span className="absolute left-3.5 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">

                      <path

                        d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z"
                      />
                    </svg>
                  </span>
                  <input
                    type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                    required
                    value={password}
                    onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢"
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-10 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] outline-none shadow-2xs font-mono"
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                    className="absolute right-3 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 p-1 cursor-pointer"
                    title={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  >
                    {showPassword ? (
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M13.875 18.825A10.05 10.05 0 0112 19c-4.478 0-8.268-2.943-9.543-7a9.97 9.97 0 011.563-3.029m5.858.908a3 3 0 114.243 4.243M9.878 9.878l4.242 4.242M9.88 9.88l-3.29-3.29m7.532 7.532l3.29 3.29M3 3l18 18" />
                      </svg>
                    ) : (
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M15 12a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0z" />
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M2.458 12C3.732 7.943 7.523 5 12 5c4.478 0 8.268 2.943 9.542 7-1.274 4.057-5.064 7-9.542 7-4.477 0-8.268-2.943-9.542-7z" />
                      </svg>
                    )}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Keep terminal active checkbox & "Use 4-Digit PIN" button */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 pt-1">
                <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer select-none">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={keepActive}
                    onChange={(e) => setKeepActive(e.target.checked)}
                    className="w-4 h-4 rounded text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500 border-gray-300 cursor-pointer"
                  />
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 font-semibold">
                    Keep terminal active
                  </span>
                </label>

                {/* Switch to PIN Button */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setView('pin');
                    setPin('');
                    setErrorMsg('');
                  }}
                  className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-[#EFF4FA] hover:bg-blue-50 text-[#19244E] text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all border border-blue-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M4 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM14 6a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2V6zM4 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2H6a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2zM14 16a2 2 0 012-2h2a2 2 0 012 2v2a2 2 0 01-2 2h-2a2 2 0 01-2-2v-2z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Use 4-Digit PIN</span>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Primary Orange Submit Button */}
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isLoading}
                className="w-full py-3.5 px-4 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] active:bg-[#c46914] text-white text-sm font-extrabold rounded-2xl shadow-md shadow-orange-500/25 transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-98 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
              >
                {isLoading ? (
                  <>
                    <span className="w-4 h-4 border-2 border-white border-t-transparent rounded-full animate-spin" />
                    <span>Opening Shift...</span>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <span>Sign In & Open Shift</span>
                    <span className="text-base leading-none">â†’</span>
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW B: ENTER SECURITY PIN (Reference Image 1)                       */}
        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {view === 'pin' && (
          <div className="w-full space-y-4 animate-fadeIn">
            {/* Status Bar simulation header */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-500 px-1">
              <span>9:41</span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                  <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M17.778 8.222c-4.296-4.296-11.26-4.296-15.556 0A1 1 0 01.808 6.808c5.076-5.077 13.308-5.077 18.384 0a1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414zM14.95 11.05a7 7 0 00-9.9 0 1 1 0 01-1.414-1.414 9 9 0 0112.728 0 1 1 0 01-1.414 1.414zm-2.829 2.828a3 3 0 00-4.242 0 1 1 0 01-1.415-1.414 5 5 0 017.072 0 1 1 0 01-1.415 1.414zM9 16a1 1 0 112 0 1 1 0 01-2 0z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                </svg>
                <span className="w-4 h-2.5 rounded-xs border border-gray-500 flex items-center p-0.5">
                  <span className="h-full w-full bg-gray-500 rounded-2xs" />
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Circular Logo & Header */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 justify-center">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-white border border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-center shadow-xs p-1">
                <div className="w-full h-full rounded-full bg-[#19244E] text-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xs">
                  BB
                </div>
              </div>
              <span className="text-sm font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-wider uppercase">
                Beardista Brew
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Staff Card */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl p-3 border border-gray-200/80 shadow-xs flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="relative flex-shrink-0">
                <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] text-white flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm shadow-2xs">
                  {staffProfile.avatarLetter}
                </div>
                <span className="absolute bottom-0 right-0 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-emerald-500 border-2 border-white rounded-full" />
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="font-extrabold text-xs text-[#19244E] truncate">
                  {staffProfile.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate">
                  {staffProfile.email}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Heading & Subtitle */}
            <div className="text-center pt-1">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                Enter Security PIN
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                Authenticate terminal session & shift
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 4 Circular Dot Indicators */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3.5 py-2">
              {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((idx) => {
                const isFilled = pin.length > idx;
                return (
                  <span
                    key={idx}
                    className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full transition-all duration-200 ${
                      isFilled
                        ? 'bg-[#E58422] scale-110 shadow-sm shadow-orange-500/40'
                        : 'bg-slate-200 scale-100'
                    }`}
                  />
                );
              })}
            </div>

            {/* PIN Error notice */}
            {errorMsg && (
              <div className="text-center text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 animate-shake">
                {errorMsg}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Numeric Keypad (3x4 Grid) */}
            <div className={`grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 max-w-xs mx-auto ${pinError ? 'animate-shake' : ''}`}>
              {/* Row 1 */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('1')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>1</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('2')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>2</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">ABC</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('3')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>3</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">DEF</span>
              </button>

              {/* Row 2 */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('4')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>4</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">GHI</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('5')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>5</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">JKL</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('6')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>6</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">MNO</span>
              </button>

              {/* Row 3 */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('7')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>7</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">PQRS</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('8')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>8</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">TUV</span>
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('9')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                <span>9</span>
                <span className="text-[9px] font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-widest -mt-1">WXYZ</span>
              </button>

              {/* Row 4: CLEAR, 0, Backspace */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('CLEAR')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-black text-xs text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                CLEAR
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('0')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-orange-50 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 font-extrabold text-xl text-gray-800 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
              >
                0
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => handleKeypadPress('BACKSPACE')}
                className="h-14 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 active:bg-gray-100 rounded-2xl shadow-xs border border-gray-100 text-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center cursor-pointer active:scale-95 transition-all"
                title="Backspace"
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path
                    strokeLinecap="round"
                    strokeLinejoin="round"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                    d="M12 14l2-2m0 0l2-2m-2 2l-2-2m2 2l2 2M3 12l6-7h12a2 2 0 012 2v10a2 2 0 01-2 2H9l-6-7z"
                  />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Links below keypad: Forgot PIN & Switch to Console */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs px-2 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setErrorMsg('Demo PIN hint: Type 2026 to unlock shift.')}
                className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 font-medium cursor-pointer"
              >
                Forgot PIN?
              </button>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  setView('console');
                  setErrorMsg('');
                }}
                className="font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline cursor-pointer"
              >
                Use Password Login â†’
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      {/* FOOTER: ENCRYPTED TERMINAL FOOTER (Both Views)                        */}
      {/* ==================================================================== */}
      <div className="w-full max-w-sm pt-4 pb-2 text-center border-t border-gray-200/80">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
          <svg className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 flex-shrink-0" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
            <path
              strokeLinecap="round"
              strokeLinejoin="round"
              strokeWidth={2}
              d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z"
            />
          </svg>
          <span>End-to-end encrypted terminal session</span>
        </div>
        <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-1 font-medium">
          Device: iPad Pro 11" â€¢ Manila Bay Branch â€¢ IP: 192.168.1.45
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default MobileLogin;
