// Helper to generate a secure random password
const generateRandomPassword = () => {
  const chars = 'ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnpqrstuvwxyz23456789!@#$%^&*';
  let pass = 'Beardista#';
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    pass += chars.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length));
  }
  return pass;
};

export const UserManagement = ({ onLogAudit }) => {
  // State for Users List
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(INITIAL_USERS);
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [roleFilter, setRoleFilter] = useState('All');

  // Slide-over Drawer States
  const [isDrawerOpen, setIsDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingUser, setEditingUser] = useState(null); // null = creating new user
  const [drawerForm, setDrawerForm] = useState({
    firstName: '',
    lastName: '',
    email: '',
    role: 'Store Admin', // 'Owner Admin' | 'Store Admin'
    status: 'Active',
    password: ''
  });
  const [passwordCopied, setPasswordCopied] = useState(false);
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState('');

  // Delete Modal States
  const [userToDelete, setUserToDelete] = useState(null);

  // In-page Toast Notification
  const [toast, setToast] = useState(null);

  const showToast = (message) => {
    setToast(message);
    setTimeout(() => setToast(null), 3500);
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // FILTERED USERS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const filteredUsers = users.filter((u) => {
    const q = searchQuery.toLowerCase().trim();
    const matchesSearch =
      !q ||
      u.name.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      u.email.toLowerCase().includes(q) ||
      u.role.toLowerCase().includes(q);

    const matchesRole =
      roleFilter === 'All' ||
      (roleFilter === 'Suspended' ? u.status === 'Suspended' : u.role === roleFilter);

    return matchesSearch && matchesRole;
  });

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DRAWER HANDLERS (CREATE / EDIT)
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleOpenAdd = () => {
    setEditingUser(null);
    setDrawerForm({
      firstName: '',
      lastName: '',
      email: '',
      role: 'Store Admin',
      status: 'Active',
      password: generateRandomPassword()
    });
    setFormError('');
    setPasswordCopied(false);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (user) => {
    setEditingUser(user);
    // Map existing role to drawer dropdown value
    const mappedRole = user.role === 'Owner' ? 'Owner Admin' : 'Store Admin';

    setDrawerForm({
      firstName: user.firstName || user.name.split(' ')[0] || '',
      lastName: user.lastName || user.name.split(' ').slice(1).join(' ') || '',
      email: user.email,
      role: mappedRole,
      status: user.status || 'Active',
      password: '' // empty for edit unless regenerated
    });
    setFormError('');
    setPasswordCopied(false);
    setShowPassword(false);
    setIsDrawerOpen(true);
  };

  const handleCloseDrawer = () => {
    setIsDrawerOpen(false);
    setEditingUser(null);
  };

  const handleGeneratePassword = () => {
    const newPass = generateRandomPassword();
    setDrawerForm((prev) => ({ ...prev, password: newPass }));
    setPasswordCopied(false);
    setShowPassword(true);
  };

  const handleCopyPassword = () => {
    if (!drawerForm.password) return;
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(drawerForm.password);
    setPasswordCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setPasswordCopied(false), 2500);
  };

  const handleSaveUser = (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!drawerForm.firstName.trim() || !drawerForm.lastName.trim()) {
      setFormError('Please enter both first and last name.');
      return;
    }
    if (!drawerForm.email.trim() || !drawerForm.email.includes('@')) {
      setFormError('Please enter a valid administrative email address.');
      return;
    }

    // Map dropdown role to standard role label (Owner, Admin)
    const normalizedRole = drawerForm.role === 'Owner Admin' ? 'Owner' : 'Admin';

    const fullName = `${drawerForm.firstName.trim()} ${drawerForm.lastName.trim()}`;

    if (editingUser) {
      // Update existing user
      setUsers((prev) =>
        prev.map((u) =>
          u.id === editingUser.id
            ? {
                ...u,
                firstName: drawerForm.firstName.trim(),
                lastName: drawerForm.lastName.trim(),
                name: fullName,
                email: drawerForm.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
                role: normalizedRole,
                status: drawerForm.status
              }
            : u
        )
      );
      showToast(`User "${fullName}" updated successfully!`);
      if (onLogAudit) {
        onLogAudit('Update User', 'update', fullName, editingUser.id, editingUser.role, normalizedRole);
      }
    } else {
      // Create new user
      const newUser = {
        id: `usr-${Date.now()}`,
        firstName: drawerForm.firstName.trim(),
        lastName: drawerForm.lastName.trim(),
        name: fullName,
        email: drawerForm.email.trim().toLowerCase(),
        role: normalizedRole,
        status: drawerForm.status,
        lastLogin: 'Never (Pending First Login)',
        avatar: 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80'
      };
      setUsers((prev) => [newUser, ...prev]);
      showToast(`New admin "${fullName}" invited with role ${normalizedRole}.`);
      if (onLogAudit) {
        onLogAudit('Create Admin', 'create', fullName, newUser.id, 'None', `Role: ${normalizedRole}`);
      }
    }

    handleCloseDrawer();
  };

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // DELETE / REVOKE ACCESS HANDLERS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  const handleConfirmRevoke = () => {
    if (!userToDelete) return;
    const deletedName = userToDelete.name;
    const deletedId = userToDelete.id;
    setUsers((prev) => prev.filter((u) => u.id !== deletedId));
    setUserToDelete(null);
    showToast(`Access revoked for ${deletedName}.`);
    if (onLogAudit) {
      onLogAudit('Revoke Access', 'delete', deletedName, deletedId, 'Active Access', 'Access Revoked');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 max-w-7xl mx-auto font-['Plus_Jakarta_Sans',sans-serif]">
      {/* Toast Notification */}
      {toast && (
        <div className="fixed top-6 right-6 z-[9999] bg-[#19244E] text-white px-5 py-3.5 rounded-2xl shadow-2xl border border-white/20 flex items-center gap-3 animate-slideDown">
          <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] animate-pulse" />
          <span className="text-xs font-bold">{toast}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* PAGE HEADER                                                          */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
              User Management
            </h1>
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 text-[10px] font-black rounded-md border border-indigo-200">
              RBAC Directory
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
            Manage administrative personnel, assign role-based access control, and revoke employee credentials.
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* Primary Orange Button: "+ Add New Admin" */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleOpenAdd}
          className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-2 self-start sm:self-auto"
        >
          <span className="text-base font-black leading-none">+</span>
          <span>Add New Admin</span>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* SEARCH BAR & ROLE FILTERS                                            */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl p-5 shadow-xs border border-gray-200 space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          {/* Search Input */}
          <div className="relative flex-1 max-w-md">
            <span className="absolute left-4 top-3 text-gray-400 pointer-events-none">
              <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                <path
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                  strokeLinejoin="round"
                  strokeWidth={2}
                  d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z"
                />
              </svg>
            </span>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search admin users by name, email, or role..."
              className="w-full pl-11 pr-10 py-2 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-medium text-gray-800 placeholder-gray-400 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
            />
            {searchQuery && (
              <button
                onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                className="absolute right-3.5 top-2 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer p-1"
              >
                âœ•
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Quick Metrics Badge */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs font-bold text-gray-500">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
              <span>{users.filter((u) => u.status === 'Active').length} Active</span>
            </span>
            <span>Â·</span>
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-400" />
              <span>{users.filter((u) => u.status === 'Suspended').length} Suspended</span>
            </span>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Filter Pills: All, Owner, Admin, Suspended */}
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1 pt-1 no-scrollbar">
          {['All', 'Owner', 'Admin', 'Suspended'].map((filter) => {
            const isActive = roleFilter === filter;
            const count =
              filter === 'All'
                ? users.length
                : filter === 'Suspended'
                ? users.filter((u) => u.status === 'Suspended').length
                : users.filter((u) => u.role === filter).length;

            return (
              <button
                key={filter}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRoleFilter(filter)}
                className={`px-3.5 py-1.5 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer whitespace-nowrap active:scale-95 flex items-center gap-2 ${
                  isActive
                    ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white shadow-xs'
                    : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200/80 hover:text-gray-900'
                }`}
              >
                <span>{filter === 'All' ? 'All Personnel' : filter}</span>
                <span
                  className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-extrabold ${
                    isActive ? 'bg-white/20 text-white' : 'bg-gray-200 text-gray-600'
                  }`}
                >
                  {count}
                </span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* DATA TABLE (READ / DELETE)                                           */}
      {/* Columns: Name, Email, Role, Status, Last Login, Actions              */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-xs border border-gray-200 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse text-xs">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-50/90 text-[11px] font-black uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 border-b border-gray-200">
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Name</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Email</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Role</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Status</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6">Last Login</th>
                <th className="py-4 px-6 text-right">Actions</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
              {filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={6} className="py-12 text-center text-gray-400">
                    <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-3 text-lg">
                      ðŸ‘¥
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">No admin users found</div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-1">
                      Try clearing your search query or adjusting role filter pills.
                    </p>
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredUsers.map((user) => {
                  const isOwner = user.role === 'Owner';
                  const isAdmin = user.role === 'Admin';
                  const isActive = user.status === 'Active';

                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={user.id}
                      className="hover:bg-amber-50/25 transition-colors group"
                    >
                      {/* Name with Avatar */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <img
                            src={user.avatar}
                            alt={user.name}
                            className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full object-cover border border-gray-200 shadow-2xs bg-gray-100 flex-shrink-0"
                            onError={(e) => {
                              e.target.src =
                                'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1535713875002-d1d0cf377fde?auto=format&fit=crop&w=200&q=80';
                            }}
                          />
                          <div>
                            <div className="font-extrabold text-[#19244E] text-xs group-hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors">
                              {user.name}
                            </div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">ID: {user.id}</div>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* Email */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span className="font-semibold text-gray-700 text-xs font-mono">
                          {user.email}
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Role Badge (Owner, Admin) */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {isOwner ? (
                          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-purple-50 text-purple-700 border border-purple-200/80 font-black text-[11px] rounded-lg inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs">
                            <span>ðŸ‘‘</span>
                            <span>Owner</span>
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="px-2.5 py-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200/80 font-black text-[11px] rounded-lg inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs">
                            <span>ðŸ›¡ï¸</span>
                            <span>Admin</span>
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* Status (Active, Suspended) */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 whitespace-nowrap">
                        <span
                          className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded-lg text-[11px] font-extrabold inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 ${
                            isActive
                              ? 'bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200/70'
                              : 'bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200/70'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <span
                            className={`w-1.5 h-1.5 rounded-full ${
                              isActive ? 'bg-emerald-500 animate-pulse' : 'bg-rose-500'
                            }`}
                          />
                          <span>{user.status}</span>
                        </span>
                      </td>

                      {/* Last Login Date */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-500 font-medium">
                        {user.lastLogin}
                      </td>

                      {/* Actions: Edit & Delete (trash) icon */}
                      <td className="py-4 px-6 text-right whitespace-nowrap">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                          {/* Edit button */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(user)}
                            className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-[#19244E] hover:text-white text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-all cursor-pointer active:scale-95 shadow-2xs"
                            title="Edit user details"
                          >
                            Edit
                          </button>

                          {/* Delete (trash) icon button */}
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setUserToDelete(user)}
                            className="p-1.5 text-gray-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                            title="Revoke access"
                          >
                            <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                              <path
                                strokeLinecap="round"
                                strokeLinejoin="round"
                                strokeWidth={2}
                                d="M19 7l-.867 12.142A2 2 0 0116.138 21H7.862a2 2 0 01-1.995-1.858L5 7m5 4v6m4-6v6m1-10V4a1 1 0 00-1-1h-4a1 1 0 00-1 1v3M4 7h16"
                              />
                            </svg>
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* ADD / EDIT ADMIN DRAWER (RIGHT-ALIGNED SLIDING DRAWER)               */}
      {/* Form: First Name, Last Name, Email, Role dropdown, Password gen      */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {isDrawerOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 overflow-hidden">
          {/* Dimmed Backdrop */}
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity cursor-pointer animate-fadeIn"
            onClick={handleCloseDrawer}
          />

          <div className="fixed inset-y-0 right-0 max-w-full flex pl-10">
            <div className="w-screen max-w-md bg-white shadow-2xl flex flex-col justify-between border-l border-gray-200 animate-slideLeft">
              {/* Drawer Header */}
              <div className="px-6 py-5 bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-between border-b border-[#24336c]">
                <div className="flex items-center space-x-3">
                  <div className="w-9 h-9 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] flex items-center justify-center text-white font-black text-sm">
                    {editingUser ? 'âœŽ' : '+'}
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="font-extrabold text-base tracking-tight">
                      {editingUser ? `Edit Admin: ${editingUser.name}` : 'Add New Admin'}
                    </h3>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-[#FFF3E7]/70">
                      {editingUser
                        ? 'Modify role privileges and account status'
                        : 'Provision new administrative credentials'}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCloseDrawer}
                  className="text-gray-300 hover:text-white p-1.5 rounded-lg hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                >
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                  </svg>
                </button>
              </div>

              {/* Drawer Form Body */}
              <form onSubmit={handleSaveUser} className="p-6 flex-1 overflow-y-auto space-y-5">
                {formError && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 text-rose-700 text-xs rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>âš ï¸</span>
                    <span>{formError}</span>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* First Name & Last Name */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      First Name *
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={drawerForm.firstName}
                      onChange={(e) => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, firstName: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="e.g. Maria"
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                      Last Name *
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      required
                      value={drawerForm.lastName}
                      onChange={(e) => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, lastName: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder="e.g. Santos"
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Email Address */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Email Address *
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="email"
                    required
                    value={drawerForm.email}
                    onChange={(e) => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, email: e.target.value })}
                    placeholder="admin@beardistabrew.com"
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-semibold text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all"
                  />
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 mt-1 block">
                    Must be a corporate or authorized store personnel email.
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Role Assignment Dropdown */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Role Assignment Dropdown *
                  </label>
                  <select
                    value={drawerForm.role}
                    onChange={(e) => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, role: e.target.value })}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <option value="Owner Admin">Owner Admin (Full System & Revenue Privileges)</option>
                    <option value="Store Admin">Store Admin (Menu, Availability, and Event Ops)</option>
                  </select>

                  <div className="mt-2 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl border border-gray-200/80 text-[11px] text-gray-600 leading-snug">
                    {drawerForm.role === 'Owner Admin' ? (
                      <p>ðŸ‘‘ <strong>Owner Admin:</strong> Unrestricted access to financial metrics, billing, audit histories, and staff credentials.</p>
                    ) : (
                      <p>ðŸ›¡ï¸ <strong>Store Admin:</strong> Full operational controls over the live catalog, inventory availability, and customer surveys.</p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Status Toggle */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider mb-1.5">
                    Account Status
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, status: 'Active' })}
                      className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                        drawerForm.status === 'Active'
                          ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800'
                          : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />
                      <span>Active</span>
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, status: 'Suspended' })}
                      className={`py-2 px-3 rounded-xl text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 ${
                        drawerForm.status === 'Suspended'
                          ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-800'
                          : 'bg-white border-gray-200 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-rose-500" />
                      <span>Suspended</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Initial Password Generator Field */}
                <div className="p-4 bg-orange-50/50 rounded-2xl border border-[#E58422]/30 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wider">
                      Initial Temporary Password
                    </label>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleGeneratePassword}
                      className="text-[11px] font-extrabold text-[#E58422] hover:text-[#c96f18] cursor-pointer flex items-center gap-1"
                    >
                      <span>ðŸ”„</span>
                      <span>Generate Secure</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>

                  <div className="relative flex items-center">
                    <input
                      type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                      value={drawerForm.password}
                      onChange={(e) => setDrawerForm({ ...drawerForm, password: e.target.value })}
                      placeholder={editingUser ? 'Leave blank to preserve current password' : 'Click Generate Secure Password'}
                      className="w-full pl-3 pr-20 py-2.5 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-xs font-mono font-bold text-gray-800 outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#E58422]"
                    />
                    <div className="absolute right-2 flex items-center gap-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                        className="p-1 text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xs cursor-pointer"
                        title={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                      >
                        {showPassword ? 'ðŸ™ˆ' : 'ðŸ‘ï¸'}
                      </button>
                      {drawerForm.password && (
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={handleCopyPassword}
                          className="px-2 py-1 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-[10px] font-extrabold rounded-md cursor-pointer transition-all"
                          title="Copy to clipboard"
                        >
                          {passwordCopied ? 'Copied!' : 'Copy'}
                        </button>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">
                    The admin will be requested to change this temporary credential upon their first sign-in.
                  </p>
                </div>
              </form>

              {/* Drawer Footer Buttons: Cancel & Save User */}
              <div className="px-6 py-4 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200 flex items-center justify-end gap-3">
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleCloseDrawer}
                  className="px-4 py-2.5 text-xs font-bold text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
                >
                  Cancel
                </button>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={handleSaveUser}
                  className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
                >
                  Save User
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {/* CENTERED DELETE / REVOKE CONFIRMATION MODAL                          */}
      {/* Prompt: "Are you sure you want to revoke this user's access?"        */}
      {/* -------------------------------------------------------------------- */}
      {userToDelete && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div
            className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs transition-opacity cursor-pointer"
            onClick={() => setUserToDelete(null)}
          />

          <div className="relative bg-white rounded-3xl max-w-md w-full p-6 shadow-2xl border border-gray-100 z-10 animate-scaleUp space-y-4">
            <div className="w-12 h-12 rounded-2xl bg-rose-100 text-rose-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-bold mx-auto shadow-sm">
              âš ï¸
            </div>

            <div className="text-center space-y-1">
              <h3 className="text-base font-black text-[#19244E]">
                Revoke Admin Access
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800">
                Are you sure you want to revoke this user's access?
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Target User Summary Card */}
            <div className="p-3.5 bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 flex items-center gap-3">
              <img
                src={userToDelete.avatar}
                alt={userToDelete.name}
                className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full object-cover border border-gray-300"
              />
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 text-left">
                <div className="text-xs font-extrabold text-[#19244E] truncate">
                  {userToDelete.name}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 truncate">
                  {userToDelete.email}
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] mt-0.5">
                  Role: {userToDelete.role}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 text-center leading-relaxed">
              This action will permanently terminate this administrative account and invalidate all active session tokens for the Beardista Brew Admin Portal.
            </p>

            {/* Modal Buttons */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setUserToDelete(null)}
                className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-gray-100 hover:bg-gray-200 text-gray-700 text-xs font-bold rounded-xl transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleConfirmRevoke}
                className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white text-xs font-extrabold rounded-xl transition-all shadow-md cursor-pointer active:scale-95"
              >
                Revoke Access
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default UserManagement;

};

};

import React, { useState } from 'react';

/**
 * 5 Official Terms & Conditions specified for the Latte Art Throwdown
 */
export const THROWDOWN_TERMS = [
  {
    id: 1,
    title: "1. Throwdown Rules & Acceptance",
    content:
      "By registering for the Beardista Brew Latte Art Throwdown, competitors and guests agree to adhere to the official bracket rules, judging criteria, and call times announced by the organizing committee. Competitors must arrive 30 minutes before their designated heat."
  },
  {
    id: 2,
    title: "2. Media & Broadcast Release",
    content:
      "Attendees and competitors grant Beardista Brew full and unrestricted rights to use photography, audiovisual footage, and competition pours captured during the event for promotional, live-stream, and social media purposes."
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    title: "3. Sportsmanship & Conduct",
    content:
      "A fair, respectful, and encouraging environment is mandatory. Unsportsmanlike conduct or interference with judges, equipment, or fellow baristas may result in immediate disqualification without refund."
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    title: "4. Safety & Equipment Liability",
    content:
      "Participants agree to handle commercial espresso machines and steaming pitchers with standard cafÃ© safety protocols. Beardista Brew holds no liability for minor slips, hot liquid scalds, or personal gear loss."
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    title: "5. Registration Transfer & Cancellations",
    content:
      "Competitor slots are non-refundable after October 30, 2026, but can be transferred to another certified barista with 48 hours advance notice by emailing throwdown@beardistabrew.com."
  }
];

/**
 * EventDetailsModal Component
 * @param {Object} props
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Whether the modal dialog is visible
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Callback function to dismiss the modal
 * @param {Object} props.eventData - Context data for the event
 */
export const EventDetailsModal = ({ isOpen, onClose, eventData }) => {
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // STATE DEFINITIONS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Role selection: 'competitor' (Image 1) or 'spectator' (Image 2)
  const [role, setRole] = useState('competitor');

  // Multi-step tracker:
  // Step 1: Initial Profile & Terms
  // Step 2: Competitor details (only for role === 'competitor')
  // Step 3: Confirmation / Thank You modal (Image 4)
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

  // Form input data state
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    fullName: '',
    age: '',
    email: '',
    contactNumber: '',
    agreedToTerms: false,
    baristaRole: 'Barista',
    representingCafe: '',
    experience: '1â€“2 years'
  });

  // State to toggle the dedicated Terms & Conditions dialog
  const [showTermsModal, setShowTermsModal] = useState(false);

  // State to hold generated registration reference code
  const [refCode, setRefCode] = useState('');

  // Form validation feedback state
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState('');

  // Guard: Do not render anything when modal is not active
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  // HANDLERS
  // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  // Handle generic text/select input updates with strict constraints
  const handleInputChange = (field, value) => {
    // 1. AGE CONSTRAINT: Maximum 99 years old, non-negative digits only
    if (field === 'age') {
      const digitsOnly = value.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (digitsOnly === '') {
        setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, age: '' }));
      } else {
        const num = parseInt(digitsOnly, 10);
        // Prevent exceeding 99 years old
        if (num > 99) {
          setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, age: '99' }));
        } else {
          setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, age: String(num) }));
        }
      }
      if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
      return;
    }

    // 2. CONTACT NUMBER CONSTRAINT: Maximum 10 digits only
    if (field === 'contactNumber') {
      const digitsOnly = value.replace(/\D/g, '').slice(0, 10);
      setFormData((prev) => ({ ...prev, contactNumber: digitsOnly }));
      if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
      return;
    }

    // Default for other fields
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value
    }));
    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
  };

  // Switch role between competitor and spectator
  const handleRoleSelect = (selectedRole) => {
    setRole(selectedRole);
    if (errorMessage) setErrorMessage('');
  };

  // Validate Step 1 and proceed
  const handleNextStep1 = () => {
    // 1. Validate Full Name
    if (!formData.fullName.trim()) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter your full name.');
      return;
    }

    // 2. Validate Age: Cannot exceed 99 years old
    const ageNum = parseInt(formData.age, 10);
    if (!formData.age.trim() || isNaN(ageNum) || ageNum < 1 || ageNum > 99) {
      setErrorMessage('Age must be a valid number between 1 and 99 years old.');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Validate Email Address: Must contain '@' and '.com'
    const emailTrimmed = formData.email.trim();
    if (!emailTrimmed) {
      setErrorMessage('Please enter your email address.');
      return;
    }
    const hasAt = emailTrimmed.includes('@');
    const hasDotCom = emailTrimmed.toLowerCase().includes('.com');
    const validFormat = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.com$/i.test(emailTrimmed);
    if (!hasAt || !hasDotCom || !validFormat) {
      setErrorMessage("Email address must have a valid format containing '@' and ending with '.com' (e.g. name@example.com).");
      return;
    }

    // 4. Validate Contact Number: Exactly 10 digits for competitor
    if (role === 'competitor') {
      const cleanNumber = formData.contactNumber.replace(/\D/g, '');
      if (!cleanNumber) {
        setErrorMessage('Please enter your 10-digit contact number.');
        return;
      }
      if (cleanNumber.length !== 10) {
        setErrorMessage('Contact number must be exactly 10 digits (e.g. 9123456789).');
        return;
      }
    }

    // 5. Validate Terms & Conditions agreement
    if (!formData.agreedToTerms) {
      setErrorMessage('Please read and agree to the Terms & Conditions.');
      return;
    }

    setErrorMessage('');

    if (role === 'competitor') {
      // Competitor proceeds to Step 2 (Tell us about yourself)
      setCurrentStep(2);
    } else {
      // Spectator completes reservation in 1 step -> generates ref & moves to Thank You
      const generatedRef = `BB-SPEC-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
      setRefCode(generatedRef);

      // Simulate database POST request for academic defense
      console.log('Simulating Spectator Reservation MySQL POST:', {
        role: 'Spectator',
        refCode: generatedRef,
        ...formData
      });

      setCurrentStep(3);
    }
  };

  // Complete Step 2 for Competitor registration
  const handleSubmitCompetitor = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();

    const generatedRef = `BB-COMP-${Math.floor(1000 + Math.random() * 9000)}`;
    setRefCode(generatedRef);

    // Simulate database POST request for academic defense
    console.log('Simulating Competitor Registration MySQL POST:', {
      role: 'Competitor',
      refCode: generatedRef,
      ...formData
    });

    setCurrentStep(3);
  };

  // Reset modal state and close
  const handleModalClose = () => {
    onClose();
    // Reset wizard back to initial state after smooth exit
    setTimeout(() => {
      setRole('competitor');
      setCurrentStep(1);
      setFormData({
        fullName: '',
        age: '',
        email: '',
        contactNumber: '',
        agreedToTerms: false,
        baristaRole: 'Barista',
        representingCafe: '',
        experience: '1â€“2 years'
      });
      setErrorMessage('');
      setShowTermsModal(false);
    }, 200);
  };

  return (
    // Backdrop overlay
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs overflow-y-auto"
      onClick={handleModalClose}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Container */}
      <div
        className="relative bg-white w-full max-w-[560px] rounded-[32px] overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/10 my-8 transition-all"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {/* VIEW 1 & 2: REGISTRATION FORM (STEP 1 & STEP 2)                      */}
        {/* ==================================================================== */}
        {currentStep !== 3 ? (
          <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10">
            {/* Top Bar: Brand Pill + Close Button */}
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center px-3.5 py-1 bg-[#FFF3E7] border border-[#E58422]/30 text-[#E58422] text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full">
                Beardista Brew Specialty
              </span>

              <button
                onClick={handleModalClose}
                className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Header Title & Subtitle */}
            <div className="mb-6">
              <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight uppercase">
                REGISTRATION
              </h2>
              <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm mt-1">
                {currentStep === 1
                  ? 'Please fill out your information below to reserve your slot.'
                  : 'Tell us about yourself!'}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* STEP 1: ROLE SELECTION & PERSONAL DETAILS (IMAGES 1 & 2)         */}
            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {currentStep === 1 && (
              <div className="space-y-5">
                {/* 2-Column Role Selection Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3.5">
                  {/* Card 1: COMPETITOR */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleRoleSelect('competitor')}
                    className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      role === 'competitor'
                        ? 'border-2 border-[#E58422] bg-white shadow-xs'
                        : 'border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {/* Trophy Icon */}
                      <div
                        className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          role === 'competitor'
                            ? 'bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]'
                            : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 14l9-5-9-5-9 5 9 5zm0 0l6.16-3.422a12.083 12.083 0 01.665 6.479A11.952 11.952 0 0012 20.055a11.952 11.952 0 00-5.825-1.998 12.078 12.078 0 01.665-6.479L12 14zm-4 6v-7.5l4-2.222" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="font-black text-[#19244E] text-sm leading-tight">
                          COMPETITOR{' '}
                          <span className="text-[#E58422] font-bold text-xs">
                            (MGA KASALI)
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-gray-400 text-[11px] mt-0.5">
                          Compete in the throwdown
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Radio Button Indicator */}
                    <div className="ml-2 shrink-0">
                      {role === 'competitor' ? (
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] text-white flex items-center justify-center">
                          <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>

                  {/* Card 2: SPECTATOR */}
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleRoleSelect('spectator')}
                    className={`relative p-4 rounded-2xl flex items-center justify-between text-left transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                      role === 'spectator'
                        ? 'border-2 border-[#E58422] bg-white shadow-xs'
                        : 'border border-gray-200 bg-white hover:border-gray-300'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      {/* Spectator User Group Icon */}
                      <div
                        className={`w-11 h-11 rounded-xl flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                          role === 'spectator'
                            ? 'bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]'
                            : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-400'
                        }`}
                      >
                        <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>

                      <div>
                        <div className="font-bold text-[#19244E] text-sm leading-tight">
                          SPECTATOR
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-gray-500 font-semibold text-xs leading-tight">
                          (MANONOOD/BISITA)
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-gray-400 text-[11px] mt-0.5">
                          Audience &amp; spectator pass
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Radio Button Indicator */}
                    <div className="ml-2 shrink-0">
                      {role === 'spectator' ? (
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] text-white flex items-center justify-center">
                          <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="w-5 h-5 rounded-full border-2 border-gray-300" />
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </button>
                </div>

                {/* Form Inputs */}
                <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                  {/* Full Name */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase mb-1.5">
                      FULL NAME <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="FULL NAME"
                      value={formData.fullName}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('fullName', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Age and Email Address Row */}
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {/* Age */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase">
                          AGE <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold">Max 99 yrs</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="relative">
                        <input
                          type="text"
                          inputMode="numeric"
                          maxLength={2}
                          placeholder="e.g. 24"
                          value={formData.age}
                          onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('age', e.target.value)}
                          className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors pr-14"
                        />
                        <span className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 select-none">
                          YRS
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* Email Address */}
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase">
                          EMAIL ADDRESS <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold">Must have @ &amp; .com</span>
                      </div>
                      <input
                        type="email"
                        placeholder="name@example.com"
                        value={formData.email}
                        onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('email', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Contact Number (Shown for Competitor in Image 1) */}
                  {role === 'competitor' && (
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-1.5">
                        <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase">
                          CONTACT NUMBER <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                        </label>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 font-semibold">
                          {formData.contactNumber.length}/10 digits max
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex border border-gray-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden focus-within:border-[#E58422] transition-colors">
                        {/* Country code prefix */}
                        <div className="px-3.5 py-3 bg-gray-50 border-r border-gray-200 flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 select-none">
                          <span role="img" aria-label="Philippines" className="text-base">
                            ðŸ‡µðŸ‡­
                          </span>
                          <span>+63</span>
                          <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-gray-400" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                          </svg>
                        </div>
                        {/* Phone input */}
                        <input
                          type="tel"
                          inputMode="numeric"
                          maxLength={10}
                          placeholder="912 345 6789"
                          value={formData.contactNumber}
                          onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('contactNumber', e.target.value)}
                          className="flex-1 px-4 py-3 bg-white text-sm text-[#111111] placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* Terms & Conditions Checkbox */}
                  <div className="pt-2">
                    <label className="flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer select-none">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        checked={formData.agreedToTerms}
                        onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('agreedToTerms', e.target.checked)}
                        className="mt-0.5 w-4 h-4 rounded text-[#E58422] focus:ring-[#E58422] border-gray-300 cursor-pointer accent-[#E58422]"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                        I agree to the{' '}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setShowTermsModal(true)}
                          className="font-bold underline text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          TERMS &amp; CONDITIONS
                        </button>{' '}
                        and{' '}
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => setShowTermsModal(true)}
                          className="font-bold underline text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422] cursor-pointer"
                        >
                          PRIVACY POLICY
                        </button>
                        .
                      </span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Validation Error Banner */}
                {errorMessage && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-600 text-xs rounded-xl font-medium">
                    {errorMessage}
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* Step Indicator & Action Button Area */}
                <div className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                  {/* Competitor shows "STEP 1 OF 2" with 2 progress bars (Image 1) */}
                  {role === 'competitor' ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-wider uppercase">
                          STEP 1 OF 2
                        </span>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <div className="w-8 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422]" />
                          <div className="w-8 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-gray-200" />
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* "NEXT âž”" Button */}
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={handleNextStep1}
                        className="w-full py-4 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white font-bold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <span>NEXT</span>
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3" />
                        </svg>
                      </button>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    /* Spectator shows "RESERVE MY SLOT âž”" directly (Image 2) */
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={handleNextStep1}
                      className="w-full py-4 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white font-bold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      <span>RESERVE MY SLOT</span>
                      <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                        <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3" />
                      </svg>
                    </button>
                  )}

                  {/* Security Guarantee Badge */}
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-gray-400 font-medium">
                    <svg className="w-3.5 h-3.5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 15v2m-6 4h12a2 2 0 002-2v-6a2 2 0 00-2-2H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v6a2 2 0 002 2zm10-10V7a4 4 0 00-8 0v4h8z" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>256-bit Encrypted Reservation Guarantee</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {/* STEP 2: COMPETITOR DETAILS (IMAGE 3)                             */}
            {/* ---------------------------------------------------------------- */}
            {currentStep === 2 && (
              <div className="space-y-6">
                {/* Back Link + Step Badge */}
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-3 border-b border-gray-100">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setCurrentStep(1)}
                    className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M10 19l-7-7m0 0l7-7m-7 7h18" />
                    </svg>
                    <span>BACK</span>
                  </button>

                  <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] px-3 py-1 rounded-full uppercase tracking-wider">
                    COMPETITOR DETAILS
                  </span>
                </div>

                {/* Sub-heading */}
                <div>
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-black text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-tight">
                    TELL US ABOUT YOURSELF!
                  </h3>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-1">
                    Configure your competitor profile and coffee background for the judges table.
                  </p>
                </div>

                {/* Input Fields */}
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {/* Role Dropdown */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase mb-1.5">
                      WHAT IS YOUR ROLE? <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <select
                        value={formData.baristaRole}
                        onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('baristaRole', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors appearance-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <option value="Barista">Barista</option>
                        <option value="Head Barista">Head Barista</option>
                        <option value="Home Brewer / Enthusiast">Home Brewer / Enthusiast</option>
                        <option value="Coffee Roaster">Coffee Roaster</option>
                        <option value="CafÃ© Owner / Manager">CafÃ© Owner / Manager</option>
                      </select>
                      <div className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* Representing What Cafe */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase mb-1.5">
                      REPRESENTING WHAT CAFE?{' '}
                      <span className="text-gray-400 font-normal">(OPTIONAL)</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="e.g. Beardista Brew, Yardstick, Independent"
                      value={formData.representingCafe}
                      onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('representingCafe', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] placeholder:text-gray-300 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Years of Experience */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-[11px] font-black tracking-wider text-[#19244E] uppercase mb-1.5">
                      YEARS OF EXPERIENCE <span className="text-[#E58422]">*</span>
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <select
                        value={formData.experience}
                        onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('experience', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl text-sm text-[#111111] focus:outline-none focus:border-[#E58422] transition-colors appearance-none cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <option value="< 1 year">&lt; 1 year</option>
                        <option value="1â€“2 years">1â€“2 years</option>
                        <option value="3â€“5 years">3â€“5 years</option>
                        <option value="5+ years">5+ years</option>
                      </select>
                      <div className="absolute right-4 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 pointer-events-none text-gray-400">
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                        </svg>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Progress Indicator & Submit Button */}
                <div className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="font-bold text-gray-400 tracking-wider uppercase">
                      STEP 2 OF 2
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <div className="w-8 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422]" />
                      <div className="w-8 h-1.5 rounded-full bg-[#E58422]" />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={handleSubmitCompetitor}
                    className="w-full py-4 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white font-bold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 cursor-pointer"
                  >
                    <span>SUBMIT REGISTRATION</span>
                    <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m6 2a9 9 0 11-18 0 9 9 0 0118 0z" />
                    </svg>
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        ) : (
          /* ================================================================== */
          /* VIEW 3: CONFIRMATION / THANK YOU MODAL (IMAGE 4)                   */
          /* ================================================================== */
          <div className="p-8 sm:p-10 text-center">
            {/* Close 'X' Button at top-right */}
            <div className="flex justify-end mb-2">
              <button
                onClick={handleModalClose}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-100 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close"
              >
                <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Glowing Circular Icon with Envelope & Checkmark */}
            <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full bg-[#ECFDF5] border border-[#A7F3D0] flex items-center justify-center mx-auto mb-5 text-[#059669] shadow-sm">
              <svg className="w-10 h-10" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.8}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M3 8l7.89 5.26a2 2 0 002.22 0L21 8M5 19h14a2 2 0 002-2V7a2 2 0 00-2-2H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v10a2 2 0 002 2z" />
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M16 11l2 2 4-4" />
              </svg>
            </div>

            {/* Registration Confirmed Pill Badge */}
            <div className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#FFF3E7] border border-[#E58422]/30 text-[#E58422] text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full mb-3">
              <span>âœ¨</span>
              <span>REGISTRATION CONFIRMED</span>
            </div>

            {/* Headline */}
            <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-tight">
              {role === 'competitor' ? 'COMPETITOR RESERVED!' : 'SPECTATOR RESERVED!'}
            </h2>

            {/* Sub-headline as requested */}
            <p className="text-gray-600 text-sm sm:text-base mt-2 mb-6">
              Please check your email for more details. See you!
            </p>

            {/* Confirmation Receipt Box */}
            <div className="bg-[#F8FAFC] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-2xl p-5 text-left space-y-1.5 mb-8">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 border-b border-gray-200/60">
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wider">
                  REGISTRATION REF
                </span>
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] font-mono">
                  {refCode || (role === 'competitor' ? 'BB-COMP-2048' : 'BB-SPEC-1024')}
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Name */}
              <div className="pt-2 font-bold text-[#19244E] text-sm">
                {formData.fullName || 'Participant'}
              </div>

              {/* Email */}
              <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                {formData.email || 'guest@example.com'}
              </div>

              {/* Role Line */}
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] pt-1">
                Role:{' '}
                {role === 'competitor'
                  ? 'Competitor (mga kasali)'
                  : 'Spectator (manonood/bisita)'}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Primary Action "THANK YOU" Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleModalClose}
              className="w-full py-4 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white font-bold text-sm tracking-wider uppercase rounded-2xl shadow-lg shadow-orange-500/20 active:scale-[0.99] transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              THANK YOU
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ====================================================================== */}
      {/* OVERLAY: 5 OFFICIAL TERMS & CONDITIONS DIALOG                          */}
      {/* ====================================================================== */}
      {showTermsModal && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xs"
          onClick={() => setShowTermsModal(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="bg-white w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[85dvh] rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl flex flex-col border border-black/10"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            {/* Header */}
            <div className="p-6 bg-[#19244E] text-white flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-widest block mb-0.5">
                  Official Event Policies
                </span>
                <h3 className="text-lg md:text-xl font-bold">
                  Latte Art Throwdown Terms &amp; Conditions
                </h3>
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setShowTermsModal(false)}
                className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-white/70 hover:text-white hover:bg-white/10 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close Terms"
              >
                <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Terms List Body */}
            <div className="p-6 md:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 text-[#111111]">
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
                Please review the guidelines below governing registration, participant conduct, media rights, and liability for the Beardista Brew Latte Art Throwdown.
              </p>

              <div className="space-y-5">
                {THROWDOWN_TERMS.map((term) => (
                  <div key={term.id} className="p-4 bg-neutral-50 rounded-xl border border-gray-100">
                    <h4 className="font-bold text-sm text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                      {term.title}
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 leading-relaxed">
                      {term.content}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Footer */}
            <div className="p-4 bg-gray-50 border-t border-gray-200 flex justify-between items-center">
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">
                Effective for October 2026 Event
              </span>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => {
                  handleInputChange('agreedToTerms', true);
                  setShowTermsModal(false);
                }}
                className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#E58422] hover:bg-[#d47414] text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full cursor-pointer transition-colors"
              >
                I Understand &amp; Agree
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default EventDetailsModal;
