import React, { useState } from 'react';

/**
 * FaqSection component renders an interactive FAQ accordion.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Array} props.faqs - Array of FAQ items from menuData
 */
export const FAQSection = ({ faqs }) => {
  // State tracking which question is currently expanded (null = all collapsed)
  const [activeId, setActiveId] = useState(null);

  // Toggle handler for accordion behavior
  const toggleFaq = (id) => {
    setActiveId(activeId === id ? null : id);
  };

  return (
    // Section wrapper with top divider and cream background
    <section className="py-16 md:py-24 bg-cream px-6 md:px-16 border-t border-black/10" id="faq-section">
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto">
        
        {/* Section Headline matching reference image: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS */}
        <div className="text-center mb-12">
          <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl md:text-4xl font-extrabold text-primary uppercase tracking-widest">
            FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
          </h2>
          {/* Centered Orange Accent Divider */}
          <div className="w-16 h-1 bg-accent mx-auto mt-4 rounded-full" />
        </div>

        {/* Accordion List Container */}
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {faqs.map((faq) => {
            const isOpen = activeId === faq.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={faq.id}
                className="bg-white border border-black/10 rounded-xl overflow-hidden shadow-sm transition-all duration-200"
              >
                {/* Accordion Header / Clickable Trigger */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => toggleFaq(faq.id)}
                  className="w-full px-6 py-5 flex justify-between items-center text-left bg-white transition-colors focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
                  aria-expanded={isOpen}
                >
                  {/* Question Title */}
                  <span className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-primary">
                    {faq.question}
                  </span>

                  {/* Down / Up Chevron Vector Indicator with rotation transition */}
                  <svg
                    className={`w-5 h-5 text-primary transition-transform duration-300 transform shrink-0 ml-4 ${
                      isOpen ? 'rotate-180 text-accent' : ''
                    }`}
                    fill="none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    stroke="currentColor"
                    strokeWidth={2}
                  >
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                  </svg>
                </button>

                {/* Collapsible Answer Body: Rendered only when activeId matches */}
                {isOpen && (
                  <div className="px-6 pb-5 pt-1 text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#111111] border-t border-black/5">
                    <p>{faq.answer}</p>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            );
          })}
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

```

/>

import React, { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import storyImg from "@/assets/our_story.jpg";
// Import your real layout components
import { Navbar } from "@/components/Navbar.jsx";
import { Footer } from "@/components/Footer.jsx";

// Import all your local images from the assets folder

import mottoBgImg from "@/assets/our_story.jpg";
import ownerImg from '@/assets/owner_pic.jpg';
import baristaBen from '@/assets/barista_ben.jpg';
import baristaDais from '@/assets/barista_dais.jpg';
import baristaJa from '@/assets/barista_ja.jpg';

const storyNarrative = [
  { 
    id: 1, 
    paragraph: "Beardista Brew began in 2020 during the height of the pandemic. Even with all the strict limitations, our passion for crafting and sharing great drinks never stopped. We wanted to build more than just a standard cafe; our vision was to create a unique space that offered the best of both worldsâ€”a coffee shop and bar open from the afternoon straight through to midnight." 
  },
  { 
    id: 2, 
    paragraph: "We would not be where we are today without the incredible support of our community. From the local regulars who stood by us since our humble beginnings, to the talented artists who hang out and bring life to our space, you all made this dream possible. Today, Beardista Brew remains a welcoming home for everyone to connect over exceptional coffee and cocktails." 
  }
];

const mottoData = {
  backgroundImage: mottoBgImg,
  motto: "To serve quality specialty handcrafted drinks and to serve the community.",
  tagline: "OUR MISSION"
};

const visionaryData = {
  image: ownerImg,
  title: "The Visionary",
  name: "Mr. Jim Carlo Gorospe",
  role: "Founder & Head Roaster",
  bio: "Jim started his career as a bartender in the corporate world, but the grueling, fast-paced environment slowly drained his creative passion. Looking for a fresh spark, he began experimentingâ€”blending his mixology background with rich espresso, craft alcohol, and the local art scene. Today, as the founder of Beardista Brew, Jimâ€™s philosophy is simple: every drink is a canvas.",
  favoriteDrink: "Kape-ling ang asawa ko"
};

const teamMembers = [
  { id: 1, name: "Ben", role: "Lead Barista", funFact: "Can pour a perfect dragon blindfolded.", image: baristaBen },
  { id: 2, name: "Dais", role: "Barista", funFact: "Master of the Tsamporado blend.", image: baristaDais },
  { id: 3, name: "Ja", role: "Barista", funFact: "Knows your regular order before you even speak.", image: baristaJa }
];

// ==============================================================================
// MAIN COMPONENT: OurStory
// ==============================================================================
export default function OurStory({ onNavigate, onOpenSurvey }) {
  const [selectedBaristaId, setSelectedBaristaId] = useState(null);

  // Automatically scroll to top when page opens
  useEffect(() => {
    window.scrollTo(0, 0);
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#111111] flex flex-col antialiased">

              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E58422]">
                THE ROOTS
              </span>
              <h1 className="text-4xl sm:text-5xl md:text-6xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] tracking-tight leading-none lowercase">
                our story
              </h1>
              <div className="space-y-6 pt-2">
                {storyNarrative.map((item) => (
                  <p key={item.id} className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#111111] leading-relaxed font-normal">
                    {item.paragraph}
                  </p>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>
        </section>

        {/* SECTION 2: MOTTO & MISSION BANNER */}
        <section className="relative py-24 md:py-32 px-6 md:px-16 overflow-hidden">
          <div className="absolute inset-0 z-0">
            <img src={mottoData.backgroundImage} alt="Beardista Brew atmosphere" className="w-full h-full object-cover" />
            <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/65 backdrop-blur-[1px]" />
          </div>

          <div className="relative z-10 max-w-4xl mx-auto text-center flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-4">
            <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full border border-[#E58422]/60 flex items-center justify-center text-[#E58422] mb-1">
              <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M18 8h1a4 4 0 010 8h-1M2 8h16v9a4 4 0 01-4 4H6a4 4 0 01-4-4V8z" />
                <line x1="6" y1="1" x2="6" y2="4" />
                <line x1="10" y1="1" x2="10" y2="4" />
                <line x1="14" y1="1" x2="14" y2="4" />

        </section>

        {/* SECTION 3: THE VISIONARY */}

          <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center flex flex-col items-center space-y-5">
            <div className="relative mb-2">
              <div className="w-36 h-36 sm:w-44 sm:h-44 rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border-3 border-[#E58422] shadow-xl p-1 bg-white">
                <img src={visionaryData.image} alt={visionaryData.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-xl" loading="lazy" />
              </div>
            </div>
            <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
              {visionaryData.title}
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base font-semibold text-[#E58422]">
              {visionaryData.name}, {visionaryData.role}
            </p>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#111111]/85 leading-relaxed font-normal max-w-2xl">
              {visionaryData.bio}
            </p>
            <div className="pt-2">
              <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 bg-white/80 border border-neutral-300 rounded-full text-xs font-medium text-[#111111] shadow-2xs">
                <span>â˜•</span>
                <span>Favorite Drink: {visionaryData.favoriteDrink}</span>
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

        {/* SECTION 4: MEET THE TEAM */}
        <section className="py-16 md:py-24 px-6 md:px-16 bg-[#FFF3E7]">
          <div className="max-w-[1280px] mx-auto">
            <div className="text-center mb-14 space-y-2">
              <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                Meet the Team
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-neutral-600">
                The skilled hands behind your favorite brew.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 items-end">
              {teamMembers.map((member, index) => {
                const isSelected = selectedBaristaId === member.id;
                const isMiddle = index === 1;

                return (
                  <div
                    key={member.id}
                    onClick={() => setSelectedBaristaId(isSelected ? null : member.id)}
                    className={`bg-white rounded-none border border-black/10 overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col cursor-pointer ${
                      isSelected ? 'ring-2 ring-[#E58422]' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    <div className={`w-full overflow-hidden bg-neutral-100 ${isMiddle ? 'h-80 sm:h-96' : 'h-72 sm:h-80'}`}>
                      <img src={member.image} alt={member.name} className="w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 hover:scale-105" loading="lazy" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-6 flex flex-col space-y-2 bg-white">
                      <h3 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">{member.name}</h3>
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider">{member.role}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-neutral-600 leading-relaxed pt-1">{member.funFact}</p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          </div>
        </section>

      </main>

      {/* 5. Real Footer */}
      <Footer />

    </div>
  );
}

import React, { useState } from 'react';
import qrImg from '@/assets/wifi_qr.jpg'; // <-- Imported local QR image

/**
 * StayConnected component displays the cafe's public WiFi credentials.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Object} props.wifi - WiFi credentials object { ssid, password }
 */
export const StayConnected = ({ wifi }) => {
  // State for copying to clipboard
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
  // State for toggling password visibility
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  // Clipboard copy handler
  const copyPassword = () => {
    navigator.clipboard.writeText(wifi.password);
    setCopied(true);
    setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 2000);
  };

  return (
    // Section wrapper with top divider and cream background
    <section className="py-16 md:py-24 bg-[#FFF3E7] px-6 md:px-16 border-t border-black/10" id="wifi-section">
      <div className="max-w-3xl mx-auto text-center">
        
        {/* Section Headline */}
        <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] mb-12 uppercase tracking-widest">
          STAY CONNECTED.
        </h2>

        {/* Centered White Credentials Card */}
        <div className="bg-white p-8 md:p-12 rounded-2xl shadow-xl flex flex-col items-center border border-black/10">
          
          {/* QR Code Container with dashed border */}
          <div className="w-52 h-52 bg-white mb-8 flex flex-col items-center justify-center border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 p-4 rounded-xl relative">
            {/* Local QR Image */}
            <img 
              src={qrImg} 
              alt="Scan to connect to WiFi" 
              className="w-full h-full object-cover rounded-lg"
            />
          </div>

          {/* Credentials Display Rows (SSID and Password) */}
          <div className="space-y-4 w-full max-w-sm">
            
            {/* Row 1: WiFi Network Name (SSID) */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-black/10 pb-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#111111]/80 uppercase tracking-wider">
                WIFI NAME
              </span>
              <span className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E] tracking-wide">
                {wifi.ssid}
              </span>
            </div>

            {/* Row 2: WiFi Password with Show/Hide and Copy actions */}
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center border-b border-black/10 pb-3">
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#111111]/80 uppercase tracking-wider">
                PASSWORD
              </span>
              
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                {/* Password Text (Hidden or Shown) */}
                <span className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E] tracking-wide font-mono">
                  {showPassword ? wifi.password : 'â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢â€¢'}
                </span>

                {/* Show/Hide Toggle Button */}
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword(!showPassword)}
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider hover:opacity-80 cursor-pointer"
                >
                  {showPassword ? 'HIDE' : 'SHOW'}
                </button>

                {/* Copy Button */}
                <button
                  onClick={copyPassword}
                  title="Click to copy password"
                  className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-normal cursor-pointer hover:opacity-80 border-l border-black/10 pl-3"
                >
                  {copied ? '(COPIED!)' : 'COPY'}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
```

import React from 'react';

/**
 * StoryModal component displays the comprehensive roastery and neighborhood history.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Whether modal is visible
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Dismiss callback
 */
export const StoryModal = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  // Guard condition: Do not render when closed
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  return (
    // Fixed backdrop overlay with blur
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Card */}
      <div
        className="bg-[#FFF3E7] w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/10 flex flex-col max-h-[90dvh]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
      >
        {/* Header Imagery */}
        <div className="relative h-48 sm:h-60 bg-gray-900 shrink-0">
          <img
            src="https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuABEC-4YMe9KuI2_3p2rngjkOCN9kRy6aHAhhS1IJnFoZePxPGaWltctHSa4ccKTzcvKwy6cTlSeAQd_Kx-1TnJxPnWdvUkktJEj2NmoKG393ywYLQM15s0P9Sb95eKHnYUhwZ0gzeUrHIywO61wXui5_NL-uLbvQusgfoKsYay7wSln88PMfmSRh5p6KOdCTWJwp4NCfRlIQjNj3FgsvyWsT0MzvDWbtX-CPpoTI7jH3G7SiPg8zBG"
            alt="Beardista Brew Roastery Interior"
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
          />
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-t from-black/80 via-black/30 to-transparent pointer-events-none" />
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="absolute top-4 right-4 bg-black/40 hover:bg-black/70 text-white p-2 rounded-full backdrop-blur-sm transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            aria-label="Close"
          >
            <svg className="w-5 h-5" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
              <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
            </svg>
          </button>
          <div className="absolute bottom-5 left-6 right-6 text-white">
            <span className="text-xs uppercase tracking-widest text-[#E58422] font-bold block mb-1">
              Our Journey &amp; Roastery
            </span>
            <h3 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold leading-tight">
              Behind Beardista Brew
            </h3>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Scrollable Story Text */}
        <div className="p-6 sm:p-8 overflow-y-auto space-y-6 grow text-[#111111]">
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xl font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2">
              Crafted with Precision in Camarin, Caloocan
            </h4>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base leading-relaxed text-[#111111]/80">
              Beardista Brew began with a dream to bring third-wave specialty coffee culture to North Caloocan. We transformed a modest space in Barangay 174 into a sanctuary where coffee enthusiasts, remote workers, and neighborhood regulars share thoughtful conversations over expertly pulled espresso.
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Sourcing and Roasting Details */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-black/10">
              <h5 className="font-bold text-[#19244E] text-sm mb-1">
                Small-Batch Profiling
              </h5>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#111111]/75 leading-relaxed">
                Every batch is profile-roasted in-house to achieve our signature "Dark &amp; Chaotic" flavorâ€”dense body, low acidity, and rich undertones of blueberry and smoke.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-black/10">
              <h5 className="font-bold text-[#19244E] text-sm mb-1">
                Direct Farm Trade
              </h5>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#111111]/75 leading-relaxed">
                We partner with highland cooperatives in Benguet for Filipino Arabica and reputable micro-lots in Brazil, ensuring ethical trade and fresh crop supply.
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-white p-5 rounded-2xl border border-black/10 text-xs sm:text-sm text-[#111111]/80 leading-relaxed">
            <strong className="text-[#19244E] block mb-1">A Space Worth Staying Awhile:</strong>
            We designed our cafe with plenty of natural daylight, accessible charging outlets, dual-band fiber internet, and a pet-friendly veranda so you can relax or work without rush.
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Footer */}
        <div className="p-4 bg-white border-t border-black/10 flex justify-end">
          <button
            onClick={onClose}
            className="px-6 py-2.5 bg-[#19244E] hover:bg-opacity-90 text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full cursor-pointer"
          >
            Back to Overview
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';

/**
 * SurveyModal component renders the 3-step interactive customer feedback flow.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {boolean} props.isOpen - Boolean controlling modal visibility
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Dismiss callback to hide modal
 */
export const SurveyModal = ({ isOpen, onClose }) => {
  // Guard clause: Return null if modal is not open to avoid unnecessary DOM rendering
  if (!isOpen) return null;

  // ============================================================================
  // STATE MANAGEMENT
  // ============================================================================

  // Single formData state object holding all user inputs across the steps
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState({
    name: '',
    ageGroup: '',
    visitFrequency: 'Weekly regular',
    orderPreferences: ['Coffee'],
    orderHighlight: '',
    rating: 'Excellent',
    notes: ''
  });

  // State tracking the active step in the multi-step survey flow (1, 2, or 3)
  const [currentStep, setCurrentStep] = useState(1);

  // Helper function to update specific fields in the single formData state object
  const updateFormField = (field, value) => {
    setFormData((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value
    }));
  };

  // Helper to toggle order preferences pill selection
  const toggleOrderPreference = (category) => {
    setFormData((prev) => {
      const exists = prev.orderPreferences.includes(category);
      if (exists) {
        return {
          ...prev,
          orderPreferences: prev.orderPreferences.filter((c) => c !== category)
        };
      } else {
        return {
          ...prev,
          orderPreferences: [...prev.orderPreferences, category]
        };
      }
    });
  };

  // Navigation handlers
  const handleNext = () => {
    setCurrentStep(2);
  };

  const handleBack = () => {
    setCurrentStep(1);
  };

  // ============================================================================
  // MOCK DATABASE FUNCTION
  // Executed on Submit click in Step 2 to simulate MySQL backend persistence
  // ============================================================================
  const handleSubmit = (e) => {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();

    // Required simulation log for the academic examination panel
    console.log("Simulating MySQL Database POST request:", formData);

    // Transition to Step 3: Success Screen
    setCurrentStep(3);
  };

  // Reset and close handler
  const handleDone = () => {
    // Reset back to Step 1 for future opens
    setCurrentStep(1);
    if (onClose) onClose();
  };

  return (
    // Fixed backdrop overlay with dimming background blur
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={handleDone}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Card */}
      <div
        className="bg-white w-full max-w-2xl rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/10 flex flex-col max-h-[92dvh] animate-scaleUp text-[#111111]"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} // Prevent closing when clicking inside modal
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL HEADER: Title, Subtitle, Close Button & Progress Bar          */}
        {/* (Rendered on Step 1 and Step 2 as shown in the reference images)    */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {currentStep !== 3 && (
          <div className="pt-6 px-6 sm:px-8 bg-white shrink-0">
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between pb-4">
              <div>
                <h2 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                  We Value Your Input
                </h2>
                <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-neutral-500 font-medium mt-1">
                  Help us brew a better experience. (Step {currentStep} of 3)
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Close 'âœ•' Button */}
              <button
                onClick={handleDone}
                className="text-neutral-400 hover:text-neutral-700 p-1.5 rounded-full transition-colors cursor-pointer"
                aria-label="Close survey"
              >
                <svg className="w-6 h-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M6 18L18 6M6 6l12 12" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Stepped Progress Bar: 33% on Step 1, 66% on Step 2 */}
            <div className="w-full bg-neutral-100 h-1 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
              <div
                className="bg-[#f3832b] h-full transition-all duration-300"
                style={{ width: currentStep === 1 ? '33.33%' : '66.66%' }}
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL BODY CONTAINER (Scrollable)                                  */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="overflow-y-auto grow p-6 sm:p-8">
          
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 1: CUSTOMER PROFILE & ORDER PREFERENCES                      */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 1 && (
            <div className="space-y-8 animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* --- SECTION 1: Customer Profile --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 20 20">
                    <path fillRule="evenodd" d="M10 9a3 3 0 100-6 3 3 0 000 6zm-7 9a7 7 0 1114 0H3z" clipRule="evenodd" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Customer Profile</span>
                </div>

                {/* 2-Column Inputs: Customer Name and Age Group */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4 mb-5">
                  {/* Customer Name */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                      Customer Name <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      placeholder="John Doe"
                      value={formData.name}
                      onChange={(e) => updateFormField('name', e.target.value)}
                      className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
                    />
                  </div>

                  {/* Age Group Dropdown */}
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                      Age Group
                    </label>
                    <div className="relative">
                      <select
                        value={formData.ageGroup}
                        onChange={(e) => updateFormField('ageGroup', e.target.value)}
                        className="w-full appearance-none px-4 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-md text-sm text-[#19244E] shadow-xs focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E] cursor-pointer"
                      >
                        <option value="">Select an age group</option>
                        <option value="Under 18">Under 18</option>
                        <option value="18-24">18-24</option>
                        <option value="25-34">25-34</option>
                        <option value="35-44">35-44</option>
                        <option value="45-54">45-54</option>
                        <option value="55+">55+</option>
                      </select>
                      {/* Dropdown Chevron Glyph */}
                      <span className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 flex items-center pr-3 pointer-events-none text-neutral-500">
                        <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2.5}>
                          <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" />
                        </svg>
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Visit Frequency: 2x2 Grid Selection */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2">
                    Visit Frequency
                  </label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    {[
                      'First-time visitor',
                      'Weekly regular',
                      'Monthly regular',
                      'Occasional'
                    ].map((frequency) => {
                      const isSelected = formData.visitFrequency === frequency;
                      return (
                        <div
                          key={frequency}
                          onClick={() => updateFormField('visitFrequency', frequency)}
                          className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border flex items-center cursor-pointer transition-all ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-[#fff6ee] border-[#f3832b] shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-[#fffaf5] border-[#f7e6d5] hover:border-orange-300'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {/* Radio Check Circle */}
                          <div
                            className={`w-4 h-4 rounded-full border mr-3 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0 ${
                              isSelected ? 'border-[#f3832b]' : 'border-neutral-400'
                            }`}
                          >
                            {isSelected && <div className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-[#f3832b]" />}
                          </div>
                          <span className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-semibold text-[#19244E]">
                            {frequency}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* --- SECTION 2: Order & Menu Preferences --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  {/* Crossed Cutlery Glyph */}
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 6.253v13m0-13C10.832 5.477 9.246 5 7.5 5S4.168 5.477 3 6.253v13C4.168 18.477 5.754 18 7.5 18s3.332.477 4.5 1.253m0-13C13.168 5.477 14.754 5 16.5 5c1.747 0 3.332.477 4.5 1.253v13C19.832 18.477 18.247 18 16.5 18c-1.746 0-3.332.477-4.5 1.253" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Order &amp; Menu Preferences</span>
                </div>

                {/* Question: What did you order today? */}
                <div className="mb-5">
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
                    What did you order today?
                  </label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
                    {['Coffee', 'Non-Coffee', 'Cocktails', 'Food'].map((category) => {
                      const isSelected = formData.orderPreferences.includes(category);
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={category}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => toggleOrderPreference(category)}
                          className={`px-5 py-2 rounded-xl text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer ${
                            isSelected
                              ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white shadow-xs'
                              : 'bg-neutral-100 hover:bg-neutral-200 text-[#19244E]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {category}
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Highlight of your order */}
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-1.5">
                    What was the highlight of your order today? <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    placeholder="e.g., The creamy-salty foam on the Hiromi"
                    value={formData.orderHighlight}
                    onChange={(e) => updateFormField('orderHighlight', e.target.value)}
                    className="w-full px-3.5 py-2.5 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 2: EXPERIENCE & ADDITIONAL NOTES                             */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 2 && (
            <div className="space-y-8 animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* --- SECTION 1: Your Experience --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  <span className="text-lg leading-none">â˜…</span>
                  <span>Your Experience</span>
                </div>

                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-3">
                  How would you rate your overall experience at Beardista Brew today?
                </label>

                {/* 5-Point Emoticon Scale Cards */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-5 gap-2 sm:gap-3">
                  {[
                    { label: 'Very Poor', icon: 'ðŸ˜µ' },
                    { label: 'Poor', icon: 'ðŸ™' },
                    { label: 'Average', icon: 'ðŸ˜' },
                    { label: 'Good', icon: 'ðŸ™‚' },
                    { label: 'Excellent', icon: 'ðŸ˜„' }
                  ].map((tier) => {
                    const isSelected = formData.rating === tier.label;
                    return (
                      <div
                        key={tier.label}
                        onClick={() => updateFormField('rating', tier.label)}
                        className={`flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-2.5 sm:p-4 rounded-xl border transition-all cursor-pointer text-center ${
                          isSelected
                            ? 'bg-[#19244E] text-white border-[#19244E] shadow-md scale-102'
                            : 'bg-[#fffaf5] border-[#f7e6d5] hover:border-orange-300 text-[#19244E]'
                        }`}
                      >
                        {/* Emoticon Face */}
                        <span className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl mb-1.5">{tier.icon}</span>
                        {/* Tier Label */}
                        <span
                          className={`text-[10px] sm:text-xs font-bold leading-tight ${
                            isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#19244E]'
                          }`}
                        >
                          {tier.label}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                    );
                  })}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* --- SECTION 2: Additional Notes --- */}
              <div>
                {/* Section Header */}
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] pb-3 border-b border-black/5 mb-5">
                  {/* Notes / Pen Glyph */}
                  <svg className="w-5 h-5 text-[#19244E]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M11 5H6a2 2 0 00-2 2v11a2 2 0 002 2h11a2 2 0 002-2v-5m-1.414-9.414a2 2 0 112.828 2.828L11.828 15H9v-2.828l8.586-8.586z" />
                  </svg>
                  <span>Additional Notes</span>
                </div>

                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E] mb-2">
                  Any other thoughts, suggestions, or feedback? <span className="text-neutral-400 font-normal">(Optional)</span>
                </label>

                <textarea
                  rows={4}
                  placeholder="Tell us more! We'd love to hear about your favorite drink, our staff, or anything we can improve..."
                  value={formData.notes}
                  onChange={(e) => updateFormField('notes', e.target.value)}
                  className="w-full px-4 py-3 bg-white border border-neutral-300 rounded-none text-sm text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E] leading-relaxed"
                />
              </div>

            </div>
          )}

          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {/* STEP 3: SUCCESS CONFIRMATION                                      */}
          {/* ================================================================ */}
          {currentStep === 3 && (
            <div className="py-8 sm:py-12 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center animate-fadeIn">
              
              {/* Checkmark Badge matching reference image */}
              <div className="w-20 h-20 rounded-2xl bg-[#fff2e5] p-2.5 flex items-center justify-center mb-6 shadow-xs border border-[#fde4cc]">
                <div className="w-full h-full rounded-xl bg-[#f3832b] flex items-center justify-center text-white shadow-sm">
                  <svg className="w-8 h-8" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={3}>
                    <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M5 13l4 4L19 7" />
                  </svg>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Thank You Title */}
              <h3 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight mb-3">
                Thank You!
              </h3>

              {/* Confirmation Text */}
              <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-neutral-600 max-w-md mx-auto leading-relaxed mb-8">
                Your feedback has been successfully submitted. We appreciate your time and look forward to serving you again soon!
              </p>

              {/* Done Close Button */}
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleDone}
                className="w-48 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-xl shadow-md active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              >
                DONE
              </button>

            </div>
          )}

        </div>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MODAL FOOTER ACTIONS                                               */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {currentStep === 1 && (
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-white border-t border-black/5 flex justify-end shrink-0">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleNext}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-7 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>NEXT</span>
              <span>â†’</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        {currentStep === 2 && (
          <div className="p-4 sm:p-6 bg-white border-t border-black/5 flex items-center justify-between shrink-0">
            {/* Back Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleBack}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E] hover:text-[#f3832b] transition-colors cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>â†</span>
              <span>Back</span>
            </button>

            {/* Submit Button */}
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleSubmit}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-7 py-3 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-lg shadow-sm active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
            >
              <span>SUBMIT</span>
              <span>âœ“</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default SurveyModal;

```
import React from 'react';

/**
 * WhatsBrewing component renders two prominent showcase feature modules.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Object} props.data - Data object containing event and mustTry specifications
 * @param {Function} props.onRegister - Callback when clicking "REGISTER & JOIN"
 * @param {Function} props.onViewTsamporado - Callback when clicking "VIEW DETAILS" on Tsamporado
 */
export const WhatsBrewing = ({ data, onRegister, onViewTsamporado }) => {
  return (
    // Section wrapper with rich Navy canvas and vertical breathing room
    <section className="py-16 md:py-24 px-6 md:px-16 bg-[#19244E] border-t border-black/10">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto text-center">
        
        {/* Section Headline */}
        <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold text-[#FFF3E7] mb-12 md:mb-16 uppercase tracking-widest">
          WHAT'S BREWING
        </h2>

        {/* 2-Column Responsive Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-8 md:gap-12">
          
          {/* Card 1: Featured Community Event (Latte Art Throwdown) */}
          <div className="relative bg-[#FFF3E7] p-8 md:p-12 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-between items-start text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-white/10 hover:border-[#D97706]/40 transition-all duration-300">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Event Subtitle Badge */}
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#D97706] block">
                {data.event.tag}
              </span>

              {/* Event Title */}
              <h3 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                {data.event.title}
              </h3>

              {/* Event Summary Description */}
              <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-[#19244E]/80 max-w-sm leading-relaxed">
                {data.event.description}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Action Button: Opens the event details modal */}
            <div className="mt-8">
              <button
                onClick={onRegister}
                className="inline-flex items-center px-6 py-3.5 bg-[#D97706] hover:bg-[#b45309] text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm transition-opacity shadow-md group cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>{data.event.buttonLabel}</span>
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                >
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Card 2: Seasonal Menu Feature (Tsamporado) */}
          <div className="relative bg-[#FFF3E7] p-8 md:p-12 rounded-2xl flex flex-col justify-between items-start text-left overflow-hidden shadow-xl border border-white/10 hover:border-[#EA580C]/40 transition-all duration-300">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* Must Try Subtitle Badge */}
              <span className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#EA580C] block">
                {data.mustTry.tag}
              </span>

              {/* Feature Title */}
              <h3 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                {data.mustTry.title}
              </h3>

              {/* Feature Description */}
              <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-[#19244E]/80 max-w-sm leading-relaxed">
                {data.mustTry.description}
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Action Button: Opens the view-only item detail modal */}
            <div className="mt-8">
              <button
                onClick={onViewTsamporado}
                className="inline-flex items-center px-6 py-3.5 bg-[#EA580C] hover:bg-[#c2410c] text-white text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-sm transition-opacity shadow-md group cursor-pointer"
              >
                <span>{data.mustTry.buttonLabel}</span>
                <svg
                  className="w-4 h-4 ml-2 group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform"
                  fill="none"
                  viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                  stroke="currentColor"
                  strokeWidth={2.5}
                >
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M14 5l7 7m0 0l-7 7m7-7H3" />
                </svg>
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

import React from 'react';

/**
 * WhyChooseUs component renders the four core pillars of the cafe.
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Array} props.pillars - Array of brand pillars from menuData
 */
export const WhyChooseUs = ({ pillars }) => {
  // SVG Icon Renderer for clean, crisp vector rendering matching the reference design
  const renderIcon = (type) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'coffee':
        // Minimalist coffee cup with steam vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M18 8h1a4 4 0 010 8h-1M2 8h16v9a4 4 0 01-4 4H6a4 4 0 01-4-4V8zM6 1v3M10 1v3M14 1v3" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'sparkle':
        // 4-point sparkle star vector representing bold creations
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 2l2.4 7.6L22 12l-7.6 2.4L12 22l-2.4-7.6L2 12l7.6-2.4L12 2z" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'shield':
        // Quality guarantee shield with checkmark vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M9 12l2 2 4-4m5.618-4.016A11.955 11.955 0 0112 2.944a11.955 11.955 0 01-8.618 3.04A12.02 12.02 0 003 9c0 5.591 3.824 10.29 9 11.622 5.176-1.332 9-6.03 9-11.622 0-1.042-.133-2.052-.382-3.016z" />
          </svg>
        );
      case 'users':
        // Community group vector
        return (
          <svg className="w-12 h-12 text-[#E58422]" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={1.5}>
            <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M17 20h5v-2a3 3 0 00-5.356-1.857M17 20H7m10 0v-2c0-.656-.126-1.283-.356-1.857M7 20H2v-2a3 3 0 015.356-1.857M7 20v-2c0-.656.126-1.283.356-1.857m0 0a5.002 5.002 0 019.288 0M15 7a3 3 0 11-6 0 3 3 0 016 0zm6 3a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0zM7 10a2 2 0 11-4 0 2 2 0 014 0z" />
          </svg>
        );
      default:
        return null;
    }
  };

  return (
    // Section wrapper with warm cream background and subtle divider
    <section className="py-16 md:py-24 bg-[#FFF3E7] px-6 md:px-16 text-[#111111] border-t border-black/10">
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto">
        
        {/* Centered Headline */}
        <h2 className="text-3xl md:text-5xl font-extrabold mb-16 text-center uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E]">
          WHY CHOOSE BEARDISTA?
        </h2>

        {/* 4-Pillar Grid */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-12">
          {pillars.map((pillar) => (
            <div key={pillar.id} className="flex flex-col items-center text-center">
              
              {/* Icon Container with subtle hover animation */}
              <div className="w-20 h-20 mb-6 flex items-center justify-center transition-transform hover:scale-110">
                {renderIcon(pillar.iconType)}
              </div>

              {/* Pillar Title */}
              <h3 className="text-2xl mb-4 font-bold text-[#111111]">
                {pillar.title}
              </h3>

              {/* Pillar Explanation */}
              <p className="text-sm md:text-base text-[#111111]/80 leading-relaxed max-w-xs">
                {pillar.description}
              </p>

            </div>
          ))}
        </div>

      </div>
    </section>
  );
};

## beardista-brew/src/features/menu/ItemDetailsModal.jsx

```
import React from 'react';

/**
 * ItemDetailsModal component displays the deep specification for a menu item.
 * Standardized to uniform dimensions matching the Stubble visual reference.
 * 
 * @param {Object} props - Component properties
 * @param {Object|null} props.item - Currently selected item, or null if modal is closed
 * @param {Function} props.onClose - Callback to dismiss the modal dialog
 */
export const ItemDetailsModal = ({ item, onClose }) => {
  // Guard clause: Render nothing if no item is selected to minimize DOM overhead
  if (!item) return null;

  // Determine if item is food or drink to adapt the description section header
  const isFood = item.category === 'Pasta' || item.category === 'Food' || item.category === 'Rice' || item.category === 'Salad';
  const aboutHeading = isFood ? 'ABOUT THIS ITEM' : 'ABOUT THIS DRINK';

  // Normalize flavor profile array from item data or fallback gracefully
  let flavorTags = [];
  if (Array.isArray(item.flavorProfile) && item.flavorProfile.length > 0) {
    flavorTags = item.flavorProfile;
  } else if (typeof item.flavorProfile === 'string') {
    flavorTags = item.flavorProfile.split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase());
  } else if (item.details && item.details.tastingNotes) {
    flavorTags = item.details.tastingNotes.split(',').map((s) => s.trim().toUpperCase());
  } else {
    // Default signature profile matching reference image
    flavorTags = ['ROBUST', 'SMOOTH'];
  }

  // Normalize contains / allergen information
  const containsInfo = item.contains || 
    (item.details && item.details.allergens) || 
    (isFood ? 'GLUTEN, DAIRY' : 'COFFEE');

  return (
    // Fixed backdrop overlay with subtle blur
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 sm:p-6 md:p-8 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xs animate-fadeIn"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      {/* Modal Dialog Card: Uniform fixed dimensions matching the Stubble reference */}
      <div
        className="bg-white w-full max-w-215 md:h-140 rounded-3xl overflow-hidden shadow-2xl border border-black/5 flex flex-col md:flex-row max-h-[92dvh] animate-scaleUp"
        onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()} // Prevent accidental dismissal on card clicks
      >
        
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* LEFT PANEL: High-Resolution Product Photograph (Fixed 50% width)   */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-1/2 h-64 sm:h-72 md:h-full relative bg-neutral-900 shrink-0 overflow-hidden">
          <img
            src={item.image}
            alt={item.name}
            className="w-full h-full object-cover"
            loading="eager"
          />
          {/* Subtle gradient vignette on mobile viewports */}
          <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-linear-to-t from-black/25 via-transparent to-transparent pointer-events-none md:hidden" />
        </div>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* RIGHT PANEL: Drink Name, Price, Description, Flavor, and Contains  */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <div className="w-full md:w-1/2 h-full p-6 sm:p-8 md:p-10 flex flex-col justify-start overflow-y-auto bg-white">
          
          {/* Top Row: Orange Close Button positioned at the top right */}
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-3 shrink-0">
            <button
              onClick={onClose}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2 py-1.5 bg-[#f3832b] hover:bg-[#e0721c] text-white text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-md shadow-xs active:scale-95 transition-all cursor-pointer"
              aria-label="Close details"
            >
              <span className="text-sm leading-none">âœ•</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          {/* Product Title: Ultra-bold navy uppercase */}
          <h2 className="text-3xl sm:text-4xl md:text-5xl font-black text-[#19244E] tracking-tight uppercase leading-none mb-2 font-display">
            {item.name}
          </h2>

          {/* Price Tag in Bold Navy */}
          <div className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] mb-5">
            {item.price}
          </div>

          {/* Dashed Horizontal Divider Line matching reference image */}
          <div className="w-full border-b border-dashed border-neutral-300 mb-6 shrink-0" />

          {/* Section 1: ABOUT THIS DRINK / ITEM */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
              {aboutHeading}
            </h4>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base text-[#111111]/85 leading-relaxed font-normal">
              {item.description}
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Section 2: FLAVOR PROFILE (Star-badged peach chips) */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2.5">
              FLAVOR PROFILE
            </h4>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2.5">
              {flavorTags.map((flavor, index) => (
                <span
                  key={index}
                  className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-4 py-1.5 bg-[#fde2cb] text-[#e87823] text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider rounded-full shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <span className="text-[11px] leading-none">â˜…</span>
                  <span>{flavor}</span>
                </span>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Section 3: CONTAINS (Component / Allergen declaration) */}
          <div>
            <h4 className="text-xs font-extrabold uppercase tracking-widest text-[#19244E] mb-2">
              CONTAINS
            </h4>
            <p className="text-sm sm:text-base font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#19244E]">
              {containsInfo}
            </p>
          </div>

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
};

export default ItemDetailsModal;

```

  },
  {
    id: 5,
    name: 'Creamy Pesto',
    category: 'Pasta',

    description: 'Creamy fresh basil pesto pasta with prawns and full of authentic flavor.',
    flavorProfile: ['HERBACEOUS', 'SAVORY'],
    contains: 'GLUTEN, DAIRY, SEAFOOD',
    status: 'AVAILABLE',
    image: 'https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/aida-public/AB6AXuBmmCjcofTtYyjGVaDVubhQ7GBDFZZwkzeyJcRtV-N62E2zrHzt0zF9c7uYKmvGfj3WtUbfzZoKSwi1uPCx2aYo2wDro_jWzmXsiEAyRe05x-MWABcOQ-gbOgLAqOjGGFqRV9gH9TvfAmZgYwehz4znin-x2LpXrmn696K2iFgA4zJ8ZOk7fDyUmfGS6xfh468GNqL5AbYMYoALG3krDAweC3BeBSu9r5OfLEv3-EUHjfgH-cMugNAa'
  }
];

// ==============================================================================
// 2. CATEGORIES LIST WITH ICONS
// ==============================================================================
const categoriesList = [
  { name: 'Signatures', icon: 'â˜…' },
  { name: 'Specialty Coffee', icon: 'â˜•' },
  { name: 'Competition Artisans', icon: 'ðŸ†' },
  { name: 'Milk Creations', icon: 'ðŸ’§' },
  { name: 'Zero-Proof', icon: 'ðŸ¹' },
  { name: 'Matcha', icon: 'ðŸµ' },
  { name: 'Foam Series', icon: 'ðŸ«§' },
  { name: 'Bespokes', icon: 'ðŸ¸' },
  { name: 'Savory Bites', icon: 'ðŸ¥' },
  { name: 'Pasta', icon: 'ðŸ' },
  { name: 'Rice', icon: 'ðŸš' },
  { name: 'Salad', icon: 'ðŸ¥—' },
  { name: 'Extras', icon: 'ï¼‹' }
];

// ==============================================================================
// 3. MAIN COMPONENT: MenuPage
// ==============================================================================
export default function MenuPage({ onNavigate, onSelectItem }) {
  // STATE 1: Tracks the currently active category. Defaults to 'Signatures'.
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState('Signatures');

  // STATE 2: Optional search input filter for quick text lookup
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');

  // STATE 3: Local selected item state (fallback when component is tested standalone)
  const [localSelectedItem, setLocalSelectedItem] = useState(null);

  // HANDLER: Card click router
  const handleItemClick = (item) => {
    if (onSelectItem) {
      onSelectItem(item);
    } else {
      setLocalSelectedItem(item);
    }
  };

  // FILTERING LOGIC:
  const filteredItems = mockCafeData.filter((item) => {
    const matchesCategory = item.category === activeCategory;
    const matchesSearch = item.name.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase()) ||
                          item.description.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
    return matchesCategory && matchesSearch;
  });

  return (
    // Outer page container
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#111111] antialiased">
      <div className="max-w-360 mx-auto flex flex-col md:flex-row">
        
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* LEFT SIDEBAR: Menu Categories Navigation                           */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <aside className="w-full md:w-64 lg:w-72 p-6 md:pr-4 border-r border-black/10 shrink-0">
          {/* Sidebar Section Title */}
          <div className="mb-6 flex justify-between items-start">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] tracking-tight">
                Menu Categories
              </h2>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 font-medium mt-0.5">
                Explore our craft
              </p>
            </div>
            {/* Mobile About Us link */}
            {onNavigate && (
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('story')}
                className="text-xs font-bold text-[#E58422] hover:underline md:hidden cursor-pointer"
              >
                About Us â†’
              </button>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Categories Button List */}
          <nav className="flex flex-row md:flex-col gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto md:overflow-visible pb-2 md:pb-0">
            {categoriesList.map((category) => {
              const isActive = activeCategory === category.name;

              return (
                <button
                  key={category.name}
                  onClick={() => setActiveCategory(category.name)}
                  className={`flex items-center gap-2.5 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-full text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold transition-all whitespace-nowrap cursor-pointer text-left ${
                    isActive
                      ? 'bg-[#E58422] text-white shadow-md'
                      : 'text-[#19244E] hover:bg-black/5'
                  }`}
                >
                  <span className="text-sm shrink-0">{category.icon}</span>
                  <span className="truncate">{category.name}</span>
                </button>
              );
            })}
          </nav>

          {/* Connection Feature: Direct link to About Us from the Menu */}
          {onNavigate && (
            <div className="hidden md:block mt-8 p-4 bg-white/70 rounded-xl border border-black/10">
              <span className="text-[10px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider block mb-1">
                Behind The Brew
              </span>
              <p className="text-xs text-[#19244E] font-semibold mb-1">
                Curious about our roastery?
              </p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-neutral-600 mb-3 leading-relaxed">
                Read how Beardista Brew brings specialty coffee to Caloocan.
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={() => onNavigate('story')}
                className="w-full py-2 px-3 bg-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#19244E]/90 text-white text-xs font-bold rounded-lg transition-colors cursor-pointer flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5"
              >
                <span>About Us</span>
                <span>â†’</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
        </aside>

        {/* ================================================================== */}
        {/* MAIN CONTENT AREA: Search Bar, Category Title, and Product Grid     */}
        {/* ================================================================== */}
        <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-10">
          
          {/* Top Search Bar */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <div className="relative max-w-2xl">
              <span className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 pl-3.5 flex items-center pointer-events-none text-neutral-400">
                <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor">
                  <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M21 21l-6-6m2-5a7 7 0 11-14 0 7 7 0 0114 0z" />
                </svg>
              </span>
              <input
                type="text"
                placeholder="SEARCH THE BREW..."
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                className="w-full pl-10 pr-4 py-2.5 bg-transparent border border-neutral-300 rounded-md text-xs tracking-wider uppercase text-[#19244E] placeholder:text-neutral-400 focus:outline-none focus:border-[#19244E]"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Active Category Header with Navy Underline Bar */}
          <div className="mb-8 pb-3 border-b-2 border-[#19244E] inline-block">
            <h1 className="text-3xl md:text-4xl font-black text-[#19244E] uppercase tracking-wide">
              {activeCategory}
            </h1>
          </div>

          {/* Empty State Guard */}
          {filteredItems.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center bg-white/50 rounded-2xl border border-black/10">
              <p className="text-base font-bold text-[#19244E]">
                No items available in this category yet.
              </p>
              <p className="text-xs text-neutral-500 mt-1">
                Try toggling between 'Signatures' and 'Pasta' to test the filter logic!
              </p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            // Responsive 3-Column Item Cards Grid
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
              {filteredItems.map((item) => (
                <MenuItemCard
                  key={item.id}
                  item={item}
                  onClick={() => handleItemClick(item)}
                />
              ))}
            </div>
          )}

        </main>

      </div>

      {/* Standalone Inspection Dialog fallback */}
      {!onSelectItem && (
        <ItemDetailsModal
          item={localSelectedItem}
          onClose={() => setLocalSelectedItem(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// ==============================================================================
// 4. SUB-COMPONENT: MenuItemCard
// Renders an individual product card: image, status tag, title, price, description.
// Invokes onClick when selected to view deep ItemDetails.
// ==============================================================================
function MenuItemCard({ item, onClick }) {
  const isAvailable = item.status === 'AVAILABLE';

  return (
    <div
      onClick={onClick}
      className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-black/10 overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-lg hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 flex flex-col cursor-pointer group"
      role="button"
      tabIndex={0}
      aria-label={`View details for ${item.name}`}
    >
      {/* Card Image Container with Status Tag Badge */}
      <div className="relative h-56 bg-neutral-100 overflow-hidden">
        <img
          src={item.image}
          alt={item.name}
          className={`w-full h-full object-cover transition-transform duration-500 group-hover:scale-105 ${
            !isAvailable ? 'grayscale opacity-70' : ''
          }`}
          loading="lazy"
        />

        {/* Status Badge Tag */}
        <span
          className={`absolute top-3 right-3 text-[10px] font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded-sm uppercase tracking-wider shadow-sm ${
            isAvailable
              ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300'
              : 'bg-neutral-200 text-neutral-700 border border-neutral-300'
          }`}
        >
          {item.status}
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* Card Text Content */}
      <div className="p-5 flex flex-col grow">
        {/* Top Row: Item Title & Orange Price Pill */}
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2 mb-2">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E] group-hover:text-[#E58422] transition-colors leading-snug">
            {item.name}
          </h3>
          <span className="bg-[#E58422] text-white text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded shrink-0">
            {item.price}
          </span>
        </div>

        {/* Item Description */}
        <p className="text-xs text-neutral-600 leading-relaxed grow line-clamp-2">
          {item.description}
        </p>

        {/* Visual cue to open ItemDetails */}
        <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-black/5 flex items-center justify-between text-[11px] font-bold text-[#E58422] uppercase tracking-wider">
          <span>View Details</span>
          <span className="group-hover:translate-x-1 transition-transform">â†’</span>
        </div>
      </div>

    </div>
  );
}
```

@import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap');
@import "tailwindcss";
/* Force Plus Jakarta Sans everywhere in the admin portal */
.font-\[\'Anybody\'\] {
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif !important;
}

@theme {
  --font-display: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  --font-body: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
   --font-admin: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
  --color-primary: #19244E;
  --color-accent: #E58422;
  --color-cream: #FFF3E7;
}

@layer base {
  body {
    font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
    background-color: #FFF3E7;
    color: #111111;
  }

  h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  }
}

/* Custom typography utilities matching design system */
.font-headline-display {
  font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  line-height: 1.08;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
  font-weight: 800;
}

.font-headline-lg {
  font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 3rem);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  font-weight: 700;
}

.font-headline-md {
  font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 2rem);
  line-height: 1.25;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.font-headline-sm {
  font-family: 'Anybody', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.25rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.font-body-lg {
  font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1.125rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.font-body-md {
  font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.6;
  font-weight: 400;
}

.font-label-md {
  font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  line-height: 1.25;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  font-weight: 600;
}

.font-label-sm {
  font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', sans-serif;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  line-height: 1.2;
  font-weight: 600;
}

/* Layout utilities matching provided HTML */
.px-margin-desktop {
  padding-left: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 4rem);
  padding-right: clamp(1.5rem, 4.5vw, 4rem);
}

.px-margin-mobile {
  padding-left: 1.25rem;
  padding-right: 1.25rem;
}

.py-section-padding {
  padding-top: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
  padding-bottom: clamp(3.5rem, 6vw, 5rem);
}

.max-w-container-max {
  max-width: 1280px;
}

.gap-gutter {
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

@keyframes slideUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(24px) scale(0.97);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes slideDown {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(-20px);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateY(0);
  }
}

@keyframes slideRight {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateX(-100%);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: translateX(0);
  }
}

@keyframes fadeIn {
  from { opacity: 0; }
  to { opacity: 1; }
}

@keyframes scaleUp {
  from {
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.94);
  }
  to {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes shake {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateX(0); }
  20%, 60% { transform: translateX(-6px); }
  40%, 80% { transform: translateX(6px); }
}

.animate-slideUp {
  animation: slideUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-slideDown {
  animation: slideDown 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-slideRight {
  animation: slideRight 0.26s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-fadeIn {
  animation: fadeIn 0.18s ease-out forwards;
}

.animate-scaleUp {
  animation: scaleUp 0.22s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) forwards;
}

.animate-shake {
  animation: shake 0.4s ease-in-out;
}
