## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/AnnouncementFormModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import {
  cancelButtonClass,
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  labelClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
  textareaClass,
} from "../formStyles";
import { todayISO } from "../events/eventUtils";
import AnnouncementPreview from "./AnnouncementPreview";
import { ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES, DESCRIPTION_LIMIT, linkSummary } from "./announcementUtils";

const emptyAnnouncement = {
  type: "new_event",
  custom_label: "",
  title: "",
  description: "",
  image_url: "",
  button_label: "",
  link_type: "none",
  link_target: "",
  starts_at: todayISO(),
  ends_at: "",
};

const URL_PATTERN = /^(https?:\/\/|\/)\S+$/;

// Create / Edit form with a live landing-page preview (beside the form on desktop, under it on phones).
export default function AnnouncementFormModal({ announcement, events, menuItems, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    ...emptyAnnouncement,
    ...announcement,
    link_target: announcement ? String(announcement.link_target ?? "") : "",
  }));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const update = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: "" }));
  };

  const changeLinkType = (value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, link_type: value, link_target: "" }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, link_target: "", button_label: "" }));
  };

  const pickImage = (file) => {
    if (file?.type.startsWith("image/")) update("image_url", URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const label = form.button_label.trim();
    const hasLink = form.link_type !== "none";
    const target = form.link_target.trim();

    const nextErrors = {
      custom_label: form.type === "custom" && !form.custom_label.trim() ? "Give your custom type a label." : "",
      title: form.title.trim() ? "" : "A title is required.",
      description: form.description.trim() ? "" : "A short description is required.",
      button_label: hasLink && !label ? "Add a button label, or choose No button." : "",
      link_target:
        hasLink && !target
          ? "Pick where the button should go."
          : form.link_type === "url" && !URL_PATTERN.test(target)
            ? "Use a full link (https://â€¦) or a page path (/menu)."
            : "",
      ends_at:
        form.starts_at && form.ends_at && form.ends_at < form.starts_at
          ? "End date must be on or after the start date."
          : "",
    };

    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      custom_label: form.type === "custom" ? form.custom_label.trim() : "",
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      button_label: hasLink ? label : "",
      link_target: form.link_type === "event" || form.link_type === "menu_item" ? Number(target) : target,
    });
  };

  const fieldError = (field) =>
    errors[field] && (
      <p id={`announcement-${field}-error`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
        {errors[field]}
      </p>
    );

  const errorProps = (field, options) => ({
    "aria-invalid": Boolean(errors[field]),
    "aria-describedby": errors[field] ? `announcement-${field}-error` : undefined,
    className: fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors[field]), ...options }),
  });

  const remaining = DESCRIPTION_LIMIT - form.description.length;
  const previewLink =
    form.link_type !== "none" && form.link_target
      ? linkSummary(form, events, menuItems)
      : "";

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={announcement ? "Edit announcement" : "New announcement"}
      description="This card appears in the â€œWhat's Brewingâ€ section of the landing page."
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-5xl"
      sheetOnPhone
      dismissible
      footer={
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
          <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="submit" form="announcement-form" className={primaryButtonClass}>
            {announcement ? "Save Changes" : "Add Announcement"}
          </button>
        </div>
      }
    >
      <div className="grid gap-6 lg:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_minmax(0,22rem)]">
        <form id="announcement-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-type" className={labelClass}>Type</label>
            <select
              id="announcement-type"
              value={form.type}
              onChange={(event) => update("type", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              {Object.entries(ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES).map(([value, label]) => (
                <option key={value} value={value}>{label}</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          {form.type === "custom" ? (
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="announcement-custom-label" className={labelClass}>
                Custom label <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                id="announcement-custom-label"
                value={form.custom_label}
                onChange={(event) => update("custom_label", event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Community"
                maxLength={24}
                {...errorProps("custom_label")}
              />
              {fieldError("custom_label")}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="hidden sm:block" />
          )}

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <label htmlFor="announcement-title" className={labelClass}>
              Title <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
            </label>
            <input
              id="announcement-title"
              value={form.title}
              onChange={(event) => update("title", event.target.value)}
              maxLength={60}
              {...errorProps("title")}
            />
            {fieldError("title")}
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <div className="flex items-baseline justify-between gap-3">
              <label htmlFor="announcement-description" className={labelClass}>
                Short description <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <span
                aria-live="polite"
                className={`text-xs font-bold ${
                  remaining <= 0 ? "text-rose-600" : remaining <= 20 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-gray-400"
                }`}
              >
                {form.description.length}/{DESCRIPTION_LIMIT}
              </span>
            </div>
            <textarea
              id="announcement-description"
              rows={3}
              maxLength={DESCRIPTION_LIMIT}
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) => update("description", event.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("description", { height: "", padding: "px-4 py-2.5" })}
            />
            {fieldError("description")}
          </div>

          <div className="sm:col-span-2">
            <p className={labelClass}>Image (optional)</p>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
              <label className="relative flex aspect-[16/9] w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 text-center sm:w-56">
                {form.image_url ? (
                  <img src={form.image_url} alt="Image preview" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <ImagePlus size={22} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Click to upload</span>
                  </>
                )}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={(event) => pickImage(event.target.files[0])}
                  aria-label="Upload announcement image"
                  className="sr-only"
                />
              </label>
              {form.image_url && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => update("image_url", "")}
                  className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
                >
                  Remove image
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-link-type" className={labelClass}>Button link</label>
            <select
              id="announcement-link-type"
              value={form.link_type}
              onChange={(event) => changeLinkType(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            >
              <option value="none">No button</option>
              <option value="event">An event</option>
              <option value="menu_item">A menu item</option>
              <option value="url">Custom URL</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-button-label" className={labelClass}>Button label</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-button-label"
              value={form.button_label}
              onChange={(event) => update("button_label", event.target.value)}
              placeholder={form.link_type === "none" ? "Pick a link first" : "e.g. Learn more"}
              disabled={form.link_type === "none"}
              maxLength={28}
              {...errorProps("button_label")}
            />
            {fieldError("button_label")}
          </div>

          {form.link_type !== "none" && (
            <div className="sm:col-span-2">
              <label htmlFor="announcement-link-target" className={labelClass}>
                {form.link_type === "event" ? "Event" : form.link_type === "menu_item" ? "Menu item" : "URL"}
              </label>
              {form.link_type === "url" ? (
                <input
                  id="announcement-link-target"
                  type="url"
                  value={form.link_target}
                  onChange={(event) => update("link_target", event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="https://â€¦ or /menu"
                  {...errorProps("link_target")}
                />
              ) : (
                <select
                  id="announcement-link-target"
                  value={form.link_target}
                  onChange={(event) => update("link_target", event.target.value)}
                  {...errorProps("link_target")}
                >
                  <option value="">Chooseâ€¦</option>
                  {(form.link_type === "event" ? events : menuItems).map((entry) => (
                    <option key={entry.id} value={entry.id}>
                      {entry.title ?? entry.name}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              )}
              {fieldError("link_target")}
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-start" className={labelClass}>Start date</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-start"
              type="date"
              value={form.starts_at}
              onChange={(event) => update("starts_at", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="announcement-end" className={labelClass}>End date (optional)</label>
            <input
              id="announcement-end"
              type="date"
              value={form.ends_at}
              min={form.starts_at || undefined}
              onChange={(event) => update("ends_at", event.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("ends_at")}
            />
            {fieldError("ends_at")}
          </div>
        </form>

        <div className="lg:sticky lg:top-0 lg:self-start">
          <p className={labelClass}>Live preview</p>
          <AnnouncementPreview values={form} linkText={previewLink} />
        </div>
      </div>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/AnnouncementPreview.jsx

import { ArrowRight, Link2 } from "lucide-react";
import { typeLabel } from "./announcementUtils";

// The card as it looks in the "What's Brewing" section of the customer landing page:
// navy background, cream card, small orange type label, title, text, orange button with an arrow.
export default function AnnouncementPreview({ values, linkText }) {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-2xl bg-[#19244E] p-4 sm:p-6">
      <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-white/50">
        What's Brewing
      </p>

      <article className="mt-3 overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#FFF3E7] shadow-lg">
        {values.image_url && (
          <img src={values.image_url} alt="" className="aspect-[16/9] w-full object-cover" />
        )}
        <div className="p-5">
          <p className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-[#E58422]">
            {typeLabel(values)}
          </p>
          <h3 className="mt-1 break-words text-lg font-bold leading-snug text-[#19244E]">
            {values.title.trim() || "Your title goes here"}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-2 break-words text-sm leading-6 text-[#19244E]/75">
            {values.description.trim() || "A short description customers will read on the landing page."}
          </p>
          {values.button_label.trim() && (
            <span className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-full bg-[#E58422] px-4 py-2 text-sm font-bold text-white">
              {values.button_label.trim()}
              <ArrowRight size={16} />
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
      </article>

      {linkText && (
        <p className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-1.5 break-all text-[11px] text-white/60">
          <Link2 size={12} className="shrink-0" />
          Button opens {linkText}
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/AnnouncementsTab.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowUp, GripVertical, Megaphone, Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import DataCard from "../DataCard";
import Pagination from "../Pagination";
import EmptyState from "../EmptyState";
import ModalWrapper, { ToggleSwitch } from "../ModalWrapper";
import { cancelButtonClass } from "../formStyles";
import { usePagination } from "../usePageSize";
import { formatDate, nextId } from "../events/eventUtils";
import AnnouncementFormModal from "./AnnouncementFormModal";
import {
  LIVE_SLOTS,
  dateRange,
  linkSummary,
  liveIds,
  scheduleState,
  sortAnnouncements,
  typeLabel,
} from "./announcementUtils";

const iconButtonClass =
  "flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 hover:text-[#19244E] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-30";

function StatusChip({ announcement, live }) {
  const state = scheduleState(announcement);
  let chip = { label: "Up next", className: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" };

  if (live) chip = { label: "Live on landing page", className: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" };
  else if (!announcement.is_visible) chip = { label: "Hidden", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-500" };
  else if (state === "scheduled") {
    chip = { label: `Starts ${formatDate(announcement.starts_at, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}`, className: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700" };
  } else if (state === "ended") chip = { label: "Ended", className: "bg-gray-100 text-gray-500" };

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${chip.className}`}>
      {live && <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-emerald-500" />}
      {chip.label}
    </span>
  );
}

// Controls the "What's Brewing" cards on the customer landing page.
export default function AnnouncementsTab({ announcements, setAnnouncements, events, menuItems, notify }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(null);
  const [deleteTarget, setDeleteTarget] = useState(null);
  const [armedId, setArmedId] = useState(null);
  const [dragId, setDragId] = useState(null);
  const [overId, setOverId] = useState(null);

  const sorted = sortAnnouncements(announcements);
  const live = liveIds(announcements);
  const pager = usePagination(sorted);

  // Saves the new order as sort_order 1, 2, 3â€¦
  const moveTo = (fromId, toIndex) => {
    const ordered = [...sorted];
    const fromIndex = ordered.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === fromId);
    if (fromIndex === -1 || toIndex < 0 || toIndex >= ordered.length) return;
    const [moved] = ordered.splice(fromIndex, 1);
    ordered.splice(toIndex, 0, moved);
    const position = new Map(ordered.map((entry, index) => [entry.id, index + 1]));
    setAnnouncements((all) => all.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, sort_order: position.get(entry.id) })));
  };

  const clearDrag = () => {
    setArmedId(null);
    setDragId(null);
    setOverId(null);
  };

  // Native drag and drop from the handle; phones use the arrow buttons.
  const dragPropsFor = (announcement, index) => ({
    draggable: armedId === announcement.id,
    onDragStart: (event) => {
      event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
      event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", String(announcement.id));
      setDragId(announcement.id);
    },
    onDragOver: (event) => {
      if (dragId === null) return;
      event.preventDefault();
      if (overId !== announcement.id) setOverId(announcement.id);
    },
    onDrop: (event) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (dragId !== null && dragId !== announcement.id) moveTo(dragId, index);
      clearDrag();
    },
    onDragEnd: clearDrag,
  });

  const toggleVisible = (announcement) => {
    setAnnouncements((all) =>
      all.map((entry) => (entry.id === announcement.id ? { ...entry, is_visible: !entry.is_visible } : entry))
    );
    notify(`${announcement.title} is now ${announcement.is_visible ? "hidden" : "visible"}.`);
  };

  const save = (values) => {
    if (editing.announcement) {
      setAnnouncements((all) =>
        all.map((entry) => (entry.id === editing.announcement.id ? { ...entry, ...values } : entry))
      );
      notify(`${values.title} was updated.`);
    } else {
      setAnnouncements((all) => [
        ...all,
        {
          ...values,
          id: nextId(all),
          is_visible: true,
          sort_order: Math.max(0, ...all.map((entry) => entry.sort_order)) + 1,
        },
      ]);
      notify(`${values.title} was added. Drag it to the top to put it live.`);
    }
    setEditing(null);
  };

  const remove = () => {
    setAnnouncements((all) => all.filter((entry) => entry.id !== deleteTarget.id));
    notify(`${deleteTarget.title} was deleted.`);
    setDeleteTarget(null);
  };

  return (
    <>
      <DataCard
        title="What's Brewing"
        description={`The first ${LIVE_SLOTS} visible cards (inside their dates) show on the customer landing page.`}
        badge={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setEditing({ announcement: null })}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
          >
            <Plus size={16} />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline">New announcement</span>
            <span className="sm:hidden">New</span>
          </button>
        }
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={sorted.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="Announcement pages" />}
      >
        {sorted.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Megaphone}
            title="Nothing brewing yet."
            message="Share a new drink, an event or a notice, and it shows up on the landing page."
          />
        ) : (
          <ol className="divide-y divide-[#EFEAE4]" onPointerUp={() => setArmedId(null)}>
            {pager.pageItems.map((announcement) => {
              const index = sorted.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === announcement.id);
              const link = linkSummary(announcement, events, menuItems);

              return (
                <li
                  key={announcement.id}
                  {...dragPropsFor(announcement, index)}
                  className={`flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3 transition sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:gap-3 sm:px-6 ${
                    overId === announcement.id && dragId !== announcement.id ? "bg-[#FFF3E7]" : ""
                  } ${announcement.is_visible ? "" : "opacity-70"}`}
                >
                  <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onPointerDown={() => setArmedId(announcement.id)}
                      aria-label={`Drag to reorder ${announcement.title}`}
                      title="Drag to reorder"
                      className="hidden h-14 w-6 shrink-0 cursor-grab items-center justify-center text-gray-300 hover:text-gray-500 active:cursor-grabbing sm:flex"
                    >
                      <GripVertical size={18} />
                    </button>

                    {announcement.image_url ? (
                      <img src={announcement.image_url} alt="" className="h-14 w-14 shrink-0 rounded-xl object-cover" />
                    ) : (
                      <span className="flex h-14 w-14 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]">
                        <Megaphone size={22} />
                      </span>
                    )}

                    <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                        <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#E58422]">
                          {typeLabel(announcement)}
                        </span>
                        <StatusChip announcement={announcement} live={live.includes(announcement.id)} />
                      </div>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{announcement.title}</p>
                      <p className="truncate text-xs text-gray-500">{announcement.description}</p>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 truncate text-[11px] text-gray-400">
                        {dateRange(announcement)}
                        {link && ` Â· ${link}`}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex shrink-0 items-center justify-between sm:justify-end">
                    <div className="flex">
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => moveTo(announcement.id, index - 1)} disabled={index === 0} aria-label="Move up" title="Move up" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <ArrowUp size={17} />
                      </button>
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => moveTo(announcement.id, index + 1)} disabled={index === sorted.length - 1} aria-label="Move down" title="Move down" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <ArrowDown size={17} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center">
                      <ToggleSwitch
                        checked={announcement.is_visible}
                        label={`${announcement.is_visible ? "Hide" : "Show"} ${announcement.title} on the landing page`}
                        onToggle={() => toggleVisible(announcement)}
                      />
                      <button type="button" onClick={() => setEditing({ announcement })} aria-label={`Edit ${announcement.title}`} title="Edit" className={iconButtonClass}>
                        <Pencil size={16} />
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(announcement)}
                        aria-label={`Delete ${announcement.title}`}
                        title="Delete"
                        className={`${iconButtonClass} hover:bg-rose-50 hover:text-rose-600`}
                      >
                        <Trash2 size={16} />
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </li>
              );
            })}
          </ol>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {editing && (
        <AnnouncementFormModal
          announcement={editing.announcement}
          events={events}
          menuItems={menuItems}
          onCancel={() => setEditing(null)}
          onSave={save}
        />
      )}

      {deleteTarget && (
        <ModalWrapper
          title="Delete this announcement?"
          description={`${deleteTarget.title} will be removed from the landing page list.`}
          onClose={() => setDeleteTarget(null)}
          sheetOnPhone
          dismissible
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end">
            <button type="button" onClick={() => setDeleteTarget(null)} className={cancelButtonClass}>
              Keep
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={remove}
              className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-extrabold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-rose-700"
            >
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>
        </ModalWrapper>
      )}
    </>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/announcements/announcementUtils.js

```
import { formatDate, todayISO } from "../events/eventUtils";

export const ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES = {
  new_event: "New Event",
  new_drink: "New Drink",
  must_try: "Must Try",
  notice: "Notice",
  custom: "Custom",
};

export const DESCRIPTION_LIMIT = 140;

// How many "What's Brewing" cards the landing page shows.
export const LIVE_SLOTS = 2;

export const typeLabel = (announcement) =>
  announcement.type === "custom"
    ? announcement.custom_label.trim() || "Custom"
    : ANNOUNCEMENT_TYPES[announcement.type];

// "scheduled" (starts later) | "ended" | "running"
export const scheduleState = (announcement) => {
  const today = todayISO();
  if (announcement.starts_at && announcement.starts_at > today) return "scheduled";
  if (announcement.ends_at && announcement.ends_at < today) return "ended";
  return "running";
};

export const sortAnnouncements = (list) => [...list].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);

// Ids of the cards the landing page shows right now: the first visible ones inside their dates.
export const liveIds = (list) =>
  sortAnnouncements(list)
    .filter((announcement) => announcement.is_visible && scheduleState(announcement) === "running")
    .slice(0, LIVE_SLOTS)
    .map((announcement) => announcement.id);

export const dateRange = ({ starts_at: start, ends_at: end }) => {
  if (start && end) return `${formatDate(start)} â€“ ${formatDate(end)}`;
  if (start) return `From ${formatDate(start)}`;
  if (end) return `Until ${formatDate(end)}`;
  return "No end date";
};

export const linkSummary = (announcement, events, menuItems) => {
  const target = announcement.link_target;
  if (announcement.link_type === "event") {
    return `Event: ${events.find((event) => event.id === Number(target))?.title ?? "event not found"}`;
  }
  if (announcement.link_type === "menu_item") {
    return `Menu: ${menuItems.find((item) => item.id === Number(target))?.name ?? "item not found"}`;
  }
  if (announcement.link_type === "url") return target;
  return "";
};

```
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { DotLottieReact } from "@lottiefiles/dotlottie-react";
import BrewingLoader, { SteamingCup } from "./BrewingLoader";

// The .lottie file is looked up in AdminRebuild/assets first, then src/testing/assets (where it is now).
// import.meta.glob returns nothing for a missing file, so the app never crashes; the cup is shown instead.
const animationFiles = import.meta.glob(
  ["../assets/barista-animation.lottie", "../../assets/barista-animation.lottie"],
  { eager: true, query: "?url", import: "default" }
);
const ANIMATION_URL = Object.values(animationFiles)[0] ?? null;

// If the player has not loaded after this long (slow or offline), show the cup instead.
const LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 8000;

export default function BaristaAnimation({ className = "" }) {
  const [player, setPlayer] = useState(null);
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(ANIMATION_URL ? "loading" : "failed");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!player) return;

    const onLoad = () => setStatus("ready");
    const onError = () => setStatus("failed");
    player.addEventListener("load", onLoad);
    player.addEventListener("loadError", onError);
    if (player.isLoaded) setStatus("ready");

    return () => {
      player.removeEventListener("load", onLoad);
      player.removeEventListener("loadError", onError);
    };
  }, [player]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== "loading") return;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => setStatus("failed"), LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [status]);

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col items-center ${className}`}>
      <div className="relative flex aspect-square w-full max-w-[22rem] items-center justify-center">
        {status === "failed" ? (
          <SteamingCup size={160} cupColor="#E58422" saucerColor="#FFF3E7" steamColor="rgba(255,255,255,0.75)" />
        ) : (
          <>
            <DotLottieReact
              src={ANIMATION_URL}
              loop
              autoplay
              dotLottieRefCallback={setPlayer}
              className={`h-full w-full transition-opacity duration-500 ${status === "ready" ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"}`}
            />
            {status === "loading" && (
              <BrewingLoader tone="light" className="absolute" />
            )}
          </>
        )}
      </div>
      <p className="font-display mt-4 text-center text-lg font-bold text-white/90 sm:text-xl">
        Crafted with passion. Served with character.
      </p>
    </div>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/BrewingLoader.jsx

```
// Coffee cup with CSS-animated rising steam (the .admin-steam animation lives in admin.css).
export function SteamingCup({ size = 64, cupColor = "#E58422", saucerColor = "#19244E", steamColor = "#C9BFB3" }) {
  return (
    <svg viewBox="0 0 64 64" width={size} height={size} aria-hidden="true">
      <g fill="none" stroke={steamColor} strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round">
        <path className="admin-steam" d="M24 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
        <path className="admin-steam" style={{ animationDelay: "0.6s" }} d="M32 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
        <path className="admin-steam" style={{ animationDelay: "1.2s" }} d="M40 23c-3-4 3-6 0-10" />
      </g>
      <path d="M14 28h36v7c0 9.4-7.6 17-17 17h-2c-9.4 0-17-7.6-17-17z" fill={cupColor} />
      <path d="M50 31h3a6 6 0 0 1 0 12h-4" fill="none" stroke={cupColor} strokeWidth="3.5" />
      <rect x="9" y="54" width="46" height="4" rx="2" fill={saucerColor} />
    </svg>
  );
}

// Small loader for loading states: a steaming cup with "Brewing...".
// tone="light" is for dark backgrounds (navy panels, orange buttons).
export default function BrewingLoader({ label = "Brewing...", size = 40, tone = "dark", className = "" }) {
  const light = tone === "light";

  return (
    <span role="status" className={`inline-flex items-center gap-2 ${className}`}>
      <SteamingCup
        size={size}
        cupColor={light ? "#FFFFFF" : "#E58422"}
        saucerColor={light ? "#FFF3E7" : "#19244E"}
        steamColor={light ? "rgba(255,255,255,0.7)" : "#C9BFB3"}
      />
      <span className={`text-sm font-bold ${light ? "text-white" : "text-[#19244E]"}`}>{label}</span>
    </span>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/CategoryModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ChevronDown, Coffee, CupSoda, ImagePlus, Leaf, UtensilsCrossed } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper, { ToggleSwitch } from "./ModalWrapper";
import {
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  textareaClass,
  labelClass,
  cancelButtonClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
} from "./formStyles";
import { categoryGroups, toSlug } from "./categoryUtils";

const highlightColors = [
  { name: "Brand Orange", value: "#E58422" },
  { name: "Navy", value: "#19244E" },
  { name: "Emerald", value: "#059669" },
  { name: "Sky", value: "#0284C7" },
  { name: "Violet", value: "#7C3AED" },
  { name: "Rose", value: "#E11D48" },
];

const categoryBadges = [
  { name: "coffee", label: "Coffee", icon: Coffee },
  { name: "drink", label: "Cold drink", icon: CupSoda },
  { name: "leaf", label: "Tea and matcha", icon: Leaf },
  { name: "food", label: "Food", icon: UtensilsCrossed },
];

export default function CategoryModal({
  category,
  existingNames,
  defaultPriority,
  onCancel,
  onSave,
}) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({
    name: category?.name ?? "",
    priority: String(category?.priority ?? defaultPriority),
    description: category?.description ?? "",
    group: category?.group ?? categoryGroups[0],
    color: category?.color ?? highlightColors[0].value,
    badge: category?.badge ?? "",
    iconImage: category?.iconImage ?? "",
    showOnMenu: category?.showOnMenu ?? true,
  }));
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [showMore, setShowMore] = useState(false);
  const slug = toSlug(form.name);

  const update = (field, value) =>
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));

  // Preview only: the picked file stays in the browser and is never uploaded.
  const chooseIcon = (event) => {
    const file = event.target.files[0];
    if (file) setForm((current) => ({ ...current, iconImage: URL.createObjectURL(file), badge: "" }));
    event.target.value = "";
  };

  const save = (status) => {
    const name = form.name.trim();

    if (!name) return setError("Category Name is required.");
    if (existingNames.some((existing) => existing.toLowerCase() === name.toLowerCase())) {
      return setError(`"${name}" already exists.`);
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      name,
      slug,
      priority: Number(form.priority) || 0,
      description: form.description.trim(),
      status,
    });
  };

  const submit = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    save("active");
  };

  const footer = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => save("draft")}
        className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-orange-200 bg-orange-50 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#B96916] transition hover:bg-orange-100"
      >
        Save as Draft
      </button>
      <button type="submit" form="category-form" className={`col-span-2 ${primaryButtonClass}`}>
        {category ? "Save Changes" : "Create Category"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={category ? "Edit Category" : "Add Category"}
      description="Group menu items so customers can browse them easily."
      footer={footer}
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
    >
      {/* Phones show the essentials first; sm:contents lets the extra fields join the desktop grid. */}
      <form id="category-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="sm:order-2">
          <label htmlFor="category-name" className={labelClass}>
            Category Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="category-name"
            type="text"
            value={form.name}
            onChange={(event) => {
              update("name", event.target.value);
              setError("");
            }}
            autoFocus
            aria-invalid={Boolean(error)}
            aria-describedby={error ? "category-name-error" : undefined}
            className={fieldClass({ error: Boolean(error) })}
          />
          {error && (
            <p id="category-name-error" className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:order-5">
          <label htmlFor="category-group" className={labelClass}>Department / Group</label>
          <select
            id="category-group"
            value={form.group}
            onChange={(event) => update("group", event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          >
            {categoryGroups.map((group) => (
              <option key={group} value={group}>{group}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-gray-100 bg-gray-50 py-1 pl-4 pr-1 sm:order-8 sm:self-end">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">Show on Menu</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-500">
              {form.showOnMenu ? "Visible to customers" : "Hidden from customers"}
            </p>
          </div>
          <ToggleSwitch
            checked={form.showOnMenu}
            label="Show category on menu"
            onToggle={() => update("showOnMenu", !form.showOnMenu)}
          />
        </div>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setShowMore((value) => !value)}
          aria-expanded={showMore}
          aria-controls="category-more"
          className="flex min-h-11 items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-dashed border-gray-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:hidden"
        >
          More details
          <ChevronDown size={18} className={`transition-transform ${showMore ? "rotate-180" : ""}`} />
        </button>

        <div
          id="category-more"
          className={`${showMore ? "grid" : "hidden"} grid-cols-2 gap-4 sm:contents`}
        >
          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-1">
            <p className={labelClass}>Category Icon</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <label className="flex h-16 w-16 shrink-0 cursor-pointer items-center justify-center overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916] transition focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-orange-200 hover:border-[#E58422]">
                {form.iconImage ? (
                  <img src={form.iconImage} alt="Category icon preview" className="h-full w-full object-cover" />
                ) : (
                  <ImagePlus size={22} />
                )}
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept="image/*"
                  onChange={chooseIcon}
                  aria-label="Upload category icon"
                  className="sr-only"
                />
              </label>
              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400">or pick a badge</span>
              <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                {categoryBadges.map(({ name, label, icon: Icon }) => {
                  const selected = form.badge === name;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={name}
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setForm((current) => ({ ...current, badge: name, iconImage: "" }))}
                      aria-pressed={selected}
                      aria-label={label}
                      title={label}
                      className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border transition ${
                        selected
                          ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#E58422]"
                          : "border-gray-200 text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-50"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <Icon size={18} />
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="sm:order-3">
            <label htmlFor="category-slug" className={labelClass}>Slug</label>
            <input
              id="category-slug"
              type="text"
              value={slug}
              readOnly
              placeholder="auto-generated"
              className={`${fieldClass({ background: "bg-gray-100" })} cursor-default`}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="sm:order-4">
            <label htmlFor="category-priority" className={labelClass}>Sort Priority</label>
            <input
              id="category-priority"
              type="number"
              inputMode="numeric"
              min="0"
              value={form.priority}
              onChange={(event) => update("priority", event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-6">
            <label htmlFor="category-description" className={labelClass}>Description</label>
            <textarea
              id="category-description"
              rows={2}
              value={form.description}
              onChange={(event) => update("description", event.target.value)}
              className={textareaClass}
            />
          </div>

          <div className="col-span-2 sm:order-7 sm:col-span-1">
            <p className={labelClass}>Highlight Color</p>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap">
              {highlightColors.map(({ name, value }) => (
                <button
                  key={value}
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => update("color", value)}
                  aria-pressed={form.color === value}
                  aria-label={name}
                  title={name}
                  className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full"
                >
                  <span
                    style={{ backgroundColor: value }}
                    className={`h-7 w-7 rounded-full ring-offset-2 transition ${
                      form.color === value ? "ring-2 ring-[#19244E]" : ""
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}

// White card used on every admin page: same radius, border and padding everywhere.
// `clip` is turned off for cards that hold dropdowns which must spill outside.
export default function DataCard({
  title,
  description,
  badge,
  footer,
  children,
  className = "",
  bodyClassName = "p-4 sm:p-6",
  clip = true,
}) {
  return (
    <section
      className={`rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white shadow-sm ${clip ? "overflow-hidden" : ""} ${className}`}
    >
      {(title || badge) && (
        <header className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 border-b border-[#EFEAE4] px-4 py-3 sm:px-6 sm:py-4">
          <div className="min-w-0">
            {title && (
              <h2 className="truncate text-base font-bold text-[#19244E] sm:text-lg">
                {title}
              </h2>
            )}
            {description && (
              <p className="mt-0.5 hidden text-sm text-gray-500 sm:block">
                {description}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          {badge && <div className="shrink-0">{badge}</div>}
        </header>
      )}

      <div className={bodyClassName}>{children}</div>

      {footer && (
        <footer className="border-t border-[#EFEAE4] px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
          {footer}
        </footer>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/AnswerField.jsx

```
import { inputClass, textareaClass } from "../formStyles";

// One registration-form question, drawn the way customers see it.
// Used by the form preview and by the participant panel (to edit answers).
export default function AnswerField({ id, question, value, onChange }) {
  const { label, type, required, help_text: helpText, options = [] } = question;
  const helpId = helpText ? `${id}-help` : undefined;
  const listValue = Array.isArray(value) ? value : value ? [value] : [];

  const labelText = (
    <>
      {label || "Untitled question"}
      {required && <span className="text-rose-500"> *</span>}
    </>
  );

  const toggleCheckbox = (option) =>
    onChange(
      listValue.includes(option)
        ? listValue.filter((entry) => entry !== option)
        : [...listValue, option]
    );

  if (type === "multiple_choice" || type === "checkboxes") {
    return (
      <fieldset aria-describedby={helpId}>
        <legend className="text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{labelText}</legend>
        {helpText && <p id={helpId} className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">{helpText}</p>}
        <div className="mt-2 space-y-1">
          {options.map((option) => (
            <label key={option} className="flex min-h-11 cursor-pointer items-center gap-3 rounded-xl px-2 text-sm text-gray-700 hover:bg-[#F8F6F3]">
              <input
                type={type === "checkboxes" ? "checkbox" : "radio"}
                name={id}
                checked={listValue.includes(option)}
                onChange={() =>
                  type === "checkboxes" ? toggleCheckbox(option) : onChange(option)
                }
                className="h-4 w-4 accent-[#E58422]"
              />
              {option}
            </label>
          ))}
        </div>
      </fieldset>
    );
  }

  const shared = {
    id,
    value: Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value ?? "",
    onChange: (event) => onChange(event.target.value),
    required,
    "aria-describedby": helpId,
  };

  let control;
  if (type === "paragraph") {
    control = <textarea rows={3} {...shared} className={textareaClass} />;
  } else if (type === "dropdown") {
    control = (
      <select {...shared} className={inputClass}>
        <option value="">Chooseâ€¦</option>
        {options.map((option) => (
          <option key={option} value={option}>{option}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    );
  } else {
    const inputType = { date: "date", email: "email", phone: "tel" }[type] ?? "text";
    control = <input type={inputType} {...shared} className={inputClass} />;
  }

  return (
    <div>
      <label htmlFor={id} className="block text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">
        {labelText}
      </label>
      {helpText && <p id={helpId} className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-gray-500">{helpText}</p>}
      <div className="mt-2">{control}</div>
    </div>
  );
}

```

import { BadgeCheck, MailWarning } from "lucide-react";
import { REGISTRATION_STATUS } from "./eventUtils";

// White pill with a coloured dot, readable on top of cover photos.
// `className` sets the display (e.g. "hidden sm:inline-flex"), so it never clashes with a built-in one.
// `flat` swaps the shadow for a border when the pill sits on a white card.
export function EventPill({ pill, className = "inline-flex", flat = false }) {
  return (
    <span
      className={`shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full bg-white/95 px-2.5 py-1 text-[10px] font-bold ${
        flat ? "border border-[#EAE5DF]" : "shadow-sm"
      } ${pill.text} ${className}`}
    >
      <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${pill.dot}`} />
      {pill.label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function RegistrationStatusBadge({ status }) {
  const { label, className } = REGISTRATION_STATUS[status] ?? REGISTRATION_STATUS.pending;

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex shrink-0 rounded-md px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold ${className}`}>
      {label}
    </span>
  );
}

export function VerifiedBadge({ verified }) {
  return verified ? (
    <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-emerald-700">
      <BadgeCheck size={12} />
      Verified
    </span>
  ) : (
    <span className="inline-flex shrink-0 items-center gap-1 rounded-md bg-gray-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-500">
      <MailWarning size={12} />
      Not verified
    </span>
  );
}

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/EventCard.jsx

```
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Copy, Image as ImageIcon, MoreHorizontal, Pencil, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { EventPill } from "./Badges";
import { formatTime, parseDate } from "./eventUtils";

const menuItemClass =
  "flex min-h-11 w-full items-center gap-3 px-4 text-sm font-bold transition";

// Short event card. On laptops the cover strip shrinks (88px down to 32px)
// so two rows of cards always fit the screen without page scroll.
export default function EventCard({
  event,
  pill,
  taken,
  capacity,
  typeCount,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);
  const menuRef = useRef(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!menuOpen) return;

    const onPointerDown = (pointerEvent) => {
      if (!menuRef.current?.contains(pointerEvent.target)) setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    const onKeyDown = (keyEvent) => {
      if (keyEvent.key === "Escape") setMenuOpen(false);
    };
    document.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
      document.removeEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
    };
  }, [menuOpen]);

  const date = parseDate(event.event_date);
  const percent = capacity ? Math.min(100, (taken / capacity) * 100) : 0;

  const pick = (action) => {
    setMenuOpen(false);
    action(event);
  };

  return (
    <article className="flex min-h-0 flex-col rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white shadow-sm">
      <div className="relative h-16 shrink-0 overflow-hidden rounded-t-2xl bg-[#FFF3E7] sm:h-[88px] lg:h-auto lg:max-h-[88px] lg:min-h-8 lg:flex-1 lg:shrink">
        {event.cover_image_url ? (
          <img src={event.cover_image_url} alt="" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
        ) : (
          <ImageIcon size={22} className="absolute left-1/2 top-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-[#E58422]/60" />
        )}

        <span className="absolute left-2 top-1.5 flex items-baseline gap-1 rounded-lg bg-white/95 px-2 py-0.5 shadow-sm">
          <span className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase text-[#E58422]">
            {date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { month: "short" })}
          </span>
          <span className="font-display text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{date.getDate()}</span>
        </span>

        <EventPill pill={pill} className="absolute right-2 top-1.5 hidden sm:inline-flex" />
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 p-3 lg:flex-1 lg:justify-between">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-1">
          <h3
            title={event.title}
            className="line-clamp-2 min-w-0 flex-1 break-words text-sm font-bold leading-5 text-[#19244E] sm:line-clamp-1"
          >
            {event.title}
          </h3>

          <div ref={menuRef} className="relative -mr-2 -mt-2.5 shrink-0 sm:-mr-1 sm:-mt-1">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setMenuOpen((open) => !open)}
              aria-label={`More actions for ${event.title}`}
              aria-haspopup="menu"
              aria-expanded={menuOpen}
              className={`flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 transition hover:bg-gray-100 sm:h-7 sm:w-7 ${menuOpen ? "bg-gray-100" : ""}`}
            >
              <MoreHorizontal size={18} />
            </button>

            {menuOpen && (
              <div
                role="menu"
                className="absolute right-0 top-full z-20 mt-1 w-40 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white py-1 shadow-lg"
              >
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onEdit)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]`}>
                  <Pencil size={15} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  Edit
                </button>
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onDuplicate)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-[#19244E] hover:bg-[#FFF3E7]`}>
                  <Copy size={15} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  Duplicate
                </button>
                <button type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => pick(onDelete)} className={`${menuItemClass} text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50`}>
                  <Trash2 size={15} />
                  Delete
                </button>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        <EventPill pill={pill} flat className="inline-flex self-start sm:hidden" />

        <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 sm:truncate">
          <span className="block truncate sm:inline">
            {date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", { weekday: "short", month: "short", day: "numeric" })}
            {event.start_time && ` Â· ${formatTime(event.start_time)}`}
          </span>
          <span className="hidden sm:inline"> Â· </span>
          <span className="block truncate sm:inline" title={event.venue}>{event.venue}</span>
        </p>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:items-end sm:gap-3">
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-2 text-[11px]">
              <span className="text-gray-500">
                <strong className="text-[#19244E]">{taken} / {capacity}</strong> registered
              </span>
              <span className="text-[10px] text-gray-400">
                {typeCount} participant {typeCount === 1 ? "type" : "types"}
              </span>
            </div>
            <div className="mt-1 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-gray-100">
              <div className="h-full rounded-full bg-[#E58422]" style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} />
            </div>
          </div>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onView(event)}
            aria-label={`View more about ${event.title}`}
            className="min-h-11 w-full shrink-0 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f] sm:min-h-8 sm:w-auto"
          >
            View More
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

```

## beardista-brew/src/testing/AdminRebuild/components/events/EventFormModal.jsx

```
import { useState } from "react";
import { ImagePlus } from "lucide-react";
import ModalWrapper from "../ModalWrapper";
import {
  fieldClass,
  inputClass,
  textareaClass,
  labelClass,
  cancelButtonClass,
  primaryButtonClass,
} from "../formStyles";

const emptyEvent = {
  title: "",
  description: "",
  event_date: "",
  start_time: "",
  end_time: "",
  venue: "",
  cover_image_url: "",
  registration_opens_at: "",
  registration_closes_at: "",
};

// Used for both Create Event (event = null) and Edit.
export default function EventFormModal({ event, onCancel, onSave }) {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(() => ({ ...emptyEvent, ...event }));
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState({});

  const update = (field, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: "" }));
  };

  const pickCover = (file) => {
    if (file?.type.startsWith("image/")) update("cover_image_url", URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const submit = (submitEvent) => {
    submitEvent.preventDefault();
    const nextErrors = {
      title: form.title.trim() ? "" : "Event title is required.",
      event_date: form.event_date ? "" : "Pick the event date.",
      venue: form.venue.trim() ? "" : "Venue is required.",
      end_time:
        form.start_time && form.end_time && form.end_time <= form.start_time
          ? "End time must be after the start time."
          : "",
      registration_closes_at:
        form.registration_opens_at &&
        form.registration_closes_at &&
        form.registration_closes_at < form.registration_opens_at
          ? "Closing date must be on or after the opening date."
          : "",
    };

    if (Object.values(nextErrors).some(Boolean)) {
      setErrors(nextErrors);
      return;
    }

    onSave({
      ...form,
      title: form.title.trim(),
      description: form.description.trim(),
      venue: form.venue.trim(),
    });
  };

  const fieldError = (field) =>
    errors[field] && (
      <p id={`event-${field}-error`} className="mt-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-rose-600">
        {errors[field]}
      </p>
    );

  const errorProps = (field) => ({
    "aria-invalid": Boolean(errors[field]),
    "aria-describedby": errors[field] ? `event-${field}-error` : undefined,
    className: fieldClass({ error: Boolean(errors[field]) }),
  });

  const footer = (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:gap-3">
      <button type="button" onClick={onCancel} className={cancelButtonClass}>
        Cancel
      </button>
      <button type="submit" form="event-form" className={primaryButtonClass}>
        {event ? "Save Changes" : "Create Event"}
      </button>
    </div>
  );

  return (
    <ModalWrapper
      title={event ? "Edit Event" : "Create Event"}
      description={
        event
          ? "Customers see these details on the events page."
          : "New events start as Draft. Set who can register in the Registration Forms tab."
      }
      footer={footer}
      onClose={onCancel}
      maxWidth="max-w-2xl"
      sheetOnPhone
      dismissible
    >
      <form id="event-form" onSubmit={submit} noValidate className="grid gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-title" className={labelClass}>
            Event Title <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-title"
            type="text"
            value={form.title}
            onChange={(e) => update("title", e.target.value)}
            autoFocus
            {...errorProps("title")}
          />
          {fieldError("title")}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-description" className={labelClass}>Description</label>
          <textarea
            id="event-description"
            rows={3}
            value={form.description}
            onChange={(e) => update("description", e.target.value)}
            className={textareaClass}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-date" className={labelClass}>
            Date <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-date"
            type="date"
            value={form.event_date}
            onChange={(e) => update("event_date", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("event_date")}
          />
          {fieldError("event_date")}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="event-start" className={labelClass}>Starts</label>
            <input
              id="event-start"
              type="time"
              value={form.start_time}
              onChange={(e) => update("start_time", e.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="event-end" className={labelClass}>Ends</label>
            <input
              id="event-end"
              type="time"
              value={form.end_time}
              onChange={(e) => update("end_time", e.target.value)}
              {...errorProps("end_time")}
            />
          </div>
          <div className="col-span-2 -mt-2">{fieldError("end_time")}</div>
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <label htmlFor="event-venue" className={labelClass}>
            Venue <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="event-venue"
            type="text"
            value={form.venue}
            onChange={(e) => update("venue", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("venue")}
          />
          {fieldError("venue")}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-opens" className={labelClass}>Registration opens</label>
          <input
            id="event-opens"
            type="date"
            value={form.registration_opens_at}
            onChange={(e) => update("registration_opens_at", e.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="event-closes" className={labelClass}>Registration closes</label>
          <input
            id="event-closes"
            type="date"
            value={form.registration_closes_at}
            min={form.registration_opens_at || undefined}
            onChange={(e) => update("registration_closes_at", e.target.value)}
            {...errorProps("registration_closes_at")}
          />
          {fieldError("registration_closes_at")}
        </div>

        <div className="sm:col-span-2">
          <p className={labelClass}>Cover image</p>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
            <label className="relative flex aspect-[16/7] w-full cursor-pointer flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 text-center sm:w-64">
              {form.cover_image_url ? (
                <img src={form.cover_image_url} alt="Cover preview" className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full object-cover" />
              ) : (
                <>
                  <ImagePlus size={22} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">Click to upload</span>
                </>
              )}
              <input
                type="file"
                accept="image/*"
                onChange={(e) => pickCover(e.target.files[0])}
                aria-label="Upload cover image"
                className="sr-only"
              />
            </label>
            {form.cover_image_url && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => update("cover_image_url", "")}
                className="min-h-11 self-start rounded-xl border border-gray-200 px-4 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50"
              >
                Remove image
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </form>
    </ModalWrapper>
  );
}

```

import { useState } from "react";
import { CalendarDays, Search } from "lucide-react";
import Pagination from "../Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../usePageSize";
import EmptyState from "../EmptyState";
import EventCard from "./EventCard";
import { eventPhase, eventPill, eventTotals } from "./eventUtils";

const PHASES = [
  { id: "all", label: "All" },
  { id: "upcoming", label: "Upcoming" },
  { id: "active", label: "Active" },
  { id: "past", label: "Past" },
];

// 3 Ã— 2 cards on desktop, 2 Ã— 2 on phones, so every page of the grid is even.
const GRID_PAGE_SIZES = { desktop: 6, phone: 4 };

const controlClass =
  "h-11 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-sm text-gray-700 outline-none transition focus:border-orange-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50 lg:h-10";

// On laptops this tab fills the space it is given (no page scroll); the card grid takes what is left.
export default function EventsTab({
  events,
  participantTypes,
  registrations,
  onView,
  onEdit,
  onDuplicate,
  onDelete,
}) {
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState("all");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [sort, setSort] = useState("date");

  const counts = Object.fromEntries(
    PHASES.map(({ id }) => [
      id,
      id === "all" ? events.length : events.filter((event) => eventPhase(event) === id).length,
    ])
  );

  const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();
  const listed = events
    .filter(
      (event) =>
        (phase === "all" || eventPhase(event) === phase) &&
        (!term ||
          event.title.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
          event.venue.toLowerCase().includes(term))
    )
    .sort((a, b) =>
      sort === "newest" ? b.id - a.id : a.event_date.localeCompare(b.event_date)
    );

  const pager = usePagination(listed, [phase, term, sort], GRID_PAGE_SIZES);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:min-h-0 lg:flex-1">
      <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
        <div
          role="group"
          aria-label="Show events"
          className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-1 rounded-xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-1 lg:inline-grid"
        >
          {PHASES.map((option) => (
            <button
              key={option.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPhase(option.id)}
              aria-pressed={phase === option.id}
              className={`flex min-h-11 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-x-1.5 rounded-lg px-2 text-xs font-bold transition sm:flex-row lg:min-h-8 lg:px-3 ${
                phase === option.id
                  ? "bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                  : "text-gray-500 hover:text-[#19244E]"
              }`}
            >
              {option.label}
              <span
                className={`rounded-md px-1.5 text-[10px] ${
                  phase === option.id ? "bg-white/80" : "bg-gray-100"
                }`}
              >
                {counts[option.id]}
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2">
          <div className="relative min-w-0 flex-1 lg:w-60 lg:flex-none">
            <Search size={16} className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-400" />
            <input
              type="search"
              value={search}
              onChange={(event) => setSearch(event.target.value)}
              placeholder="Search events..."
              aria-label="Search events"
              className={`${controlClass} w-full pl-9 pr-3`}
            />
          </div>
          <select
            value={sort}
            onChange={(event) => setSort(event.target.value)}
            aria-label="Sort events"
            className={`${controlClass} w-36 shrink-0 px-3 sm:w-48`}
          >
            <option value="date">Sort: Event date</option>
            <option value="newest">Sort: Newest</option>
          </select>
        </div>
      </div>

      {listed.length === 0 ? (
        <EmptyState
          icon={CalendarDays}
          className="justify-center rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white lg:flex-1"
          title={events.length === 0 ? "No events yet. Time to plan a throwdown?" : "No events match that."}
          message={
            events.length === 0
              ? "Use Create Event to set up your first one."
              : "Try another filter or search."
          }
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 lg:min-h-0 lg:flex-1 lg:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-rows-2 lg:gap-4">
          {pager.pageItems.map((event) => {
            const { types, taken, capacity } = eventTotals(event, participantTypes, registrations);

            return (
              <EventCard
                key={event.id}
                event={event}
                pill={eventPill(event, participantTypes, registrations)}
                taken={taken}
                capacity={capacity}
                typeCount={types.length}
                onView={onView}
                onEdit={onEdit}
                onDuplicate={onDuplicate}
                onDelete={onDelete}
              />
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      <Pagination {...pager} label="Event pages" className="shrink-0" />
    </div>
  );
}

```
// Labels and small helpers shared by the three Events tabs.

export const REGISTRATION_STATUS = {
  pending: { label: "Pending verification", className: "bg-sky-50 text-sky-700" },
  confirmed: { label: "Confirmed", className: "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700" },
  waitlisted: { label: "Waitlisted", className: "bg-amber-50 text-amber-700" },
  cancelled: { label: "Cancelled", className: "bg-rose-50 text-rose-600" },
};

// Statuses an admin can pick by hand ("pending" only changes when the person verifies their email).
export const ADMIN_STATUSES = ["confirmed", "waitlisted", "cancelled"];

export const PRESET_TYPES = ["Competitor", "Spectator/Guest", "Sponsor", "Volunteer"];

export const QUESTION_TYPES = {
  short_answer: "Short answer",
  paragraph: "Paragraph",
  multiple_choice: "Multiple choice",
  checkboxes: "Checkboxes",
  dropdown: "Dropdown",
  date: "Date",
  email: "Email",
  phone: "Phone",
};

// Question types that need a list of options.
export const CHOICE_TYPES = ["multiple_choice", "checkboxes", "dropdown"];

export const chipClass = (active) =>
  `inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-xs font-bold transition ${
    active
      ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
      : "border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
  }`;

export const nextId = (rows) => Math.max(0, ...rows.map((row) => row.id)) + 1;

const pad = (number) => String(number).padStart(2, "0");

export const todayISO = () => {
  const today = new Date();
  return `${today.getFullYear()}-${pad(today.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(today.getDate())}`;
};

// Local time as "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:00", the same shape as the sample timestamps.
export const nowISO = () => {
  const now = new Date();
  return `${todayISO()}T${pad(now.getHours())}:${pad(now.getMinutes())}:00`;
};

// "YYYY-MM-DD" is read as a local date (not UTC) so it never shifts by a day.
export const parseDate = (value) => {
  const [year, month, day] = value.slice(0, 10).split("-").map(Number);
  return new Date(year, month - 1, day);
};

export const formatDate = (
  value,
  options = { month: "short", day: "numeric", year: "numeric" }
) => (value ? parseDate(value).toLocaleDateString("en-US", options) : "Not set");

// "16:00" â†’ "4:00 PM"
export const formatTime = (value) => {
  if (!value) return "";
  const [hours, minutes] = value.split(":").map(Number);
  return `${hours % 12 || 12}:${pad(minutes)} ${hours < 12 ? "AM" : "PM"}`;
};

// "2026-10-22T09:55:00" â†’ "Oct 22, 2026 Â· 9:55 AM"
export const formatDateTime = (value) =>
  value ? `${formatDate(value)} Â· ${formatTime(value.slice(11, 16))}` : "Never";

export const timeRange = (event) =>
  [event.start_time, event.end_time].filter(Boolean).map(formatTime).join(" â€“ ") ||
  "Time not set";

// "past" | "active" (happening today) | "upcoming"
export const eventPhase = (event) => {
  const today = todayISO();
  if (event.event_date < today) return "past";
  if (event.event_date === today) return "active";
  return "upcoming";
};

export const answerText = (value) =>
  Array.isArray(value) ? value.join(", ") : value ?? "";

export const confirmedCount = (registrations, typeId) =>
  registrations.filter(
    (registration) =>
      registration.participant_type_id === typeId && registration.status === "confirmed"
  ).length;

// Confirmed spots and total capacity across all participant types of one event.
export const eventTotals = (event, participantTypes, registrations) => {
  const types = participantTypes.filter((type) => type.event_id === event.id);
  return {
    types,
    taken: types.reduce((sum, type) => sum + confirmedCount(registrations, type.id), 0),
    capacity: types.reduce((sum, type) => sum + type.capacity, 0),
  };
};

// The pill shown on event cards and in the View More pop-up.
export const eventPill = (event, participantTypes, registrations) => {
  const phase = eventPhase(event);
  const { taken, capacity } = eventTotals(event, participantTypes, registrations);

  if (event.status === "draft") return { label: "Draft", dot: "bg-gray-400", text: "text-gray-600" };
  if (event.status === "cancelled") return { label: "Cancelled", dot: "bg-rose-500", text: "text-rose-700" };
  if (phase === "past" || event.status === "completed") return { label: "Past", dot: "bg-gray-400", text: "text-gray-600" };
  if (phase === "active") return { label: "Happening now", dot: "bg-violet-500 animate-pulse", text: "text-violet-700" };
  if (event.status === "closed") return { label: "Registration closed", dot: "bg-amber-500", text: "text-amber-700" };
  if (event.registration_opens_at && event.registration_opens_at > todayISO()) {
    return {
      label: `Opens ${formatDate(event.registration_opens_at, { month: "short", day: "numeric" })}`,
      dot: "bg-sky-500",
      text: "text-sky-700",
    };
  }
  if (capacity > 0 && taken >= capacity) return { label: "Full", dot: "bg-rose-500", text: "text-rose-700" };
  return { label: "Registration open", dot: "bg-emerald-500", text: "text-emerald-700" };
};

export const sortQuestions = (questions) =>
  [...questions].sort((a, b) => a.sort_order - b.sort_order);

import { useEffect } from "react";

  CalendarDays,

function InfoBox({ icon: Icon, label, children }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-[#F8F6F3] p-3">
      <dt className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-gray-400">

        {label}
      </dt>
      <dd className="mt-1 break-words text-sm font-bold text-[#19244E]">{children}</dd>

}

// "View More" pop-up. Full-screen sheet on phones; Esc or a click outside closes it.
export default function EventViewModal({
  event,
  pill,
  types,
  registrations,
  onClose,
  onEdit,
  onToggleRegistration,

}) {
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKeyDown = (keyEvent) => {
      if (keyEvent.key === "Escape") onClose();
    };
    document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);

  }, [onClose]);

  const finished =

  const registrationOpen = event.status === "open";

  return (
    <div

      }}

    >

          <button
            type="button"

            aria-label="Close"

            <X size={20} />
          </button>
          <div className="absolute inset-x-0 bottom-0 p-4 sm:p-6">

            </h2>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid min-h-0 flex-1 gap-6 overflow-y-auto p-4 sm:p-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,3fr)_minmax(0,2fr)]">
          <div className="space-y-5">
            <dl className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
              <InfoBox icon={CalendarDays} label="Date">

                  return (

                  );

        </div>

        <div className="grid shrink-0 grid-cols-2 gap-2 border-t border-[#EFEAE4] px-4 py-3 sm:flex sm:justify-end sm:px-6">

          <button

          >
            <Users size={15} />
            View participants
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
