ï»¿import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { QRCodeCanvas } from "qrcode.react";
import {
  MapPin,
  Eye,
  EyeOff,
  Save,
  CheckCircle2,
  Download,
  QrCode,
} from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";

const defaults = {
  storeName: "Beardista Brew",
  tagline: "Brewing Good Times, One Cup at a Time",
  address: "Caloocan City, Philippines",
  openingTime: "4:00 PM",
  closingTime: "12:00 AM",
  wifiSSID: "Beardista_Guest",
  wifiPass: "guestpassword123",
};

const inputClass =
  "w-full rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-[#19244E] outline-none transition focus:border-[#E58422] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-100";

const labelClass =
  "mb-1.5 block text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500";

// The PNG is drawn at 640px and shown at 160px, so the download stays sharp when printed.
const QR_DOWNLOAD_SIZE = 640;

// Characters with a special meaning in the Wi-Fi QR format need a backslash in front.
const escapeWifi = (value) => value.replace(/([\\;,:"])/g, "\\$1");

const wifiQrText = (ssid, password) =>
  `WIFI:T:WPA;S:${escapeWifi(ssid)};P:${escapeWifi(password)};;`;

function Field({ id, label, value, onChange, placeholder, type = "text" }) {
  return (
    <div className="min-w-0">
      <label htmlFor={id} className={labelClass}>{label}</label>
      <input
        id={id}
        type={type}
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder={placeholder}
        className={inputClass}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default function Settings() {
  const [form, setForm] = useState(defaults);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(defaults);
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [showWifi, setShowWifi] = useState(false);
  const qrRef = useRef(null);

  const update = (key, value) => {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [key]: value }));
    setNotice("");
  };

  const saveSettings = (event) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    setSaved({ ...form });
    setNotice("Settings saved in this preview session only.");
  };

  const downloadQr = () => {
    const canvas = qrRef.current?.querySelector("canvas");
    if (!canvas) return;

    const link = document.createElement("a");
    const name = form.wifiSSID.trim().replace(/[^\w-]+/g, "_") || "wifi";
    link.download = `${name}-wifi-qr.png`;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    link.click();
  };

  const hasChanges = JSON.stringify(form) !== JSON.stringify(saved);
  const hasNetwork = form.wifiSSID.trim() !== "";
  const qrText = wifiQrText(form.wifiSSID, form.wifiPass);
  // Shown under the fields; the password stays hidden unless the eye toggle is on.
  const qrPreviewText = wifiQrText(
    form.wifiSSID,
    showWifi ? form.wifiPass : "â€¢".repeat(Math.min(form.wifiPass.length, 12))
  );

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <PageHeader
        title="System & Store Settings"
        description="Configure store information and guest Wi-Fi details."
        actions={
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 sm:items-end">
            <button
              type="submit"
              form="settings-form"
              className="inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#E58422] px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#d47414]"
            >
              <Save size={17} /> Save All Settings
            </button>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              {hasChanges ? "You have unsaved changes." : "All changes saved."}
            </p>
          </div>
        }
      />

      {notice && (
        <div role="status" className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-3 text-sm text-green-800">
          <CheckCircle2 size={19} className="shrink-0" />
          <p><strong>Preview saved.</strong> {notice}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      <form id="settings-form" onSubmit={saveSettings} className="space-y-6">
        <DataCard
          title="CafÃ© Brand & Physical Location"
          description="Store identity and operating hours shown to customers."
          bodyClassName="space-y-4 p-4 sm:p-6"
        >
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Field id="store-name" label="Store Name" value={form.storeName} onChange={(v) => update("storeName", v)} />
            <Field id="store-tagline" label="Tagline / Concept" value={form.tagline} onChange={(v) => update("tagline", v)} />
          </div>
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="store-address" className={labelClass}><span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2"><MapPin size={14} /> Branch Street Address</span></label>
            <input id="store-address" value={form.address} onChange={(e) => update("address", e.target.value)} className={inputClass} />
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
            <Field id="store-opening" label="Opening Time" value={form.openingTime} onChange={(v) => update("openingTime", v)} placeholder="4:00 PM" />
            <Field id="store-closing" label="Closing Time" value={form.closingTime} onChange={(v) => update("closingTime", v)} placeholder="12:00 AM" />
          </div>
        </DataCard>

        <DataCard
          title="Guest Wi-Fi"
          description="Customers scan the QR code to join the guest network."
        >
          <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)_auto]">
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <Field id="wifi-ssid" label="Network Name (SSID)" value={form.wifiSSID} onChange={(v) => update("wifiSSID", v)} />
              <div>
                <label htmlFor="wifi-password" className={labelClass}>Wi-Fi Password</label>
                <div className="relative">
                  <input
                    id="wifi-password"
                    type={showWifi ? "text" : "password"}
                    value={form.wifiPass}
                    onChange={(e) => update("wifiPass", e.target.value)}
                    className={`${inputClass} pr-12 font-mono`}
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-label={showWifi ? "Hide Wi-Fi password" : "Show Wi-Fi password"}
                    aria-pressed={showWifi}
                    onClick={() => setShowWifi(!showWifi)}
                    className="absolute right-0.5 top-1/2 flex h-11 w-11 -translate-y-1/2 items-center justify-center rounded-lg text-gray-500 hover:bg-gray-200"
                  >
                    {showWifi ? <EyeOff size={17} /> : <Eye size={17} />}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="min-w-0 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2">
                <p className="text-[10px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-400">QR code text</p>
                <p className="mt-0.5 break-all font-mono text-xs text-[#19244E]">{qrPreviewText}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-2 md:w-44">
              <p className="self-start text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-gray-500 md:self-center">
                Live Preview
              </p>

              {hasNetwork ? (
                <div
                  ref={qrRef}
                  className="rounded-2xl border border-[#EAE5DF] bg-white p-2"
                >
                  <QRCodeCanvas
                    value={qrText}
                    size={QR_DOWNLOAD_SIZE}
                    marginSize={2}
                    level="M"
                    fgColor="#19244E"
                    bgColor="#FFFFFF"
                    title={`Wi-Fi QR code for ${form.wifiSSID}`}
                    style={{ width: 144, height: 144 }}
                  />
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="flex aspect-square w-40 flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-orange-200 bg-[#FFF3E7]/50 p-3 text-center">
                  <QrCode size={32} className="text-[#E58422]" />
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-[#19244E]">QR appears here</p>
                  <p className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">Enter a network name first.</p>
                </div>
              )}

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={downloadQr}
                disabled={!hasNetwork}
                className="inline-flex min-h-11 w-40 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-4 text-xs font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#29386f] disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-40"
              >
                <Download size={15} /> Download PNG
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DataCard>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

```

```
ï»¿import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { CircleCheck, Crown, MailCheck, UserX, Users } from "lucide-react";
import PageHeader from "../components/PageHeader";
import StatCard, { StatGrid } from "../components/StatCard";
import DataCard from "../components/DataCard";
import Pagination from "../components/Pagination";
import { usePagination } from "../components/usePageSize";
import EmptyState from "../components/EmptyState";

const INITIAL_USERS = [
  { id: 1, name: "Jim Carlo Gorospe", email: "founder@beardistabrew.com", role: "Owner", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 16, 2026 Â· 09:42 AM" },
  { id: 2, name: "Ben Cabazeres", email: "admin@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 16, 2026 Â· 08:15 AM" },
  { id: 3, name: "Gab Evora", email: "barista.lead@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Active", lastLogin: "Oct 15, 2026 Â· 05:30 PM" },
  { id: 4, name: "Jahnyne Galindez", email: "dave.tan@beardistabrew.com", role: "Admin", status: "Suspended", lastLogin: "Sep 28, 2026 Â· 02:10 PM" },
];

// New accounts are always Staff and stay Pending until the confirmation code is used.
const emptyForm = {
  firstName: "",
  lastName: "",
  email: "",
  role: "Staff",
  status: "Pending",
  password: "",
};

const ROLE_OPTIONS = [
  { value: "Owner", label: "Owner Admin" },
  { value: "Admin", label: "Store Admin" },
  { value: "Staff", label: "Staff / Employee" },
];

const fieldClass =
  "mt-2 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-3.5 py-3 font-normal outline-none focus:border-orange-300 focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50";

const initials = (name) =>
  name
    .split(" ")
    .filter(Boolean)
    .slice(0, 2)
    .map((part) => part[0])
    .join("")
    .toUpperCase();

function StatusBadge({ status }) {
  const styles = {
    Active: ["bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700", "bg-emerald-500"],
    Pending: ["bg-amber-50 text-amber-700", "bg-amber-500"],
    Suspended: ["bg-rose-50 text-rose-700", "bg-rose-500"],
  };
  const [badge, dot] = styles[status] ?? styles.Suspended;

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${badge}`}>
      <span className={`h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full ${dot}`} />
      {status}
    </span>
  );
}

function RoleBadge({ role }) {
  const styles = {
    Owner: "bg-violet-50 text-violet-700",
    Admin: "bg-blue-50 text-blue-700",
    Staff: "bg-orange-50 text-orange-700",
  };

  return (
    <span className={`inline-flex rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold ${styles[role] ?? styles.Staff}`}>
      {role}
    </span>
  );
}

export default function UserManagement() {
  const [users, setUsers] = useState(INITIAL_USERS);
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [filter, setFilter] = useState("All");
  const [drawerOpen, setDrawerOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState(null);
  const [form, setForm] = useState(emptyForm);
  const [formError, setFormError] = useState("");
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [codeSentTo, setCodeSentTo] = useState(null);
  const [toast, setToast] = useState("");
  const [revokeUser, setRevokeUser] = useState(null);

  const editing = editingId !== null;
  const activeCount = users.filter((user) => user.status === "Active").length;
  const suspendedCount = users.filter((user) => user.status === "Suspended").length;
  const roleCount = (role) => users.filter((user) => user.role === role).length;

  const filteredUsers = useMemo(() => {
    const term = search.trim().toLowerCase();

    return users.filter((user) => {
      const matchesSearch =
        !term ||
        user.name.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        user.email.toLowerCase().includes(term) ||
        user.role.toLowerCase().includes(term);

      const matchesFilter =
        filter === "All" ||
        (filter === "Suspended"
          ? user.status === "Suspended"
          : user.role === filter);

      return matchesSearch && matchesFilter;
    });
  }, [users, search, filter]);

  const pager = usePagination(filteredUsers, [search, filter]);
  const pageUsers = pager.pageItems;

  function notify(message) {
    setToast(message);
    window.setTimeout(() => setToast(""), 2600);
  }

  function changeSearch(value) {
    setSearch(value);
  }

  function changeFilter(value) {
    setFilter(value);
  }

  function openAddDrawer() {
    setEditingId(null);
    setForm(emptyForm);
    setFormError("");
    setShowPassword(false);
    setCodeSentTo(null);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
  }

  function openEditDrawer(user) {
    const parts = user.name.split(" ");
    setEditingId(user.id);
    setForm({
      firstName: parts.shift() || "",
      lastName: parts.join(" "),
      email: user.email,
      role: user.role,
      status: user.status,
      password: "",
    });
    setFormError("");
    setShowPassword(false);
    setCodeSentTo(null);
    setDrawerOpen(true);
  }

  function updateField(field, value) {
    setForm((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: value }));
  }

  function generateDemoPassword() {
    const demoPassword = "Demo-" + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8) + "!26";
    updateField("password", demoPassword);
    setShowPassword(true);
    notify("Demo password generated locally.");
  }

  async function copyDemoPassword() {
    if (!form.password) {
      setFormError("Generate a demo password first.");
      return;
    }

    // This preview intentionally does not access the system clipboard.
    notify("Demo password selected. Copying is disabled in this preview.");
  }

  function saveUser(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setFormError("");

    const firstName = form.firstName.trim();
    const lastName = form.lastName.trim();
    const email = form.email.trim();

    if (!firstName || !lastName || !email) {
      setFormError("Please complete the first name, last name, and email.");
      return;
    }

    if (!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)) {
      setFormError("Please enter a valid email address.");
      return;
    }

    const duplicateEmail = users.some(
      (user) =>
        user.email.toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase() &&
        user.id !== editingId
    );

    if (duplicateEmail) {
      setFormError("This email already exists in the demo directory.");
      return;
    }

    const fullName = `${firstName} ${lastName}`.trim();

    if (editing) {
      setUsers((current) =>
        current.map((user) =>
          user.id === editingId
            ? { ...user, name: fullName, email, role: form.role, status: form.status }
            : user
        )
      );
      notify("Demo user updated locally.");
      setDrawerOpen(false);
      return;
    }

    const newUser = {
      id: Date.now(),
      name: fullName,
      email,
      role: "Staff",
      status: "Pending",
      lastLogin: "Never",
    };
    setUsers((current) => [newUser, ...current]);
    // UI only: no email is sent. The drawer switches to the confirmation step.
    setCodeSentTo(email);
  }

  function confirmRevoke() {
    if (!revokeUser) return;

    setUsers((current) => current.filter((user) => user.id !== revokeUser.id));
    setRevokeUser(null);
    notify("Demo user removed from this preview.");
  }

  const filters = [
    { label: "All Users", value: "All", count: users.length },
    { label: "Owner", value: "Owner", count: roleCount("Owner") },
    { label: "Admin", value: "Admin", count: roleCount("Admin") },
    { label: "Staff", value: "Staff", count: roleCount("Staff") },
    { label: "Suspended", value: "Suspended", count: suspendedCount },
  ];

  const drawerTitle = codeSentTo ? "Staff Added" : editing ? "Edit User" : "Add New Staff";

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 text-slate-800">
      <PageHeader
        title="User Management"
        description="Manage administrative personnel, assign roles, and review account status."
        actions={
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={openAddDrawer}
            className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-5 text-sm font-bold text-white shadow-sm transition hover:bg-[#DD7517] focus:outline-none focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-100"
          >
            <span className="text-lg leading-none">+</span>
            Add New Staff
          </button>
        }
      />

      <StatGrid>
        <StatCard label="Total Users" value={users.length} sub="Listed in this demo directory" icon={Users} />
        <StatCard label="Active Accounts" value={activeCount} sub="Currently marked active" icon={CircleCheck} />
        <StatCard label="Suspended" value={suspendedCount} sub="Currently marked suspended" icon={UserX} />
        <StatCard label="Owner Accounts" value={roleCount("Owner")} sub="Owner role in the demo" icon={Crown} />
      </StatGrid>

      <DataCard
        bodyClassName=""
        footer={filteredUsers.length > 0 && <Pagination {...pager} label="User pages" />}
      >
        <div className="border-b border-[#EFEAE4] p-3 sm:p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between">
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <h2 className="text-base font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                Administrative Directory
              </h2>
              <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm text-slate-500">
                Search, filter, and manage the sample user records.
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="relative w-full lg:max-w-sm">
              <span className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-400">
                âŒ•
              </span>
              <input
                type="search"
                value={search}
                onChange={(event) => changeSearch(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search name, email, or role..."
                aria-label="Search users"
                className="h-11 w-full rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm outline-none transition placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-orange-300 focus:bg-white focus:ring-4 focus:ring-orange-50 sm:h-10"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
            {filters.map((item) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={item.value}
                onClick={() => changeFilter(item.value)}
                aria-pressed={filter === item.value}
                className={`inline-flex min-h-11 shrink-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border px-3.5 text-sm font-semibold transition sm:min-h-9 ${
                  filter === item.value
                    ? "border-[#E58422] bg-[#FFF3E7] text-[#B96916]"
                    : "border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-600 hover:border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-50"
                }`}
              >
                {item.label}
                <span
                  className={`rounded-md px-1.5 py-0.5 text-xs ${
                    filter === item.value
                      ? "bg-white/80 text-[#B96916]"
                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-500"
                  }`}
                >
                  {item.count}
                </span>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {filteredUsers.length === 0 ? (
          <EmptyState
            icon={Users}
            title={users.length === 0 ? "It's quiet behind the counter." : "No one by that name here."}
            message={users.length === 0 ? "Add your first staff member to get started." : "Try another search term or filter."}
            action={
              users.length > 0 && (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => { changeSearch(""); changeFilter("All"); }}
                  className="min-h-11 px-3 text-sm font-bold text-orange-600 hover:text-orange-700"
                >
                  Clear search and filters
                </button>
              )
            }
          />
        ) : (
          <>
            {/* Below xl: stacked cards instead of a wide table. */}
            <ul className="divide-y divide-slate-100 xl:hidden">
              {pageUsers.map((user) => (
                <li key={user.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
                  <div className="hidden h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#A95012] sm:flex">
                    {initials(user.name)}
                  </div>
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                    <p className="truncate font-bold text-[#19244E]">{user.name}</p>
                    <p className="truncate text-xs text-slate-500">{user.email}</p>
                    <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                      <RoleBadge role={user.role} />
                      <StatusBadge status={user.status} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex shrink-0 flex-col gap-1.5 sm:flex-row">
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => openEditDrawer(user)}
                      className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700"
                    >
                      Edit
                    </button>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setRevokeUser(user)}
                      aria-label={`Remove ${user.name} from the demo`}
                      className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50"
                    >
                      Remove
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>

            <div className="hidden overflow-x-auto xl:block">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse text-left">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-50/80 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500">
                    <th className="px-6 py-3">Name</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Email Address</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Role</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Status</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3">Last Login</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-right">Actions</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100">
                  {pageUsers.map((user) => (
                    <tr key={user.id} className="transition hover:bg-slate-50/70">
                      <td className="px-6 py-3">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                          <div className="flex h-10 w-10 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-xl border border-orange-100 bg-orange-50 text-sm font-extrabold text-[#A95012]">
                            {initials(user.name)}
                          </div>
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-bold text-[#19244E]">{user.name}</p>
                            <p className="mt-0.5 text-xs text-slate-400">
                              ID: USR-{String(user.id).slice(-4).padStart(4, "0")}
                            </p>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-600">{user.email}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3"><RoleBadge role={user.role} /></td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3"><StatusBadge status={user.status} /></td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-sm text-slate-500">{user.lastLogin}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3">
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => openEditDrawer(user)}
                            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-700"
                          >
                            Edit
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setRevokeUser(user)}
                            aria-label={`Remove ${user.name} from the demo`}
                            className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-bold text-rose-600 transition hover:border-rose-200 hover:bg-rose-50"
                          >
                            Remove
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </>
        )}
      </DataCard>

      {toast && (
        <div role="status" className="fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-[70] max-w-sm rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-xl">
          {toast}
        </div>
      )}

      {drawerOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex justify-end">
          <button
            type="button"
            aria-label="Close user form"
            onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
            className="absolute inset-0 cursor-default bg-slate-950/40 backdrop-blur-[2px]"
          />

          <aside
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="user-drawer-title"
            className="relative flex h-full w-full max-w-xl flex-col bg-white shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between border-b border-slate-100 px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-widest text-orange-600">
                  User Directory
                </p>
                <h2 id="user-drawer-title" className="mt-1 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-2xl">
                  {drawerTitle}
                </h2>
                {!codeSentTo && (
                  <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-slate-500">
                    {editing
                      ? "Update the fields for this local demo record."
                      : "New accounts are created as Staff / Employee."}
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                aria-label="Close"
                className="-mr-2 flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl text-xl text-slate-400 hover:bg-slate-100 hover:text-slate-700"
              >
                Ã—
              </button>
            </div>

            {codeSentTo ? (
              <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div role="status" className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-6 py-10 text-center sm:px-8">
                  <div className="mx-auto flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600">
                    <MailCheck size={26} />
                  </div>
                  <h3 className="mt-4 break-words text-lg font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
                    Confirmation code sent to {codeSentTo}
                  </h3>
                  <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
                    The new staff member enters this code to confirm their email.
                    Their account shows as <strong className="text-amber-700">Pending</strong> until then.
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => notify(`Code resent to ${codeSentTo}.`)}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    Resend Code
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                    className="min-h-11 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#DD7517]"
                  >
                    Done
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : (
              <form onSubmit={saveUser} className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <div className="flex-1 space-y-5 overflow-y-auto px-5 py-5 sm:px-8">
                  <div>
                    <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Personal Information</h3>
                    <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">Enter the name and email for the directory.</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      First Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                      <input
                        required
                        value={form.firstName}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("firstName", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Jamie"
                        className={fieldClass}
                      />
                    </label>
                    <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                      Last Name <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                      <input
                        required
                        value={form.lastName}
                        onChange={(event) => updateField("lastName", event.target.value)}
                        placeholder="e.g. Santos"
                        className={fieldClass}
                      />
                    </label>
                  </div>

                  <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                    Email Address <span className="text-rose-500">*</span>
                    <input
                      required
                      type="email"
                      value={form.email}
                      onChange={(event) => updateField("email", event.target.value)}
                      placeholder="name@beardistabrew.com"
                      className={fieldClass}
                    />
                  </label>

                  {editing ? (
                    <>
                      <div className="border-t border-slate-100 pt-5">
                        <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Role & Access</h3>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">These selections are visual demo settings only.</p>
                      </div>

                      <label className="block text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">
                        Assigned Role
                        <select
                          value={form.role}
                          onChange={(event) => updateField("role", event.target.value)}
                          className={`${fieldClass} bg-white`}
                        >
                          {ROLE_OPTIONS.map((option) => (
                            <option key={option.value} value={option.value}>{option.label}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </label>

                      <div>
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Account Status</p>
                        {form.status === "Pending" && (
                          <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-amber-700">
                            Waiting for the confirmation code. Pick a status to change it.
                          </p>
                        )}
                        <div className="mt-2 grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                          {["Active", "Suspended"].map((status) => (
                            <button
                              type="button"
                              key={status}
                              onClick={() => updateField("status", status)}
                              aria-pressed={form.status === status}
                              className={`min-h-11 rounded-xl border px-4 text-sm font-bold transition ${
                                form.status === status
                                  ? status === "Active"
                                    ? "border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 ring-2 ring-emerald-100"
                                    : "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 ring-2 ring-rose-100"
                                  : "border-slate-200 text-slate-500 hover:bg-slate-50"
                              }`}
                            >
                              {status === "Active" ? "âœ“ " : "âŠ˜ "}{status}
                            </button>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    <>
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 px-4 py-3">
                        <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-700">Role</p>
                        <RoleBadge role="Staff" />
                      </div>

                      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 p-4">
                        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                          <div>
                            <h3 className="text-sm font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">Temporary Password Demo</h3>
                            <p className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-slate-500">
                              Generates sample text only. It does not create credentials.
                            </p>
                          </div>
                          <span className="rounded-lg bg-amber-100 px-2 py-1 text-[10px] font-extrabold uppercase tracking-wide text-amber-800">
                            Demo
                          </span>
                        </div>

                        <div className="mt-3 flex gap-2">
                          <input
                            type={showPassword ? "text" : "password"}
                            value={form.password}
                            onChange={(event) => updateField("password", event.target.value)}
                            placeholder="Generate sample password"
                            autoComplete="off"
                            aria-label="Temporary password"
                            className="min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-sm outline-none focus:border-orange-300"
                          />
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100"
                          >
                            {showPassword ? "Hide" : "Show"}
                          </button>
                        </div>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={generateDemoPassword}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-lg bg-[#19244E] px-3 text-xs font-bold text-white hover:bg-[#26356B] sm:min-h-9"
                          >
                            Generate Sample
                          </button>
                          <button
                            type="button"
                            onClick={copyDemoPassword}
                            className="min-h-11 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white px-3 text-xs font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 sm:min-h-9"
                          >
                            Copy (Preview)
                          </button>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </>
                  )}

                  {formError && (
                    <p role="alert" className="rounded-xl border border-rose-200 bg-rose-50 px-4 py-3 text-sm font-medium text-rose-700">
                      {formError}
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="flex gap-3 border-t border-slate-100 bg-white px-5 py-4 sm:px-8">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => setDrawerOpen(false)}
                    className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 transition hover:bg-slate-50"
                  >
                    Cancel
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="submit"
                    className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl bg-[#F28A28] px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white transition hover:bg-[#DD7517]"
                  >
                    {editing ? "Save Changes" : "Save Staff"}
                  </button>
                </div>
              </form>
            )}
          </aside>
        </div>
      )}

      {revokeUser && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-[60] flex items-center justify-center bg-slate-950/45 p-4">
          <div
            role="dialog"
            aria-modal="true"
            aria-labelledby="remove-user-title"
            className="w-full max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-6 shadow-2xl"
          >
            <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-rose-50 text-xl text-rose-600">
              !
            </div>
            <h2 id="remove-user-title" className="mt-4 text-xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
              Remove demo user?
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-slate-500">
              <strong className="text-slate-700">{revokeUser.name}</strong> will
              be removed from this preview's temporary list. This does not
              revoke or change any real account.
            </p>
            <div className="mt-6 flex gap-3">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setRevokeUser(null)}
                className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-50"
              >
                Cancel
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={confirmRevoke}
                className="min-h-11 flex-1 rounded-xl bg-rose-600 px-4 text-sm font-bold text-white hover:bg-rose-700"
              >
                Remove from Preview
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

```

import React from "react";
import { createRoot } from "react-dom/client";
import {
  HashRouter,
  Routes,
  Route,
  Navigate,
  Link,
} from "react-router-dom";

import "../../index.css";
import "./admin.css";
import AdminLayout from "./layout/AdminLayout";
import AdminDashboard from "./pages/AdminDashboard";
import MenuManagement from "./pages/MenuManagement";
import Analytics from "./pages/Analytics";
import ContentManagement from "./pages/ContentManagement";
import UserManagement from "./pages/UserManagement";
import AuditLogs from "./pages/AuditLogs";
import Events from "./pages/Events";
import Settings from "./pages/Settings";
import AdminLogin from "./pages/AdminLogin";
import MyAccount from "./pages/MyAccount";

const sections = [
  {
    path: "/admin/menu-management",
    title: "Menu Management",
    description: "Manage and organize the cafÃƒÂ© menu.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/analytics",
    title: "Analytics",
    description: "Review cafÃƒÂ© performance and business insights.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/content-management",
    title: "Content Management",
    description: "Manage the content displayed across the cafÃƒÂ© system.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/user-management",
    title: "User Management",
    description: "View and manage system user information.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/audit-logs",
    title: "Audit Logs",
    description: "Review a record of system activities.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/events",
    title: "Events",
    description: "Organize and review cafÃƒÂ© events.",
  },
  {
    path: "/admin/settings",
    title: "Settings",
    description: "Review administrator settings.",
  },
];

function PlaceholderPage({ title, description }) {
  return (
    <AdminLayout activePage={title}>
      <div className="space-y-6">
        <div>
          <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-[#E58422]">
            ADMIN WORKSPACE
          </p>
          <h1 className="mt-2 text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E] sm:text-3xl">
            {title}
          </h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-gray-500">{description}</p>
        </div>

        <section className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm sm:p-8">
          <div className="mx-auto flex max-w-lg flex-col items-center py-8 text-center">
            <div className="flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-orange-50 text-2xl">
              Ã¢Ëœâ€¢
            </div>
            <h2 className="mt-5 text-lg font-bold text-[#19244E]">
              Page ready for development
            </h2>
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
              Routing is working. The actual {title.toLowerCase()} features
              have not been implemented in this preview yet.
            </p>
            <Link
              to="/admin/dashboard"
              className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition hover:bg-[#27376f]"
            >
              Return to Dashboard
            </Link>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>
    </AdminLayout>
  );
}

function NotFoundPage() {
  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen items-center justify-center bg-[#F8F6F3] px-5">
      <div className="max-w-md rounded-2xl bg-white p-8 text-center shadow-sm">
        <p className="text-sm font-bold text-[#E58422]">404 ERROR</p>
        <h1 className="mt-3 text-2xl font-extrabold text-[#19244E]">
          Page not found
        </h1>
        <p className="mt-3 text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500">
          This URL does not match a page in the admin preview.
        </p>
        <Link
          to="/admin/dashboard"
          className="mt-6 inline-flex rounded-xl bg-[#19244E] px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold text-white hover:bg-[#27376f]"
        >
          Go to Dashboard
        </Link>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

function AdminRebuildApp() {
  return (
    <HashRouter>
      <Routes>
        <Route path="/" element={<Navigate to="/admin/dashboard" replace />} />
        <Route path="/admin" element={<Navigate to="/admin/dashboard" replace />} />
        <Route path="/admin/login" element={<AdminLogin />} />
        <Route
          path="/admin/dashboard"
          element={
            <AdminLayout activePage="Dashboard">
              <AdminDashboard />
            </AdminLayout>
          }
        />
        <Route
          path="/admin/account"
          element={
            <AdminLayout activePage="My Account">
              <MyAccount />
            </AdminLayout>
          }
        />


        {sections.map((section) => (
          <Route
            key={section.path}
            path={section.path}
          element={
  section.path === "/admin/menu-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Menu Management">
      <MenuManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/analytics" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Analytics">
      <Analytics />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/content-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Content Management">
      <ContentManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/user-management" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="User Management">
      <UserManagement />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/audit-logs" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Audit Logs">
      <AuditLogs />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/events" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Events">
      <Events />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : section.path === "/admin/settings" ? (
    <AdminLayout activePage="Settings">
      <Settings />
    </AdminLayout>
  ) : (
    <PlaceholderPage
      title={section.title}
      description={section.description}
    />
  )
            }
          />

        ))}
      </Routes>
    </HashRouter>
  );
}

createRoot(document.getElementById("root")).render(
  <React.StrictMode>
    <AdminRebuildApp />
  </React.StrictMode>
);

## beardista-brew/supabase/functions/event-code/index.ts

```
import { createClient } from "https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2";

const corsHeaders = {
  "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
    "authorization, x-client-info, apikey, content-type",
  "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "POST, OPTIONS",
};

type RegisterRequest = {
  action: "register";
  eventId: number;
  email: string;
  fullName: string;
  phone?: string | null;
};

type VerifyRequest = {
  action: "verify";
  registrationId: string;
  code: string;
};

type RegistrationResult = {
  id: string;
  eventId: number;
  userEmail: string;
  fullName: string;
};

type VerificationResult = RegistrationResult & {
  eventTitle: string;
  status: "confirmed" | "waitlisted";
};

function jsonResponse(body: Record<string, unknown>, status = 200) {
  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
    status,
    headers: { ...corsHeaders, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  });
}

function getRequiredSecret(name: string) {
  const value = Deno.env.get(name);
  if (!value) throw new Error(`Missing required Edge Function secret: ${name}`);
  return value;
}

function createVerificationCode() {
  const range = 0x1_0000_0000;
  const limit = range - (range % 1_000_000);
  const values = new Uint32Array(1);
  do {
    crypto.getRandomValues(values);
  } while (values[0] >= limit);
  return (values[0] % 1_000_000).toString().padStart(6, "0");
}

function escapeHtml(value: string) {
  return value.replace(/[&<>"']/g, (character) => {
    const entities: Record<string, string> = {
      "&": "&amp;",
      "<": "&lt;",
      ">": "&gt;",
      '"': "&quot;",
      "'": "&#39;",
    };
    return entities[character];
  });
}

async function sendBrevoEmail(
  email: string,
  name: string,
  subject: string,
  htmlContent: string,
) {
  const apiKey = getRequiredSecret("BREVO_API_KEY");
  const senderEmail = getRequiredSecret("BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL");
  const senderName = Deno.env.get("BREVO_SENDER_NAME") ?? "Beardista Brew";

  const response = await fetch("https://api.brevo.com/v3/smtp/email", {
    method: "POST",
    headers: {
      accept: "application/json",
      "api-key": apiKey,
      "content-type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      sender: { email: senderEmail, name: senderName },
      to: [{ email, name }],
      subject,
      htmlContent,
    }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    console.error("Brevo email delivery failed", response.status);
    throw new Error("Email delivery failed");
  }
}

function isValidEmail(email: unknown): email is string {
  return (
    typeof email === "string" &&
    email.length <= 254 &&
    /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)
  );
}

async function register(request: RegisterRequest, supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>) {
  if (
    !Number.isSafeInteger(request.eventId) ||
    request.eventId <= 0 ||
    !isValidEmail(request.email) ||
    typeof request.fullName !== "string" ||
    request.fullName.trim().length < 1 ||
    request.fullName.length > 200 ||
    (request.phone != null &&
      (typeof request.phone !== "string" || request.phone.length > 40))
  ) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Valid event, email, name, and phone are required." }, 400);
  }

  const code = createVerificationCode();
  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("create_event_registration", {
    p_event_id: request.eventId,
    p_user_email: request.email.trim(),
    p_full_name: request.fullName.trim(),
    p_phone: request.phone?.trim() || null,
    p_verification_code: code,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === "55000") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: error.message }, 429);
    }
    if (error.code === "23505") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "This email is already registered for the event." }, 409);
    }
    if (error.code === "P0002") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "This event is not open for registration." }, 404);
    }
    console.error("Could not create event registration", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Could not create the event registration." }, 500);
  }

  const registration = data as RegistrationResult;
  try {
    await sendBrevoEmail(
      registration.userEmail,
      registration.fullName,
      "Verify your Beardista Brew event registration",
      `<p>Hello ${escapeHtml(registration.fullName)},</p><p>Your verification code is <strong>${code}</strong>.</p><p>Enter this code to complete your event registration.</p>`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not send event verification email", error);
    return jsonResponse(
      {
        error: "Registration was saved, but the verification email could not be sent. Please retry.",
        registrationId: registration.id,
      },
      502,
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse({
    registrationId: registration.id,
    status: "pending",
    message: "Verification code sent.",
  });
}

async function verify(request: VerifyRequest, supabase: ReturnType<typeof createClient>) {
  if (
    typeof request.registrationId !== "string" ||
    !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-8][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(
      request.registrationId,
    ) ||
    typeof request.code !== "string" ||
    !/^\d{6}$/.test(request.code)
  ) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "A valid registration ID and six-digit code are required." }, 400);
  }

  const { data, error } = await supabase.rpc("verify_event_registration", {
    p_registration_id: request.registrationId,
    p_verification_code: request.code,
  });

  if (error) {
    if (error.code === "P0002") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: "Registration not found." }, 404);
    }
    if (error.code === "22023") {
      return jsonResponse({ error: error.message }, 400);
    }
    console.error("Could not verify event registration", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Could not verify the event registration." }, 500);
  }

  const registration = data as VerificationResult;
  if ("error" in registration) {
    return jsonResponse({ error: registration.error }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const statusMessage =
      registration.status === "confirmed"
        ? "Your registration is confirmed."
        : "The event is at capacity. You have been added to the waitlist.";
    await sendBrevoEmail(
      registration.userEmail,
      registration.fullName,
      `Your ${registration.eventTitle} registration`,
      `<p>Hello ${escapeHtml(registration.fullName)},</p><p>${escapeHtml(statusMessage)}</p>`,
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Could not send event confirmation email", error);
    return jsonResponse(
      { error: "Registration verified, but the confirmation email could not be sent." },
      502,
    );
  }

  return jsonResponse({
    registrationId: registration.id,
    status: registration.status,
    message:
      registration.status === "confirmed"
        ? "Registration confirmed."
        : "Registration verified and added to the waitlist.",
  });
}

Deno.serve(async (request: Request) => {
  if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
    return new Response("ok", { headers: corsHeaders });
  }
  if (request.method !== "POST") {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Method not allowed." }, 405);
  }

  let body: RegisterRequest | VerifyRequest;
  try {
    body = await request.json();
  } catch {
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Request body must be valid JSON." }, 400);
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createClient(
      getRequiredSecret("SUPABASE_URL"),
      getRequiredSecret("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY"),
      { auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false } },
    );

    if (body.action === "register") return await register(body, supabase);
    if (body.action === "verify") return await verify(body, supabase);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Unsupported action." }, 400);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Event verification function failed", error);
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Event registration service is unavailable." }, 500);
  }
});

```

import { useState } from 'react';
import StudentCard from './components/StudentCard';
import Header from './components/Header';
import NavBr from './components/NavBr';
import Footer from './components/Footer';
import LoginModal from './components/LoginModal';
import './index.css';

function App() {
  const [isLoggedIn, setIsLoggedIn] = useState(false);

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex flex-col bg-gray-100">
      <Header />
      <NavBr />

      <main className="flex-1 flex justify-center items-start py-8">
        <StudentCard />
      </main>

      <Footer />
    <LoginModal
    isOpen={!isLoggedIn}
    onLoginSuccess={() => setIsLoggedIn(true)}
    dismissible={false}/>
      
      
    </div>
  );
}

export default App;

## School/Dishhtmlact/americanRes.html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
    <body>
        CLAM CHOWDER<br>
<pre>Ingredients<br>
â€¢	Clams: I live in Utah, where the fresh clams are definitely not plentiful. In fact, Iâ€™ve never even cooked fresh clams. Good thing this recipe is amazing with canned clams! Iâ€™ve tried both baby clams and chopped clams, and while both were good, the chopped clams were the best.<br>
â€¢	Bacon: Not only do you get the bacon pieces throughout the chowder, but your veggies are cooked in the bacon grease, bringing in lots more flavor. <br>
â€¢	Celery, Onions & Garlic: These are all for flavor. Usually my kids complain if there is celery in soup, but no one even complained in this chowder!<br>
â€¢	Flour: The flour is to thicken up the chowder. I have not tested this with a gluten free alternative.<br>
â€¢	Clam Juice: While testing this recipe, I originally was using chicken broth, but it was really missing the clam flavor. So I would say that in a pinch, chicken or vegetable broth would work, but I highly suggest using clam juice.<br>
â€¢	Half and Half: Half and half definitely is the best, in my opinion. See below for substitutions if you donâ€™t have half and half. <br>
â€¢	Potatoes: I like using baby red potatoes. You could also use russets, but would need to peel them first. Either way, make sure you dice the potatoes fairly small.<br>
â€¢	Rosemary & Thyme: Technically these can both be left out, but I think the rosemary and thyme are what really make this recipe stand out!<br>
â€¢	Red Wine Vinegar: This is a trick I learned years ago â€“ adding a bit of vinegar to soup at the very end. It helps to balance the flavors and bring some brightness to the soup.<br>
â€¢	Salt and Pepper: Always salt and pepper!<br>
</pre>
<pre>How to Make Clam Chowder<br>
It may look like a lot of steps, but this comes together in well under an hour!<br>
Step 1: Drain the clams, but reserve the juice, because you are going to use it. I like to do this in a sieve because then I will rinse the clams.<br>
Step 2: Slice the bacon and cook it in a Dutch oven or heavy soup pan. I finally just invested in a Le Creuset Dutch Oven, but I had a Lodge Dutch Oven for years before the enamel started to come off. Once the bacon is crisp, remove it with a slotted spoon. Leave about 2 tablespoons of the bacon grease and discard the rest. <br>
Step 3: Melt the butter in with the bacon grease and add the onions and celery. Cook until soft, then add the garlic for 30 seconds.<br>
Step 4: Stir the flour into the mixture. Let it cook for a minute or two. <br>
Step 5: Whisk in the clam juice and the reserved juice from the canned clams. Cook this until it starts to thicken, then add in the half and half.<br>
Step 6: Stir in the potatoes.<br>
Step 7: Then add the thyme and rosemary. Cook until the potatoes are tender. Donâ€™t add the clams yet â€“ they will get tough if you cook them too long.<br>
Step 8: A few minutes before you are ready to serve, stir in the clams and the reserved bacon. <br>
Step 9: Add the vinegar, and cook for a minute or two until it is all warmed through. Donâ€™t forget to taste and season with salt and pepper.<br></pre>

<pre>Clam Chowder Toppings<br>
This soup already has a lot going on, but here are a few ideas of what you can serve on top of your clam chowder:<br>
Oyster crackers â€“ I buy these just for clam chowder! <br>
Fresh herbs â€“ Parsley is easy, but I always like a little extra thyme and rosemary.<br>
More bacon â€“ This is the obvious answer, right? I will always fry up an extra slice or two of bacon so that I have some crispy bacon to serve on top.<br></pre>
<a href="americanC.html" name="c" target="c"> back</a>
    </body>
</html>
```

Ingredients<br>

â€¢	blue cheese or ranch dressing for serving, optional<br>

Step by Step<br>

Step 1. Preheat oven to 425â„‰. Prepare a sheet pan by covering it in tin foil and spraying thoroughly with cooking spray. <br>
 Step 2. Season both sides of chicken wings with salt and pepper to taste, and paprika if desired. Lay them in a single layer skin side down on the lined baking tray. Bake for one hour, flipping halfway through. <br>
Step 3. Melt butter in a Pyrex bowl in the microwave. Stir in hot sauce and vinegar. <br>
Steo 4. After one hour, or when the chicken wings are tender, remove from oven. Transfer <br>them from the sheet pan to the Pyrex bowl and toss thoroughly to coat<br>.
 Step 5. Plate wings and serve with celery sticks and blue cheese (or ranch) dressing on the side. And donâ€™t forget lots of napkins! <br></pre>

       <pre> Mongo Dish
â€¢	1 1/2 cups Mung beans<br>
â€¢	1 tbsp garlic<br>
â€¢	Â½ lb pork thinly sliced<br>
â€¢	2 cups spinach (or alugbati) <br>
â€¢	1 piece tomato chopped<br>
â€¢	1 piece onion chopped<br>
â€¢	8 pieces shrimp optional<br>
â€¢	2 tablespoons fish sauce<br>
â€¢	24 ounces water for boiling<br>
â€¢	1 piece Knorr beef cube for flavoring<br>
â€¢	1/2 cup crushed pork rind chicharon<br>
â€¢	1/4 teaspoon ground black pepper<br>


Step by Step<br>
1.	In a pan, put-in the water and bring to a boil<br>
2.	Put-in the Mung beans and simmer until becomes soft (about 35 to 50 minutes) <br>
3.	On a separate pan, sautÃ© the garlic,onion, and tomato<br>
4.	Add the pork. Cook for 5 mins<br>
5.	Put-in the beef cube and fish sauce. Simmer for 10 mins or until the meat is tender. <br>Note: If necessary, you may add water to help make the meat tender but make sure to add more time to simmer<br>
6.	Add the shrimp. Stir and then cook for 2 minutes. <br>
7.	Pour the cooked Mung beans. Stir and then simmer for 10 minutes<br>
8.	Add the spinach and pork rinds (chicharon) <br>
9.	Sprinkle the ground black pepper<br>
10.	Serve hot. Share and Enjoy! <br></pre>

## School/Dishhtmlact/japaneseres.html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
    <body>
       <pre> TAI MESH<br>
Ingredients<br>
â€¢	leftover cooked whole sea bream â€” I used half of the meat of the sea bream to cook 2 <br>rice cooker cups of rice. <br>
â€¢	Japanese short-grain rice<br>
â€¢	kombu â€” for umami<br>
â€¢	sake â€” to remove the fish odor and make the rice plump<br>
â€¢	soy sauce â€” for color and subtle saltiness<br>
â€¢	kosher salt<br>
â€¢	knob ginger<br>
Step by step<br>
1.	Remove the fish meat from the sea bream bone. Donâ€™t waste any of it! <br>
2.	Make the bone broth with the fishbones and head. <br>
3.	Cook the rice with bone broth, sake, soy sauce, salt, and kombu. <br>
4.	Discard the kombu and fluff the rice. <br>
5.	Gently stir in the leftover fish meat and thin slices of ginger. Serve it with sansho pepper! <br>
Filling<br>
â€¢	1 1/2 cups green cabbage, very finely chopped<br>
â€¢	1 tsp salt, separated<br>
â€¢	1 lb / 500g ground pork (mince) (fattier the better) <br>
â€¢	1 cup garlic chives, finely chopped (Note 1) <br>
â€¢	1 garlic cloves, crushed<br>
â€¢	1 tsp ginger, grated<br>
â€¢	1 tsp sesame oil<br>
â€¢	1 tbsp cornstarch / corn flour
â€¢	2 tsp soy sauce<br>
Gyoza
â€¢	1 tsp cornflour (cornstarch) â€“ for tray<br>
â€¢	40 â€“ 45 round wonton (gyoza) wrappers (Gow Gee wrappers) â€“ 1 1/2 packets (Note 2) <br>
â€¢	3 tbsp vegetable oil (or other cooking oil) <br>
â€¢	Dipping Sauce<br>
Soy sauce<br>
â€¢	Rice wine vinegar<br>
â€¢	Chili oil (Rayu is Japanese chili oil) <br>
Instructions
1.	Combine cabbage and 1/2 tsp salt in a small bowl, then set aside for 20 minutes to allow the cabbage to wilt slightly. <br>
2.	Place remaining Filling ingredients (including remaining 1/2 tsp salt) in a large bowl. Squeeze out any excess water from the cabbage and add to the bowl. <br>
3.	Use your hands to mix the Filling. <br>
4.	Sprinkle a baking tray with 1 tsp of cornstarch / cornflour. <br>
5.	Place 1 gyoza wrapper on your palm (left hand for right-handed people). Dip your finger in water and run it around the edge of half the gyoza wrapper (to seal). <br>
6.	Place 1 slightly heaped tbsp of Filling on the wrapper. Fold wrapper over and use your right hand assisted by your left hand thumb to create 4 pleats. Press to seal and place on the tray. Repeat with remaining wrappers. (See video for demo) <br>
To Cook<br>
1.	Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet (that has a lid) over medium high heat. <br>
2.	Place about 12 gyoza in rows, slightly overlapping each other. Cook until the underside is light golden, then pour 1/3 cup of water around the gyoza and place the lid on. <br>
3.	Cook until the water has completely evaporated (so the golden underside is not wet and soggy) and the wrapper is slightly translucent on top â€“ about 3 to 4 minutes. (See video) <br>
4.	Use an egg flip to transfer onto a plate upside down i.e. golden side up. <br>
5.	Serve with Dipping Sauce. <br></pre>

<a href="japaneseC.html" name="c" target="c"> back</a>
    </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>

    <body>
       <pre>
Jiaozi<br>
â€¢	1 tsp cornflour (cornstarch) â€“ for tray<br>
â€¢	40 â€“ 45 round wonton (gyoza) wrappers (Gow Gee wrappers) â€“ 1 1/2 packets (Note 2) <br>
â€¢	3 tbsp vegetable oil (or other cooking oil) <br>
â€¢	Dipping Sauce<br>
Soy sauce<br>
â€¢	Rice wine vinegar<br>
â€¢	Chili oil (Rayu is Japanese chili oil) <br>
Instructions
1.	Combine cabbage and 1/2 tsp salt in a small bowl, then set aside for 20 minutes to allow the cabbage to wilt slightly. <br>
2.	Place remaining Filling ingredients (including remaining 1/2 tsp salt) in a large bowl. Squeeze out any excess water from the cabbage and add to the bowl. <br>
3.	Use your hands to mix the Filling. <br>
4.	Sprinkle a baking tray with 1 tsp of cornstarch / cornflour. <br>
5.	Place 1 gyoza wrapper on your palm (left hand for right-handed people). Dip your finger in water and run it around the edge of half the gyoza wrapper (to seal). <br>
6.	Place 1 slightly heaped tbsp of Filling on the wrapper. Fold wrapper over and use your right hand assisted by your left hand thumb to create 4 pleats. Press to seal and place on the tray. Repeat with remaining wrappers. (See video for demo) <br>
To Cook<br>
1.	Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet (that has a lid) over medium high heat. <br>
2.	Place about 12 gyoza in rows, slightly overlapping each other. Cook until the underside is light golden, then pour 1/3 cup of water around the gyoza and place the lid on. <br>
3.	Cook until the water has completely evaporated (so the golden underside is not wet and soggy) and the wrapper is slightly translucent on top â€“ about 3 to 4 minutes. (See video) <br>
4.	Use an egg flip to transfer onto a plate upside down i.e. golden side up. <br>
5.	Serve with Dipping Sauce. <br></pre>

    </body>

## School/Dishhtmlact/koreanRes.html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
    <body>
        <pre>>BiBIMBOP<br>
Ingredients<br>
â€¢	4 cups cooked white rice , preferably short grain (Note 1) <br>
â€¢	4 eggs<br>
â€¢	2 tsp sesame seeds<br>
â€¢	Korean Beef & Marinade: <br>
â€¢	250 g/8oz beef tenderloin or thick steak , very finely sliced (subs, Note 2) <br>
â€¢	1/4 green apple , grated using box grater (Note 3) <br>
â€¢	3 garlic cloves , minced<br>
â€¢	1 tbsp soy sauce , light or all purpose (Note 4) <br>
â€¢	1 tbsp honey (or brown sugar) <br>
â€¢	2 tsp sesame oil , toasted (Note 9) <br>
Vegetables: <br>
â€¢	2 carrots , large, cut into 5 x 0.5cm/2 x 1/5" batons<br>
â€¢	2 zucchini , large, cut into 5 x 0.5cm/2 x 1/5" batons<br>
â€¢	1 bunch of spinach , cut into 5cm/2" lengths<br>
â€¢	8 dried shiitake mushrooms , large (Note 5) <br>
â€¢	4 cups bean sprouts<br>
â€¢	2 tsp garlic , minced (3 cloves) <br>
â€¢	8 tsp vegetable oil , separated<br>
â€¢	1/2 tsp salt<br>
o	tsp soy sauce , light or all purpose (Note 4) <br>
â€¢	1/4 tsp fish sauce (sub soy) <br>
â€¢	1/4 tsp white sugar<br>
â€¢	Sesame oil , toasted (Note 9) <br>
Bibimbap Sauce: <br>
â€¢	4 tbsp gochujang paste (Note 6) <br>
â€¢	2 tbsp mirin (Note 7<br>
â€¢	2 tbsp rice vinegar (Note 8) <br>
o	tsp soy sauce (Note 4) <br>
â€¢	3 tsp white sugar<br>
â€¢	1 garlic clove , finely grated<br>
â€¢	2.5 tsp sesame oil , toasted (Note 9) <br>
Instructions<br>
Bibimbap Sauce: <br>
1.	Mix ingredients until sugar is dissolved. <br>
Marinated Beef:
1.	Mix the marinade in a bowl, then add beef. Marinate for 30 minutes to overnight. <br>
2.	Heat 2 tsp oil in a large skillet over high heat. Let excess marinade drip off then add beef. Cook for 3 - 4 minutes until cooked and there's some caramelised bits, then remove from skillet. <br>
3.	Keep warm until required or reheat to warm. <br>
Prepare Vegetables: <br>
1.	Shiitake: Soak mushrooms in a large bowl of boiling water for 30 minutes, or until rehydrated. Drain, squeeze out excess water, then slice. <br>
2.	Carrot and Zucchini salting (optional, Note 10): Place carrot and zucchini in separate bowls, sprinkle each with 1/4 tsp salt, toss, leave for 20 minutes then drain excess liquid. <br>
Cook Vegetables: <br>
1.	Get 2 skillets going if you can! <br>
2.	Shiitake: Heat 2 tsp oil oil in a skillet over medium high heat. Cook mushrooms for 2 minutes. Add 1.5 tsp soy, 1/4 tsp sugar, 1/2 tsp of garlic. Stir for 1 minute, then remove. <br>
3.	Carrot: Add 2 tsp oil into the skillet, cook carrot until just tender (5 to 8 minutes), then remove. <br>
4.	Zucchini: Cook as with carrot for 4 minutes. <br>
5.	Spinach: Heat 2 tsp veg with a splash of sesame oil. Saute until starting to wilt. Add 1/2 tsp garlic, and salt to taste, stir, then remove. When cool, squeeze to drain out excess liquid. <br>
6.	Beansprouts: Simmer in water for 5 min or steam in microwave for 3 min until floppy. Drain under cold water, then cool. Squeeze out excess liquid with hands, place in bowl. Mix with 2 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp garlic, 1/4 tsp fish sauce. <br>
7.	Vegetables can cool, they are meant to be at room temp or slightly warm. <br>
Assemble: <br>
1.	Fry eggs in a skillet to your taste (I like mine with runny yolks). <br>
2.	Place warm rice in bowls. <br>
3.	Top with vegetables and beef, as pictured in post, then lastly, the egg. <br>
4.	Sprinkle with sesame seeds, drizzled with sesame oil. Serve with Bibimbap Sauce! <br></pre>
<a href="koreanC.html" name="c" target="c"> back</a>
    </body>
</html>
```

## School/Dishhtmlact/koreanRes2.html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
    <body>
        <pre>GABLITANG<br>
            Ingredients<br>
            For the Soup: <br>
            
            â€¢	2 pounds beef short ribs, English-cut, cut into 2-inch squares<br>
            â€¢	2 teaspoons salt<br>
            â€¢	4 ounces glass noodles<br>
            â€¢	2 scallions, sliced into 1-inch pieces<br>
            For the Seasoned Radish: <br>
            
            â€¢	1/2 large Korean radish, or 2 Chinese white radishes, peeled and cut into 1-inch slices<br>
            â€¢	3 tablespoons soy sauce<br>
            â€¢	2 teaspoons sesame oil<br>
            â€¢	4 cloves garlic, minced<br>
            â€¢	1 tablespoon sliced fresh ginger<br>
            â€¢	1 teaspoon finely ground black pepper<br>
            â€¢	Kochukaru chili powder, optional<br>
            
            Steps to Make It<br>
            Steps to Make It<br>
            1.	Gather the ingredients. <br>
            2.	Soak the ribs in a bowl of cold water for about 1 to 2 hours to drain the blood, changing <br>the water a couple of times. Longer soaking may be needed (traditionally, the ribs are soaked for 8 to 10 hours). <br>
            3.	Make the seasoned radish: Mix the sliced radish with the soy sauce, sesame oil, garlic, ginger, and pepper. <br>
            4.	Place the ribs in a pot and cover with fresh water. Bring to a boil and simmer vigorously for 5 minutes. <br>
            5.	Remove the ribs from the pot and rinse off any scum or oil in cold water. <br>
            6.	In a large pot, place the ribs and cover with 4 cups of fresh water. Bring to a boil, and then simmer over high heat for 30 minutes. <br>
            7.	Add the seasoned radish and the 2 teaspoons salt to the soup pot and cook for an <br>additional 10 minutes. <br>
            8.	Add the noodles and cook for another 4 minutes. <br>
            9.	Add the sliced scallions and cook for another minute. <br>
            10.	Serve with a sprinkle of chili powder, if desired. <br>
            <a href="koreanC.html" name="c" target="c"> back</a>
            </pre>

    </body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <title>Case List</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/index.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/case/case-list.css">
</head>
<body>
    <div id="nav"></div>
    <div class="case-page-title">
        <h1>CASE LIST</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="case-landing-page">
        <div class="case-topbar">
            <div class="case-type-group">
                <input type="radio" name="case-type" value="atx" id="atx-type" class="case-type-radio" checked>
                <label for="atx-type" class="case-type-label">ATX</label>
                <input type="radio" name="case-type" value="m-atx" id="matx-type" class="case-type-radio">
                <label for="matx-type" class="case-type-label">M-ATX</label>
                <input type="radio" name="case-type" value="m-itx" id="mitx-type" class="case-type-radio">
                <label for="mitx-type" class="case-type-label">M-ITX</label>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="case-scrollable-content" >
            <div class="case-grid-container">
                <!-- ATX Items -->
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/atx/atx1.png" alt="ATX Case 1">
                    <p>ATX Case 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/atx/atx2.png" alt="ATX Case 2">
                    <p>ATX Case 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/atx/atx3.png" alt="ATX Case 3">
                    <p>ATX Case 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/atx/atx4.png" alt="ATX Case 4">
                    <p>ATX Case 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/atx/atx5.png" alt="ATX Case 5">
                    <p>ATX Case 5</p>
                </div>
                <!-- M-ATX Items -->
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-atx/matx1.png" alt="M-ATX Case 1">
                    <p>M-ATX Case 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-atx/matx2.png" alt="M-ATX Case 2">
                    <p>M-ATX Case 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-atx/matx3.png" alt="M-ATX Case 3">
                    <p>M-ATX Case 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-atx/matx4.png" alt="M-ATX Case 4">
                    <p>M-ATX Case 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-atx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-atx/matx5.png" alt="M-ATX Case 5">
                    <p>M-ATX Case 5</p>
                </div>
                <!-- M-ITX Items -->
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-itx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-itx/mitx1.png" alt="M-ITX Case 1">
                    <p>M-ITX Case 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-itx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-itx/mitx2.png" alt="M-ITX Case 2">
                    <p>M-ITX Case 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-itx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-itx/mitx3.png" alt="M-ITX Case 3">
                    <p>M-ITX Case 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-itx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-itx/mitx4.png" alt="M-ITX Case 4">
                    <p>M-ITX Case 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="case-grid-item" data-type="m-itx">
                    <img src="@/assets/case/m-itx/mitx5.png" alt="M-ITX Case 5">
                    <p>M-ITX Case 5</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="bottom-nav"></div>
    <script>
        // Filtering logic for case type
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="case-type"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="case-type"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.case-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-type') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked type or type from URL
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Get 'type' from query string (e.g., ?type=atx)
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const typeParam = params.get('type');
            let typeValue = null;
            if (typeParam && ['atx', 'm-atx', 'm-itx'].includes(typeParam)) {
                typeValue = typeParam;
            }
            if (typeValue) {
                let radioId = '';
                if (typeValue === 'atx') radioId = 'atx-type';
                else if (typeValue === 'm-atx') radioId = 'matx-type';
                else if (typeValue === 'm-itx') radioId = 'mitx-type';
                const radio = document.getElementById(radioId);
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                    radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                    return;
                }
            }
            // Default: show checked
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="case-type"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```
