    <script>
        // Filtering logic for Cooler type
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="cooler-type"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="cooler-type"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.cooler-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-type') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked type or type from URL
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const typeParam = params.get('type');
            let typeValue = null;
            if (typeParam && ['aicooler', 'aio'].includes(typeParam)) {
                typeValue = typeParam;
            }
            if (typeValue) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(typeValue + '-type');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                    radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                    return;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="cooler-type"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

                    </a>

                    </a>
                </div>
                <div class="ryzen-grid-item" data-series="r9">
                    <a href="ryzen9/ryzen9-9900x.html">
                        <img src="@/assets/cpu/cpu-amd/ryzen9/9th.png" alt="9900X">
                        <p>9900X</p>
                    </a>

                <div class="ryzen-grid-item" data-series="r9">

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for AMD series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="ryzen-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="ryzen-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.ryzen-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?cpu= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check for ?cpu= in URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const cpu = params.get('cpu');
            if (cpu && ['r3','r5','r7','r9'].includes(cpu)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(cpu + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="ryzen-series"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for Intel series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="intel-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="intel-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.intel-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?cpu= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check for ?cpu= in URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const cpu = params.get('cpu');
            if (cpu && ['i3','i5','i7','i9'].includes(cpu)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(cpu + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="intel-series"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for AMD GPU series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="amd-gpu-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="amd-gpu-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.amd-gpu-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?series= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check for ?series= in URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const series = params.get('series');
            if (series && ['5000', '6000', '7000'].includes(series)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(series + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                    radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change')); // Trigger change event to filter items
                }
            } else {
                const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="amd-gpu-series"]:checked');
                if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            }
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for Intel mobo series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="nvidia-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="nvidia-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.nvidia-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?series= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const series = params.get('series');
            if (series && ['20','30','40'].includes(series)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(series + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="nvidia-series"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for AMD mobo series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="mobo-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="mobo-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.mobo-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?series= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const series = params.get('series');
            if (series && ['a','b','x'].includes(series)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(series + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="mobo-series"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

## School/NEWwe/websystem/pages/motherboard-page/intel-mobo/intel-list.html

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <title>Intel Motherboard List</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/index.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/motherboard/intel-css/intel-list.css">
</head>
<body>
    <div id="nav"></div>
    <div class="intel-mobo-page-title">
        <h1>INTEL MOTHERBOARD LIST</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="intel-mobo-landing-page">
        <div class="intel-mobo-topbar">
            <div class="intel-mobo-series-group">
                <input type="radio" name="intel-mobo-series" value="h" id="h-series" class="intel-mobo-series-radio" checked>
                <label for="h-series" class="intel-mobo-series-label">h-series</label>
                <input type="radio" name="intel-mobo-series" value="b" id="b-series" class="intel-mobo-series-radio">
                <label for="b-series" class="intel-mobo-series-label">b-series</label>
                <input type="radio" name="intel-mobo-series" value="z" id="z-series" class="intel-mobo-series-radio">
                <label for="z-series" class="intel-mobo-series-label">z-series</label>
            </div>
            <a href="../amd-mobo/amd-list.html" class="intel-amd-link">AMD List</a>
        </div>
        <div class="intel-mobo-scrollable-content">
            <div class="intel-mobo-grid-container">
                <!-- h-series Items -->
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="h">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/h-series/h1.png" alt="H-Series Mobo 1">
                    <p>H-Series Mobo 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="h">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/h-series/h2.png" alt="H-Series Mobo 2">
                    <p>H-Series Mobo 2</p>
                </div>
                <!-- b-series Items -->
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="b">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/b-series/b1.png" alt="B-Series Mobo 1">
                    <p>B-Series Mobo 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="b">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/b-series/b2.png" alt="B-Series Mobo 2">
                    <p>B-Series Mobo 2</p>
                </div>
                <!-- z-series Items -->
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="z">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/z-series/z1.png" alt="Z-Series Mobo 1">
                    <p>Z-Series Mobo 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="intel-mobo-grid-item" data-series="z">
                    <img src="@/assets/mobo/intel/z-series/z2.png" alt="Z-Series Mobo 2">
                    <p>Z-Series Mobo 2</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="bottom-nav"></div>
    <script>
        // Filtering logic for Intel mobo series
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="intel-mobo-series"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="intel-mobo-series"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.intel-mobo-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-series') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked series and handle ?series= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const series = params.get('series');
            if (series && ['h','b','z'].includes(series)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(series + '-series');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="intel-mobo-series"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```

```
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <title>PSU List</title>
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/index.css">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../../../styles/psu/psu-list.css">
</head>
<body>
    <div id="nav"></div>
    <div class="psu-page-title">
        <h1>PSU LIST</h1>
    </div>
    <div class="psu-landing-page">
        <div class="psu-topbar">
            <div class="psu-type-group">
                <input type="radio" name="psu-type" value="fully-modular" id="fully-modular-type" class="psu-type-radio" checked>
                <label for="fully-modular-type" class="psu-type-label">Fully Modular</label>
                <input type="radio" name="psu-type" value="semi-modular" id="semi-modular-type" class="psu-type-radio">
                <label for="semi-modular-type" class="psu-type-label">Semi-Modular</label>
                <input type="radio" name="psu-type" value="non-modular" id="non-modular-type" class="psu-type-radio">
                <label for="non-modular-type" class="psu-type-label">Non-Modular</label>
            </div>
        </div>
        <div class="psu-grid-container">
                <!-- Fully Modular Items -->
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="fully-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/fully-modular/fm1.png" alt="Fully Modular PSU 1">
                    <p>Fully Modular PSU 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="fully-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/fully-modular/fm2.png" alt="Fully Modular PSU 2">
                    <p>Fully Modular PSU 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="fully-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/fully-modular/fm3.png" alt="Fully Modular PSU 3">
                    <p>Fully Modular PSU 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="fully-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/fully-modular/fm4.png" alt="Fully Modular PSU 4">
                    <p>Fully Modular PSU 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="fully-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/fully-modular/fm5.png" alt="Fully Modular PSU 5">
                    <p>Fully Modular PSU 5</p>
                </div>
                <!-- Semi-Modular Items -->
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="semi-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/semi-modular/sm1.png" alt="Semi-Modular PSU 1">
                    <p>Semi-Modular PSU 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="semi-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/semi-modular/sm2.png" alt="Semi-Modular PSU 2">
                    <p>Semi-Modular PSU 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="semi-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/semi-modular/sm3.png" alt="Semi-Modular PSU 3">
                    <p>Semi-Modular PSU 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="semi-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/semi-modular/sm4.png" alt="Semi-Modular PSU 4">
                    <p>Semi-Modular PSU 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="semi-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/semi-modular/sm5.png" alt="Semi-Modular PSU 5">
                    <p>Semi-Modular PSU 5</p>
                </div>
                <!-- Non-Modular Items -->
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="non-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/non-modular/nm1.png" alt="Non-Modular PSU 1">
                    <p>Non-Modular PSU 1</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="non-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/non-modular/nm2.png" alt="Non-Modular PSU 2">
                    <p>Non-Modular PSU 2</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="non-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/non-modular/nm3.png" alt="Non-Modular PSU 3">
                    <p>Non-Modular PSU 3</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="non-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/non-modular/nm4.png" alt="Non-Modular PSU 4">
                    <p>Non-Modular PSU 4</p>
                </div>
                <div class="psu-grid-item" data-type="non-modular">
                    <img src="@/assets/psu/non-modular/nm5.png" alt="Non-Modular PSU 5">
                    <p>Non-Modular PSU 5</p>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>
    <div id="bottom-nav"></div>
    <script>
        // Filtering logic for PSU type
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="psu-type"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="psu-type"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.psu-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-type') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked type or type from URL
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Get 'type' from query string (e.g., ?type=fully-modular)
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const typeParam = params.get('type');
            let typeValue = null;
            if (typeParam && ['fully-modular', 'semi-modular', 'non-modular'].includes(typeParam)) {
                typeValue = typeParam;
            }
            if (typeValue) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(typeValue + '-type');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                    radio.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
                    return;
                }
            }
            // Default: show checked
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="psu-type"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

```

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for RAM type
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="ram-type"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="ram-type"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.ram-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-type') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked RAM type and handle ?ram= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check for ?ram= in URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const ram = params.get('ram');
            if (ram && ['ddr4', 'ddr5'].includes(ram)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(ram + '-type');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="ram-type"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

    <script>
        // Filtering logic for Storage type
        document.querySelectorAll('input[name="storage-type"]').forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', () => {
                const selectedValue = document.querySelector('input[name="storage-type"]:checked').value;
                document.querySelectorAll('.storage-grid-item').forEach(item => {
                    item.style.display = item.getAttribute('data-type') === selectedValue ? 'block' : 'none';
                });
            });
        });

        // On load, show only checked type and handle ?type= query param
        window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
            // Check for ?type= in URL
            const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
            const type = params.get('type');
            if (type && ['nvme', 'sata', 'hdd'].includes(type)) {
                const radio = document.getElementById(type + '-type');
                if (radio) {
                    radio.checked = true;
                }
            }
            const checked = document.querySelector('input[name="storage-type"]:checked');
            if (checked) checked.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
        });
    </script>
</body>
</html>

## School/NEWwe/websystem/samples/styles.css

```


body {
    background-image: url('diagonal-pattern.png');
    background-color: #f0f0f0;
    background-size: cover;
    min-height: 100vh;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

header {
    background-color: #000;
    color: white;
    padding: 15px 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
    height: 70px;
}

.logo {
    font-size: 24px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.search-menu {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
}

.search-container {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #fff;
    border-radius: 30px;
    padding: 5px 10px;
    margin-right: 15px;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    width: 300px;
}

.search-container input {
    flex: 1;
    border: none;
    outline: none;
    padding: 8px;
    background: transparent;
}

.search-button {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
}

.search-button svg {
    color: #888;
}

.menu-button {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.hamburger {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: space-between;
    height: 24px;
}

.hamburger span {
    display: block;
    width: 30px;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: white;
    margin: 2px 0;
}

.main-content {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 20px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
}

.product-display {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1200px;
    display: flex;
    background: transparent;
    position: relative;
    border-radius: 15px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.sidebar {
    width: 120px;
    background-color: transparent;
    overflow: visible;
}

.thumbnail-container {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 15px;
    overflow: visible;
}

.thumbnail {
    width: 100px;
    height: 120px;
    background-color: #a01b1b;
    border-radius: 15px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    color: white;
    cursor: pointer;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1; 
    top: 5px;
}

.thumbnail img {
    width: 70px;
    height: 70px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
}

.thumbnail-label {
    line-height: 1.2;
    font-size: 14px;
}

.thumbnail-border {
    position: relative;
    width: 100px;
    height: 120px;
    border-radius: 15px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    
}

.thumbnail-border::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: 0;
    left: -30px;
    width: 200px;
    height: 110%;
    background-color: #f44336;
    border-top-left-radius: 15px;
    border-bottom-left-radius: 15px;
    z-index: 0;
    
}

.product-details {
    flex: 1;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
    border-radius: 15px;
    display: flex;
    position: relative;
    padding: 20px;
    border: 8px solid #e73a3a;
}

.close-button {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    right: 10px;
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    background-color: #9e1717;
    color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: bold;
}

.product-image {
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
}

.product-image img {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 400px;
    object-fit: contain;
}

.product-info {
    flex: 1;
    padding: 20px;
}

.brand-logo {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    width: 500px;
    height: 80px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-left: -30px; 
}

.brand-logo img {
    width: 100%;
}

.specifications {
    list-style-type: none;
}

.specifications li {
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    position: relative;
    padding-left: 15px;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

.specifications li::before {
    content: "â€¢";
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    color: #000;
}

strong {
    font-weight: bold;
}

footer {
    background-color: #000000;
    padding: 10px 20px;
    text-align: right;
    width: 100%;
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

.info-button {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    cursor: pointer;
}

.info-button span:first-child {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    background-color: #888;
    color: white;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    margin-right: 5px;
    font-style: italic;
}

.info-button span:last-child {
    color: white;
    font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .product-details {
        flex-direction: column;
    }
    
    .product-image, .product-info {
        width: 100%;
    }
}
```

```
/* --- Cooler Page Title --- */
.cooler-page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #222;
    color: #7C4DFF;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}

.cooler-page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

/* --- Top Bar for Buttons --- */
.cooler-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-top: 10px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
}

/* --- Cooler Type Buttons (Left) --- */
.cooler-type-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
}

.cooler-type-radio {
    display: none;
}

.cooler-type-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #7C4DFF;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s, color 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.cooler-type-label:hover {
    background-color: #4b2cbf;
}

.cooler-type-radio:checked + .cooler-type-label {
    width: 170px;
    background-color: #222;
    color: #7C4DFF;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
}

/* --- Layout --- */
.cooler-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.cooler-scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 258px auto; /* Adjusted bottom margin for AMD button */
    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px; /* Remove top padding */
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
}
.cooler-scrollable-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.cooler-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #222;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;    /* Remove opacity */
    opacity: 0.95;
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.cooler-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.cooler-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: #000000;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #7C4DFF;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.cooler-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.cooler-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

```

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/cpu-amd/ryzen-cpu-list.css

```
/* --- Ryzen Page Title --- */
.ryzen-page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    color: #ED1C24; /* Changed from #FF9100 to #ED1C24 */
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}

.ryzen-page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

/* --- Top Bar for Buttons --- */
.ryzen-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between; /* Add space between left group and right button */
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 92%;
    margin: 0 auto; /* Remove bottom margin */
    padding-top: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 0;    /* Ensure no gap below */
    padding-bottom: 0;   /* Ensure no gap below */
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

/* --- Ryzen Series Buttons (Left) --- */
.ryzen-series-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-left: 19px;
}

.ryzen-series-radio {
    display: none;
}

.ryzen-series-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #ED1C24; /* Red background */
    color: #fff;               /* White text for visibility */
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s, color 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.ryzen-series-label:hover {
    background-color: #fff; /* Black on hover */
    color: #000;            /* Keep text white on hover */
}

.ryzen-series-radio:checked + .ryzen-series-label {
    width: 170px;
    background-color: #000;    /* White background when selected */
    color: #fff;            /* Red text when selected */
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
}

/* --- Intel Button (Top Right) --- */
.ryzen-intel-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #00ADEF;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    animation: intel-pulse 1.2s infinite alternate;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition: background 0.3s;
}

.ryzen-intel-link:hover {
    background-color: #0074A6;
}

@keyframes intel-pulse {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #00ADEF40; }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px 8px #00ADEF20; }
}

/* --- Layout --- */
.ryzen-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.ryzen-scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 258px auto;
    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px; /* Remove top padding */
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
}
.ryzen-scrollable-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.ryzen-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.95;
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.ryzen-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.ryzen-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.8);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #ED1C24; /* Changed from #FF9100 to #ED1C24 */
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.ryzen-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.ryzen-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

a {
    color: #fff;
    text-decoration: none;
}

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/gpu/gpu.css

```
.gpu-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 80px auto; /* Centered the box horizontally */
    background-color: #000; /* Black background for the title box */
    color:  #fdfce9; /* White text for contrast */
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 40%; /* Reduced width to make the box shorter */
}

.gpu-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

.gpu-brands {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-around;
    margin: 150px 20px; /* Increased top margin to lower the boxes */
}

.gpu-brands div {
    width: 25%; /* Reduced width to make the boxes smaller */
    text-align: center;
    background-color: #000; /* Changed to black */
    border: 1px solid #333; /* Adjusted border color for subtle contrast */
    border-radius: 15px;
    padding: 10px; /* Reduced padding for smaller boxes */
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); /* Darker shadow for black boxes */
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s;
}

.gpu-brands div:hover {
    transform: scale(1.05);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); /* Slightly stronger shadow on hover */
}

.gpu-brands img {
    max-width: 70%; /* Reduced image size */
    height: auto;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.gpu-brands p {
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; /* Ensure Fredoka is applied to descriptions */
    font-size: 0.9em; /* Slightly smaller font size */
    color: #fff; /* Changed to white for better contrast */
    line-height: 1.4; /* Adjusted line height for smaller text */
}

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/gpu/intel-gpu/intel-gpu-list.css

```
.intel-gpu-page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    color: #0074D9;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}

.intel-gpu-page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

/* --- Top Bar for Buttons --- */
.intel-gpu-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 92%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-top: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

/* --- Intel Mobo Series Buttons (Left) --- */
.intel-gpu-series-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-left: 19px; /* Add left margin for spacing */
}

.intel-gpu-series-radio {
    display: none;
}

.intel-gpu-series-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #0074D9;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s, color 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.intel-gpu-series-label:hover {
    background-color: #fff;
    color: #0074D9;
}

.intel-gpu-series-radio:checked + .intel-gpu-series-label {
    width: 170px;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
}

.intel-nvidia-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #76B900;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    animation: nvidia-pulse 1.2s infinite alternate;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition: background 0.3s;
    margin-left: 1276px;
}

.intel-nvidia-link:hover {
    background-color: #76B900;
}

@keyframes nvidia-pulse {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #76B90040; }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px 8px #76B90020; } 
}

/* --- intel List Button (Top Right) --- */
.intel-amd-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #ED1C24;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    animation: amd-pulse 1.2s infinite alternate;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition: background 0.3s;
}

.intel-amd-link:hover {
    background-color: #b31217;
}

@keyframes amd-pulse {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #ED1C2440; }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px 8px #ED1C2420; }
}

/* --- Layout --- */
.intel-gpu-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.intel-gpu-scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 258px auto;
    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
}
.intel-gpu-scrollable-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.intel-gpu-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.95;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.intel-gpu-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.intel-gpu-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.8);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #0074D9;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.intel-gpu-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.intel-gpu-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}/* Empty file for intel GPU styles */
/* Empty file for Intel GPU styles */

```

```
@font-face {
    font-family: 'Fredoka';
    font-optical-sizing: auto;
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 100 900;
    src: url('@/assets/font/Fredoka-VariableFont_wdth,wght.ttf') format('truetype'); /* Correct the path */
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Orbitron';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 400 700;
    src: url('@/assets/font/Orbitron-VariableFont_wght.ttf') format('truetype'); /* Add Orbitron font */
}

@font-face {
    font-family: 'Teko';
    font-style: normal;
    font-weight: 300 700;
    src: url('@/assets/font/Teko-VariableFont_wght.ttf') format('truetype'); /* Add Teko font */
}

#nav {
    background-color: #000000;
    width: 100%;
    height: 60px;
}

body {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    background-color: #fdfce9; 
    background-image: url('@/assets/bg/tech-bg.png');
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
    background-position: center center;
    background-size: cover;
    overflow: hidden; /* Prevent scrolling */
    height: 100vh; /* Full viewport height */
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; /* Apply Fredoka font */
}

img {
    opacity: 1 !important; /* Ensure global image styles do not override local styles */
    background-color: transparent; /* Reset any global background color */
}

#bottom-nav {
    position: fixed;
    bottom: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 50px; 
    background-color: #000000; 
    color: white; 
    text-align: center;
    line-height: 50px; 
    box-shadow: 0 -2px 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); 
}

#image-container {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center; 
    align-items: center; 
    padding: 20px; 
    position: absolute; 
    top: 180px; /* Use CSS variable for top position */
   right: 160px; /* Use CSS variable for right position */ 
}

#image-container img {
    width: 700px; 
    height: 1000; 
    object-fit: contain; 
}

.intro-image {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    margin-top: 20px; /* Add spacing above the image */
}

.intro-image img {
    width: 80%; /* Adjust image width */
    height: auto; /* Maintain aspect ratio */
}


.enter-page {
    display: flex;
    text-align: center;
    position: absolute;
    top:365px; /* Adjusted to place below the box */
    left: 280px; /* Centered relative to the box */
    font-size: 12px;
    background-color: #000000;
    color: rgb(252, 252, 252);
    padding: 15px 50px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 150px;
    cursor: pointer;
    margin-top: 0; /* Removed extra margin */
}

.highlight-box {
    background-color: #000000; /* Light background color */
    color: #fdfce9; /* Set font color to pink */
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 35px; /* Increased curve for the box */
    text-align: center;
    position: absolute;
    top: 280px;
    left: 200px;
    width: 700px; /* Keep the given width */
    height: 350px; /* Keep the given height */
    box-sizing: border-box; /* Include padding in width */
    max-width: 700px; /* Limit maximum width */
    display: flex; /* Use flexbox for centering */
    flex-direction: column; /* Stack elements vertically */
    justify-content: center; /* Center content vertically */
    align-items: center; /* Center content horizontally */
}

.highlight-box .intro-title {
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; /* Changed to Fredoka font */
    font-size: 28px; /* Adjust font size to fit */
    margin-bottom: 15px; /* Adjust spacing below the title */
    margin-top: 0; /* Remove extra margin to center properly */
}

.highlight-box .intro-text {
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif; /* Changed to Fredoka font */
    font-size: 10px; /* Adjust font size to fit */
    word-wrap: break-word; /* Ensure text wraps properly */
    overflow: hidden; /* Prevent overflow outside the box */
    text-overflow: ellipsis; /* Add ellipsis for overflowing text */
}

```
/* --- AMD Mobo Page Title --- */
.mobo-page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    color: #ED1C24;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}

.mobo-page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

/* --- Top Bar for Buttons --- */
.mobo-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 92%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding-top: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
}

/* --- Mobo Series Buttons (Left) --- */
.mobo-series-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
    margin-left: 19px; /* Add left margin for spacing */
}

.mobo-series-radio {
    display: none;
}

.mobo-series-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #ED1C24;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s, color 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.mobo-series-label:hover {
    background-color: #fff;
    color: #000;
}

.mobo-series-radio:checked + .mobo-series-label {
    width: 170px;
    background-color: #000;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
}

/* --- Intel List Button (Top Right) --- */
.ryzen-intel-link {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #00ADEF;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-decoration: none;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    animation: intel-pulse 1.2s infinite alternate;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    transition: background 0.3s;
}

.ryzen-intel-link:hover {
    background-color: #0074A6;
}

@keyframes intel-pulse {
    0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 #00ADEF40; }
    100% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px 8px #00ADEF20; }
}

/* --- Layout --- */
.mobo-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.mobo-scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 258px auto;
    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
}
.mobo-scrollable-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.mobo-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #1a1a1a;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.95;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.mobo-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.mobo-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: rgba(26, 26, 26, 0.8);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #ED1C24;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.mobo-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.mobo-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/motherboard/mobo-list.css

```
/* --- Page Title --- */
.page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #000000;
    color: #0074D9;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}
.page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}
/* --- Layout --- */
.landing-page {
    display: flex;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
    position: relative;
}
/* --- Sidebar --- */
.series-sidebar {
    width: 150px;
    position: fixed;
    top: calc(50% + 40px);
    left: 61px;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    padding: 20px;
    gap: 30px;
    opacity: 0.9;
}
.series-sidebar input {
    display: none;
}
.series-sidebar label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 180px;
    height: 70px;
    background-color: #0074D9;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}
.series-sidebar label:hover {
    background-color: #005BB5;
}
.series-sidebar input:checked + label {
    width: 260px;
    background-color: black;
    border-radius: 18px 0 0 18px;
}
/* --- Brand Filter Buttons --- */
.brand-filter {
    gap: 16px;
}
.brand-btn {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 180px;
    height: 70px;
    background-color: #0074D9;
    color: #ffffff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 22px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    cursor: pointer;
    border: none;
    transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(.4,2,.6,1), box-shadow 0.2s, height 0.3s cubic-bezier(.4,2,.6,1);
    margin: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
}
.brand-btn:hover {
    background-color: #005BB5;
}
.brand-btn.active,
.brand-btn:focus {
    height: 110px;
    background-color: black;
    border-radius: 18px 18px 18px 18px;
    outline: none;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
    z-index: 2;
    width: 180px;
}
/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    margin-left: 170px;
    height: calc(10vh -90px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 20px;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    position: relative;
}
/* --- Grid Container --- */
.grid-container {
    height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #000000;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.9;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    margin-top: 100px;
}
.grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}
/* --- Grid Item --- */
.grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: rgba(0, 173, 239, 0.1);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
    border: 1px solid #00ADEF;
    color: #ffffff;
    text-align: center;
}
.grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}
.grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

```

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/page-2.css

```
.page2-title {
    display: flex;
    text-align: center;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    font-family: 'Teko', sans-serif; /* Change font to Teko */
    font-size: 28px; /* Adjust font size to fit within the box */
    background-color: #000000; /* Add background box */
    color: #fdfce9; /* Change font color */
    padding: 5px 20px; /* Reduce top and bottom padding to make the box thinner */
    border-radius: 15px; /* Add rounded corners */
    height: 100px; /* Adjust height to fit content */
    width: 600px; /* Adjust width to fit content */
    position: absolute; /* Position the box */
    top: 140px; /* Adjust vertical position to avoid overlapping with nav */
    left: 50%; /* Center horizontally */
    transform: translateX(-50%); /* Adjust for centering */
    white-space: nowrap; /* Ensure the title stays in one line */
}

.pc-part {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); /* 4 columns */
    gap: 25px; /* Increase spacing between boxes for uniformity */
    justify-items: center; /* Center items horizontally */
    align-items: center; /* Center items vertically */
    margin-top: 290px; /* Increase margin-top to lower the parts list */
}

.parts-list {
    width: 220px; /* Slightly smaller box size */
    height: 220px; /* Slightly smaller box size */
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 12px; /* Adjust font size for smaller boxes */
    background-color: #000000;
    color: rgb(252, 252, 252);
    padding: 15px;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 50px;
    cursor: pointer;
    overflow: hidden;
    position: relative;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; /* Smooth hover effect */
}

.parts-list:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1); /* Slightly enlarge the box on hover */
    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3); /* Add shadow effect */
}

.parts-list img {
    width: 120%; /* Adjust image size relative to the smaller box */
    height: auto;
    object-fit: contain;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease-in-out;
}

.parts-list p {
    font-size: 16px; /* Slightly larger text for better readability */
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-top: 10px;
    color: #fdfce9;
    opacity: 1; /* Ensure text is always visible */
    transition: none; /* Disable hover transition effects */
    position: absolute; /* Position text over the image */
    bottom: 10px; /* Place text at the bottom */
}

.page2-text {
    margin-top: 50px; /* Adjust this value as needed to minimize dead space */
}

```

## School/NEWwe/websystem/styles/psu/psu-list.css

```
/* --- PSU Page Title --- */
.psu-page-title {
    text-align: center;
    margin: 40px auto 0;
    background-color: #222;
    color: #FF9800;
    padding: 20px;
    border-radius: 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    width: 30%;
}

.psu-page-title h1 {
    font-size: 2.5em;
    margin: 0;
}

/* --- Top Bar for Buttons --- */
.psu-topbar {
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    align-items: flex-start;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 0 auto;
    padding-top: 10px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    padding-bottom: 0;
}

/* --- PSU Type Buttons (Left) --- */
.psu-type-group {
    display: flex;
    gap: 18px;
}

.psu-type-radio {
    display: none;
}

.psu-type-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 48px;
    background-color: #FF9800;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s, width 0.3s, color 0.3s;
    box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
}

.psu-type-label:hover {
    background-color: #c66900;
}

.psu-type-radio:checked + .psu-type-label {
    width: 170px;
    background-color: #222;
    color: #FF9800;
    border-radius: 14px 14px 0 0;
}

/* --- Layout --- */
.psu-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.psu-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    width: 90%; /* Changed from 100% to 90% */
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    border-radius: 10px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #222;
    margin: 0 auto 280px auto; /* Move container down by 3px */
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.95;
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.psu-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.psu-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: rgba(34, 34, 34, 0.8);
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #FF9800;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.psu-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.psu-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

```

}

.ram-type-radio {

    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 120px;
    height: 50px;
    background-color: #7C4DFF;
    color: #fff;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
    font-size: 18px;
    border-radius: 14px;
    cursor: pointer;

.ram-landing-page {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    height: 100vh;
    overflow: hidden;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

/* --- Scrollable Content --- */
.ram-scrollable-content {
    flex: 1;
    width: 90%;
    margin: 0 auto 0 auto; /* Adjusted bottom margin for AMD button */
    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px; /* Remove top padding */
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */

    opacity: 0.95;

}

    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 0.95;

}

    display: none;
}

    height: calc(100vh - 180px);
    overflow-y: auto;
    padding: 0 20px 20px 20px; /* Remove top padding */
    scrollbar-width: none; /* Firefox */
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    opacity: 0.95;
}
.storage-scrollable-content::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Container --- */
.storage-grid-container {
    min-height: 600px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
    grid-gap: 20px;
    justify-items: center;
    align-items: center;
    background-color: #222;
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 20px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    opacity: 1;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
}
.storage-grid-container::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
}

/* --- Grid Item --- */
.storage-grid-item {
    width: 220px;
    height: 240px;
    background-color: #000000;
    border-radius: 10px;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    transition: transform 0.3s, box-shadow 0.3s;
    border: 1px solid #7C4DFF;
    color: #fff;
    text-align: center;
}

.storage-grid-item img {
    width: 180px;
    height: 180px;
    object-fit: contain;
    margin: 10px auto;
    display: block;
    opacity: 1.0;
}

.storage-grid-item p {
    text-align: center;
    font-size: 1.1em;
    margin: 0;
    font-family: 'Fredoka', sans-serif;
}

```

## School/WEBSYS/.github/workflows/jekyll-gh-pages.yml

```
# Sample workflow for building and deploying a Jekyll site to GitHub Pages
name: Deploy Jekyll with GitHub Pages dependencies preinstalled

on:
  # Runs on pushes targeting the default branch
  push:
    branches: ["main"]

  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  workflow_dispatch:

# Sets permissions of the GITHUB_TOKEN to allow deployment to GitHub Pages
permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

# Allow only one concurrent deployment, skipping runs queued between the run in-progress and latest queued.
# However, do NOT cancel in-progress runs as we want to allow these production deployments to complete.
concurrency:
  group: "pages"
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  # Build job
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Pages
        uses: actions/configure-pages@v5
      - name: Build with Jekyll
        uses: actions/jekyll-build-pages@v1
        with:
          source: ./
          destination: ./_site
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3

  # Deployment job
  deploy:
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: build
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        id: deployment
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4

```

## School/WEBSYS/project/scripts/amdcpulist.js

```
function filterCPU(category) {
    // Hide all items
    const allItems = document.querySelectorAll('.grid-item');
    allItems.forEach(item => item.style.display = 'none');

    // Show items of the selected category
    const categoryItems = document.querySelectorAll(`.${category}`);
    categoryItems.forEach(item => item.style.display = 'block');
}

// Automatically highlight the CPU type based on the query parameter
const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
const cpuId = urlParams.get('cpu');
if (cpuId) {
    filterCPU(cpuId);
}

```

function showLandingPage(cpuId) {
    // Hide the initial boxes
    document.querySelector('.cpu-intel-boxes').classList.add('hidden');
    document.querySelector('.cpu-intel-title').classList.add('hidden');

    // Show the landing page
    document.querySelector('.landing-page').classList.remove('hidden');
}

```
